Planet.name: Murkhana
Planet.description: This world was a tourist attraction for the beauty of its oceans, black beaches, sheltered coves and coral reefs. The forests and plains are a constant bright but murky green. The inhabitants have sided with the CIS and is a hosting planet for CIS propaganda.

pl.description: Murkhana słynęła niegdyś jako świat wypoczynkowy, przyciągający turystów rozległymi oceanami, czarnymi plażami, osłoniętymi zatokami i barwnymi rafami koralowymi. Jej lasy i równiny pokrywa jaskrawa, choć przytłumiona zielenią roślinność. Mieszkańcy opowiedzieli się po stronie Konfederacji Niezależnych Systemów, a planeta stała się jednym z ośrodków separatystycznej propagandy. Walory naturalne Murkhany współistnieją zatem z rosnącym znaczeniem politycznym i informacyjnym w strukturach CIS.

en.description: This world was a tourist attraction for the beauty of its oceans, black beaches, sheltered coves and coral reefs. The forests and plains are a constant bright but murky green. The inhabitants have sided with the CIS and is a hosting planet for CIS propaganda.

hut.description: Murkhana was once a pleasure-world praised for oceans, black beaches, sheltered coves, and coral reefs. Bright, murky-green forests and plains cover its land. Its people chose the Confederacy, and the world now hosts Separatista propaganda. Beauty remains its oldest asset, but political messaging has become the planet's greater value in the CIS ledger.

Planet.name: Nyriaan
Planet.description: Nyriaan is a unique planet within the galaxy. It is covered in a thick cloud layer above its atmosphere that is so strong it blocks all communication to and from the surface, as well as making unaided landing impossible. Furthermore, the weather on Nyriaan poses a constraint threat to its inhabitants and further makes landings upon the planet beyond dangerous. Storms on the planet can be massive and quite common, lasting months on end. Interestingly, another phenomenon on Nyriaan is its interaction with the Force. While force sensitives could use the Force while on its surface, they couldn’t do so while in planetary atmosphere, due to a currently unidentified interference. The planet's surface consists of plains and low hills, with some valleys, where boggy conditions have formed. In the northern hemisphere, there are many shallow, rocky valleys, which were where most of the planet's mining operations had once taken place before mysteriously being abandoned. Lastly, and most interestingly, there have been rumors and folk stories being told about strange individuals roaming the surface of Nyriaan’s northern hemisphere. Helmeted monstrosities dragging settlers away into the night. Such folk stories have been told for the last couple of thousand years and have mostly been ignored by Republic officials.

pl.description: Nyriaan spowija niezwykle gęsta warstwa chmur, która odcina powierzchnię od łączności i niemal uniemożliwia samodzielne lądowanie. Wielomiesięczne burze, podmokłe równiny, niskie wzgórza oraz skaliste doliny czynią świat wyjątkowo niebezpiecznym. Dawne kopalnie na północy zostały porzucone w niewyjaśnionych okolicznościach. W atmosferze występują również zakłócenia ograniczające korzystanie z Mocy. Od tysięcy lat osadnicy przekazują opowieści o hełmiastych istotach porywających ludzi nocą, lecz urzędnicy Republiki zwykle uznawali je za folklor.

hut.description: Nyriaan hides beneath a cloud layer strong enough to cut surface comms and make unaided landing nearly impossible. Storms may last for months above boggy plains, low hills, and rocky northern valleys where abandoned mines still stand. The atmosphere also interferes with use of the Force. For thousands of years settlers have told of helmeted creatures taking people into the night, though Republica officials continue to file the stories as folklore rather than evidence.

Planet.name: Silla
Planet.description: The peaceful planet of Silla is inhabited by small villages. They are often found in the vast forests or on the side of large mountains. The temperate world is quiet.

pl.description: Silla jest spokojnym światem strefy umiarkowanej, którego niewielkie osady rozproszyły się pośród rozległych lasów i na zboczach wysokich gór. Brak wielkich metropolii oraz ciężkiego przemysłu pozwolił zachować cichy, prowincjonalny charakter planety. Jej znaczenie wynika przede wszystkim z lokalnych wspólnot i naturalnego krajobrazu, nie zaś z rozbudowanej gospodarki czy pozycji strategicznej.

en.description: The peaceful planet of Silla is inhabited by small villages. They are often found in the vast forests or on the side of large mountains. The temperate world is quiet.

hut.description: Silla is a quiet mild-world of small villages hidden among vast forests and high mountain slopes. Great cities and heavy industry have not taken root, leaving the planet provincial and calm. Its value lies in local communities and unspoiled land, not in a powerful industry or a strategic bargain.

Planet.name: Agaris
Planet.description: Agaris is a planet with an extremely damp and clammy climate like that of a jungle without any trees.

pl.description: Agaris wyróżnia się skrajnie wilgotnym, lepkim klimatem, przypominającym dżunglę pozbawioną drzew. Nasycone wodą powietrze i grząski teren dominują w krajobrazie, ograniczając rozwój osadnictwa oraz transportu. Dostępne archiwa nie wskazują rozległych zasobów ani znaczącego przemysłu; osobliwością planety pozostaje przede wszystkim jej bezleśne, tropikalne środowisko.

en.description: Agaris is a planet with an extremely damp and clammy climate like that of a jungle without any trees.

hut.description: Agaris carries an oppressively damp climate, like a jungle stripped of every tree. Water-heavy air and yielding ground dominate travel and settlement. Archives name no great resource or industry; the planet's chief distinction is its strange, treeless tropica environment.

Planet.name: Csilla
Planet.description: Csilla is a planet forever locked in ice. There is nothing on the surface other than military complexes and fake cities. Most of the fauna that existed on the planet no longer exist save a few trees that can be found in caves.

pl.description: Csillę od niepamiętnych czasów skuwa lód. Na powierzchni znajdują się przede wszystkim kompleksy wojskowe oraz pozorowane miasta, podczas gdy znaczna część właściwego życia i infrastruktury chroni się przed mrozem. Dawna fauna niemal całkowicie wyginęła; nieliczne drzewa przetrwały jedynie w osłoniętych jaskiniach. Surowy klimat uczynił planetę naturalną twierdzą, lecz poważnie ograniczył jej otwartą biosferę.

en.description: Csilla is a planet forever locked in ice. There is nothing on the surface other than military complexes and fake cities. Most of the fauna that existed on the planet no longer exist save a few trees that can be found in caves.

hut.description: Csilla is a world locked beneath ancient ice. Military complexes and false cities dominate the surface, while much of its real life and infrastructure hides from the cold. Most native fauna is gone, and only a few trees survive inside sheltered caves. The climate makes a natural fortress but leaves little open biosphere to exploit.

Planet.name: Benath
Planet.description: The rocky planet of Benath is located in Wild Space. The Benathy created their cities using the rocks and foliage among the orange surface. It is home to a monarchy civilization that is not affiliated with the Republic or the CIS.

pl.description: Benath to skalisty świat położony w Dzikiej Przestrzeni. Benathowie wznoszą miasta z miejscowego kamienia, wkomponowując zabudowę w pomarańczowe pustkowia i ocalałą roślinność. Planetą rządzi monarchia, która zachowuje niezależność zarówno od Republiki, jak i Konfederacji. Jej odosobnienie oraz własny porządek polityczny mają większe znaczenie niż słabo udokumentowane zasoby gospodarcze.

en.description: The rocky planet of Benath is located in Wild Space. The Benathy created their cities using the rocks and foliage among the orange surface. It is home to a monarchy civilization that is not affiliated with the Republic or the CIS.

hut.description: Benath is a rocky Wild Space world. The Benathy build cities from local stone among orange terrain and scattered foliage. A monarchy rules the planet while remaining outside both Republica and Confederacy. Isolation and an independent political order matter more here than any poorly documented resource wealth.

Planet.name: Malden
Planet.description: Malden is a campaign adaptation of the rugged Mediterranean island terrain recorded in Arma. Dry hills, patchwork fields, small settlements and a broken coastline define its inhabited zones, while old fortifications and airfields give it continuing military value. Local agriculture and modest port infrastructure support the colony, but no reliable interstellar census or detailed resource survey survives in the campaign archive. Its modern importance comes chiefly from its position on the Outer Rim approaches and from the defensible terrain surrounding its settlements.

pl.description: Malden jest kampanijną adaptacją surowego, śródziemnomorskiego krajobrazu znanego z Arma. Zamieszkane obszary tworzą suche wzgórza, mozaika pól, niewielkie osady i poszarpane wybrzeże, a dawne fortyfikacje oraz lotniska zachowują znaczenie wojskowe. Lokalna uprawa i skromna infrastruktura portowa podtrzymują kolonię, lecz nie zachował się wiarygodny spis ludności ani pełne rozpoznanie zasobów. Współczesna wartość planety wynika głównie z położenia przy podejściach do Zewnętrznych Rubieży i łatwego do obrony terenu.

en.description: Malden is a campaign adaptation of the rugged Mediterranean island terrain recorded in Arma. Dry hills, patchwork fields, small settlements and a broken coastline define its inhabited zones, while old fortifications and airfields give it continuing military value. Local agriculture and modest port infrastructure support the colony, but no reliable interstellar census or detailed resource survey survives in the campaign archive. Its modern importance comes chiefly from its position on the Outer Rim approaches and from the defensible terrain surrounding its settlements.

hut.description: Malden adapts the rugged Mediterranean terrain recorded in Arma. Dry hills, patchwork fields, small settlements, and a broken coast define its inhabited land, while old forts and airfields retain mala value. Farming and modest ports sustain the colony, but no reliable census or resource survey survives. Its greatest profit comes from a position on the Outer Rim approaches and terrain that rewards a prepared defender.

Planet.name: Keitum
Planet.description: A planet of varying hot and warm climates. Most of the planet is covered in plains and rivers. Due to the tilt of the planet the deserts that exist are located on the north pole and the only bit of snow on the south pole.

pl.description: Keitum jest światem o zróżnicowanym, przeważnie gorącym klimacie. Większość powierzchni zajmują równiny poprzecinane rzekami. Nietypowe nachylenie osi sprawia, że pustynie skupiają się wokół bieguna północnego, natomiast jedyne trwałe obszary śnieżne występują przy biegunie południowym. Ten odwrócony układ stref klimatycznych wyznacza kierunki osadnictwa i wykorzystania ziemi.

en.description: A planet of varying hot and warm climates. Most of the planet is covered in plains and rivers. Due to the tilt of the planet the deserts that exist are located on the north pole and the only bit of snow on the south pole.

hut.description: Keitum is a mostly hot world of broad plains and rivers. Its unusual axial tilt gathers deserts around the northern pole, while the only lasting snow lies in the south. This reversed climate pattern directs settlement, farming, and every practical bargain over habitable land.

Planet.name: Harvest
Planet.description: A once beautiful planet rich with rare minerals now devastated to almost all desert due to a nuclear reaction going off from a poorly maintained reactor. The inhabitants now live as nomads in the wilderness or in the old mining cities that were left over from the original mining company that controlled the planet. The cities are lucky enough to be surrounded by the last remaining plains. Now the cities have coliseums for gladiator fights so that the wealthy can stay in power.

pl.description: Harvest było niegdyś pięknym światem bogatym w rzadkie minerały. Katastrofa zaniedbanego reaktora przemieniła jednak niemal całą powierzchnię w nuklearną pustynię. Ocaleni żyją jako koczownicy albo w dawnych miastach górniczych otoczonych ostatnimi połaciami równin. W tych ośrodkach zamożne elity utrzymują wpływy między innymi poprzez widowiska gladiatorskie. Dzisiejsza gospodarka planety opiera się na pozostałościach przemysłu wydobywczego i kruchej kontroli nad nielicznymi obszarami nadającymi się do życia.

en.description: A once beautiful planet rich with rare minerals now devastated to almost all desert due to a nuclear reaction going off from a poorly maintained reactor. The inhabitants now live as nomads in the wilderness or in the old mining cities that were left over from the original mining company that controlled the planet. The cities are lucky enough to be surrounded by the last remaining plains. Now the cities have coliseums for gladiator fights so that the wealthy can stay in power.

hut.description: Harvest was once beautiful and rich in rare minerals. A neglected reactor catastrophe turned almost all of it into nuclear wasteland. Survivors roam as nomads or inhabit old mining cities beside the last plains. Wealthy bosses preserve power through gladiator games and control of remaining resources. The present economy feeds on the bones of the old mining industry and the few lands where life can still bargain with the ruin.

Planet.name: Endovar
Planet.description: A world that hosts a jedi temple. The surroundings are unknown to keep the location secret. Otherwise the planet is a jungle planet with spikey mountains poking out of the foliage.

pl.description: Endovar skrywa świątynię Jedi, a dokładne położenie jej otoczenia pozostaje tajne ze względów bezpieczeństwa. Wiadomo jedynie, że planetę porasta gęsta dżungla, ponad którą wznoszą się ostre, iglicowe góry. O wartości świata decyduje przede wszystkim chronione dziedzictwo Zakonu; zasoby, zaludnienie i rozległość osadnictwa nie zostały ujawnione w dostępnych rejestrach.

en.description: A world that hosts a jedi temple. The surroundings are unknown to keep the location secret. Otherwise the planet is a jungle planet with spikey mountains poking out of the foliage.

hut.description: Endovar hides a Jedi temple whose exact surroundings remain sealed for security. Dense jungle covers the world, broken by sharp mountains rising like spires above the foliage. Its chief value is the protected inheritance of the Order; resources, population, and settlement remain outside the public ledger.

Planet.name: Kakra
Planet.description: This is an unstable volcanic planet. Inhabitable and destructive in nature. The land is ever changing with the constantly active volcanoes.

pl.description: Kakra jest niestabilnym, lecz możliwym do zamieszkania światem wulkanicznym. Nieustannie czynne wulkany przeobrażają powierzchnię, niszcząc dawne formacje terenu i tworząc nowe. Osadnictwo wymaga ciągłego monitorowania aktywności geologicznej oraz infrastruktury zdolnej przetrwać popiół, lawę i wstrząsy. Ta sama siła natury, która zagraża mieszkańcom, może zapewniać dostęp do energii geotermalnej i świeżo odsłoniętych minerałów.

en.description: This is an unstable volcanic planet. Inhabitable and destructive in nature. The land is ever changing with the constantly active volcanoes.

hut.description: Kakra is an unstable but inhabited volcanic world. Active vents continually destroy old ground and make new land. Settlement demands constant geological watching and structures able to survive ash, lava, and quakes. The same violence that threatens the people may offer geothermal power and minerals newly exposed by the changing crust.

Planet.name: Ring of Kafrene
Planet.description: The mining complex of the Ring of Kafrene is known to many as a hub for trade along the Thrand Sector. The structure connected planetoids together which attracted many wandering travelers as well as a resting spot for known bounty hunters or secret informants.

pl.description: Pierścień Kafrene to rozległy kompleks górniczy łączący kilka planetoid. Położenie przy szlakach sektora Thrand uczyniło go ważnym ośrodkiem wymiany i odpoczynku dla wędrownych załóg. W jego portach spotykają się kupcy, łowcy nagród oraz informatorzy działający poza oficjalnym obiegiem. Wartość instalacji wynika zarówno z wydobycia, jak i z usług świadczonych podróżnym przemierzającym region.

en.description: The mining complex of the Ring of Kafrene is known to many as a hub for trade along the Thrand Sector. The structure connected planetoids together which attracted many wandering travelers as well as a resting spot for known bounty hunters or secret informants.

hut.description: The Ring of Kafrene is a mining complex joining several planetoids. Its position in the Thrand Sector makes it a trade hub and resting place for wandering crews. Merchants, bounty hunters, and quiet informants share its ports. Profit comes from both extraction and the services sold to every traveler passing through the region.

Planet.name: Guagenia
Planet.description: Guagenia is a barren planet with little vegetation. With towering sand dunes the planet is not populated and there is a lack of water to be found on the planet’s surface. The sand, however, is also mixed in with spice, a mind altering substance. Survivable conditions can be found deep within caves with sources of water and cooler temperatures than above ground.

pl.description: Guagenia jest jałowym, niemal bezwodnym światem pokrytym wysokimi wydmami i skąpą roślinnością. Powierzchnia pozostaje niezamieszkana, lecz piasek zawiera domieszkę przyprawy o właściwościach psychoaktywnych, co nadaje planecie potencjalną wartość gospodarczą. Warunki pozwalające przetrwać występują głęboko w jaskiniach, gdzie można znaleźć wodę i temperatury znacznie niższe niż na powierzchni. Każda ekspedycja musi zatem łączyć wydobycie z rozbudowanym zapleczem podziemnym.

en.description: Guagenia is a barren planet with little vegetation. With towering sand dunes the planet is not populated and there is a lack of water to be found on the planet’s surface. The sand, however, is also mixed in with spice, a mind altering substance. Survivable conditions can be found deep within caves with sources of water and cooler temperatures than above ground.

hut.description: Guagenia is a barren, nearly waterless world of towering dunes and sparse growth. Its empty surface sands carry traces of mind-altering spice, giving the planet a tempting profit. Survivable conditions exist deep in caves where water and cooler air can be found. Any mining bargain therefore depends on underground shelter and reliable access to those hidden reserves.

Planet.name: Throffdon
Planet.description: Throffdon is a planet in the Inner Rim as well as “The Interior” territories, Grid Square J-9, with no hyperspace routes attached. Throffdon is a very unique planet in that it orbits an octonary, eight, star cluster. This means that Throffdon never has a documented night, as day lasts year round for the planet. A “night” may be possible only when all eight stars are on the opposite side of the planet but even then the night would not cover the whole planet. As such Throffdon has no atmosphere and is uninhabitable to any forms of life aside from some extremophile lifeforms, like the Midi-chlorian.

pl.description: Throffdon leży w Wewnętrznych Rubieżach, w kwadracie J-9, bez bezpośredniego połączenia z trasami nadprzestrzennymi. Okrąża układ ośmiu gwiazd, dlatego na całej planecie praktycznie nie zapada udokumentowana noc. Nie posiada atmosfery i pozostaje niezdatny do zamieszkania przez znane rozwinięte formy życia; przetrwać mogą jedynie organizmy skrajnie odporne. Niezwykły układ orbitalny czyni go obiektem naukowym, lecz brak dostępu i wrogie środowisko ograniczają jego praktyczne wykorzystanie.

en.description: Throffdon is a planet in the Inner Rim as well as “The Interior” territories, Grid Square J-9, with no hyperspace routes attached. Throffdon is a very unique planet in that it orbits an octonary, eight, star cluster. This means that Throffdon never has a documented night, as day lasts year round for the planet. A “night” may be possible only when all eight stars are on the opposite side of the planet but even then the night would not cover the whole planet. As such Throffdon has no atmosphere and is uninhabitable to any forms of life aside from some extremophile lifeforms, like the Midi-chlorian.

hut.description: Throffdon lies in the Inner Rim's J-9 grid without a hyperspace lane. It circles eight stars, so a true planetwide night has never been recorded. The world has no atmosphere and cannot support known complex life, save the hardest extremophiles. Its rare orbit has scholarly value, but isolation and lethal conditions leave little immediate profit.

Planet.name: Boiyuh
Planet.description: Boiyuh is a planet in the Colonies and “The Interior” regions of the galaxy, Grid Square J-9, with no attached hyperspace lanes. Boiyuh is a planet with an atmosphere and natural water. Boiyeah is covered heavily in trees and lakes. Notably quite a peaceful planet that was until the discovery of the hallucinogen “Veil” Boiyuh quickly became known for its parties across the galaxy. Oftentimes parties would go on for months. While seen now as something bad, these parties had a notable social benefit, species from all walks of life gathered together to have fun, the rich, the poor, the powerful and the weak all gathered around the same fires. The expression “Boiyuh” widespread throughout the galaxy originates from the planet, it means a form of excitement or accomplishment.

pl.description: Boiyuh jest zalesionym i bogatym w jeziora światem Kolonii, położonym w kwadracie J-9 poza głównymi trasami. Spokojna planeta zyskała galaktyczną sławę po odkryciu halucynogenu „Veil”, który uczynił ją miejscem wielomiesięcznych festiwali. Choć później potępiano ich nadmiar, spotkania te miały niezwykłą wartość społeczną: przy wspólnych ogniskach gromadzili się bogaci i ubodzy, możni i pozbawieni wpływów. Z nazwy świata wywodzi się popularny okrzyk „Boiyuh”, wyrażający ekscytację lub poczucie dokonania.

en.description: Boiyuh is a planet in the Colonies and “The Interior” regions of the galaxy, Grid Square J-9, with no attached hyperspace lanes. Boiyuh is a planet with an atmosphere and natural water. Boiyeah is covered heavily in trees and lakes. Notably quite a peaceful planet that was until the discovery of the hallucinogen “Veil” Boiyuh quickly became known for its parties across the galaxy. Oftentimes parties would go on for months. While seen now as something bad, these parties had a notable social benefit, species from all walks of life gathered together to have fun, the rich, the poor, the powerful and the weak all gathered around the same fires. The expression “Boiyuh” widespread throughout the galaxy originates from the planet, it means a form of excitement or accomplishment.

hut.description: Boiyuh is a forest-and-lake world in the Colonies, beyond the main J-9 lanes. Discovery of the hallucinogen Veil turned the quiet planet into a galactic festival ground where parties could last for months. Though later condemned for excess, they mixed rich and poor, powerful and forgotten around the same fires. The common exclamation “Boiyuh,” meaning excitement or accomplishment, was born from the world's name.

Planet.name: Gwongdeen
Planet.description: Covered completely in a living sea of membranous biological matter which is dark red and pink in color. Underneath that sea is a rocky surface with a singular spaceport. In order to reach the true surface force fields are used to push the sea water out of the way for ships to pass through.

pl.description: Gwongdeen w całości pokrywa żywe morze błoniastej materii biologicznej o ciemnoczerwonej i różowej barwie. Pod nim znajduje się skalista właściwa powierzchnia oraz pojedynczy port kosmiczny. Statki docierają do instalacji dzięki polom siłowym, które rozchylają organiczny ocean i tworzą bezpieczny korytarz przelotu. Utrzymanie portu wymaga zatem nieprzerwanego zasilania i precyzyjnej kontroli technologicznej.

en.description: Covered completely in a living sea of membranous biological matter which is dark red and pink in color. Underneath that sea is a rocky surface with a singular spaceport. In order to reach the true surface force fields are used to push the sea water out of the way for ships to pass through.

hut.description: Gwongdeen is covered by a living sea of dark red and pink membranous matter. Beneath it lies a rocky true surface and a single spaceport. Force fields push the organic ocean aside to open a passage for ships. The port survives only through uninterrupted power and precise control of that protective technology.

Planet.name: Galagolos
Planet.description: Galagolos is a smaller planet of mostly swamps. Due to the swamps and the humidity, the planet has an awful stench that permeates everything, even through filters.

pl.description: Galagolos jest niewielkim światem zdominowanym przez mokradła. Wysoka wilgotność oraz gazy powstające w bagnach tworzą odór tak przenikliwy, że przedostaje się nawet przez systemy filtracyjne. Warunki utrudniają stałe osadnictwo, transport i pracę w terenie. Dostępne źródła nie wskazują zasobów, które równoważyłyby te niedogodności na większą skalę.

en.description: Galagolos is a smaller planet of mostly swamps. Due to the swamps and the humidity, the planet has an awful stench that permeates everything, even through filters.

hut.description: Galagolos is a small world dominated by swamps. Humidity and bog gases create a stench strong enough to defeat ordinary filters. Settlement, travel, and field work all carry this burden. Available ledgers name no great resource rich enough to make the discomfort a widely profitable bargain.

Planet.name: Quarzite
Planet.description: Quarzite is an unassuming planet of grey and violet everywhere. Though the atmosphere is so thick it causes a constant storm of lightning and heavy rain, making reaching the surface almost impossible. The only way down is through one massive turbolift. Underground, there are grand caves with a breathable atmosphere. In the caves are bright violet crystals and crystalline structures that shine brightly enough to see without the star that Quarzite orbits.

pl.description: Quarzite sprawia wrażenie szarego i fioletowego pustkowia, lecz jego niezwykle gęsta atmosfera wywołuje nieustanne burze z piorunami i ulewami, niemal odcinając powierzchnię. Jedyną pewną drogę w głąb planety zapewnia olbrzymia turbowinda. Pod ziemią rozciągają się rozległe jaskinie z atmosferą zdatną do oddychania. Fioletowe kryształy i naturalne struktury krystaliczne świecą tam tak intensywnie, że zastępują światło gwiazdy, tworząc warunki dla podziemnego osadnictwa.

en.description: Quarzite is an unassuming planet of grey and violet everywhere. Though the atmosphere is so thick it causes a constant storm of lightning and heavy rain, making reaching the surface almost impossible. The only way down is through one massive turbolift. Underground, there are grand caves with a breathable atmosphere. In the caves are bright violet crystals and crystalline structures that shine brightly enough to see without the star that Quarzite orbits.

hut.description: Quarzite appears grey and violet beneath an atmosphere so dense that lightning and heavy rain never truly cease. A single great turbolift offers reliable passage below. Vast caves contain breathable air and brilliant violet crystals whose natural light replaces the distant star. The surface denies easy access, while the underground world provides the only practical ground for settlement and profit.

Planet.name: Borosk
Planet.description: Borosk is a normal planet, but due to many invasions has become a fortress world with an exterior shield and hundreds of fortifications planet side. It has a very rocky surface with differing weather.

pl.description: Borosk był pierwotnie zwyczajnym, skalistym światem o zmiennej pogodzie. Liczne inwazje przeobraziły go jednak w planetarną twierdzę, osłoniętą zewnętrznym generatorem tarcz i setkami umocnień na powierzchni. Krajobraz podporządkowano obronie, a kolejne warstwy fortyfikacji świadczą o długiej historii zagrożeń. Znaczenie Borosku jest dziś przede wszystkim strategiczne, nie przyrodnicze.

en.description: Borosk is a normal planet, but due to many invasions has become a fortress world with an exterior shield and hundreds of fortifications planet side. It has a very rocky surface with differing weather.

hut.description: Borosk began as an ordinary rocky world with changeable weather. Repeated invasions remade it into a fortress protected by an outer shield and hundreds of surface defenses. The landscape now serves mala before nature, and every new fortification records another old threat. Its chief value is strategic rather than natural.

Planet.name: Dinwa Prime
Planet.description: Dinwa Prime is a lightly documented world whose reliable records concern later occupations rather than its condition during the Clone Wars. Republic charts confirm the planet as a settled strategic stop, but surviving sources do not establish its climate, population, principal resources or the appearance of its surface in this era. Campaign intelligence therefore treats Dinwa Prime as a known political location with an incomplete planetary survey. Its value comes from access and administration rather than any verified economic specialization.

pl.description: Dinwa Prime jest słabo udokumentowanym światem, o którym wiarygodne źródła opisują głównie późniejsze okupacje, nie zaś warunki z epoki Wojen Klonów. Mapy Republiki potwierdzają istnienie osadnictwa i strategicznego punktu tranzytowego, lecz nie określają klimatu, ludności, zasobów ani wyglądu powierzchni. Wywiad kampanii traktuje planetę jako znany ośrodek polityczny o niepełnym rozpoznaniu. Jej wartość wynika z dostępu i administracji, a nie z potwierdzonej specjalizacji gospodarczej.

en.description: Dinwa Prime is a lightly documented world whose reliable records concern later occupations rather than its condition during the Clone Wars. Republic charts confirm the planet as a settled strategic stop, but surviving sources do not establish its climate, population, principal resources or the appearance of its surface in this era. Campaign intelligence therefore treats Dinwa Prime as a known political location with an incomplete planetary survey. Its value comes from access and administration rather than any verified economic specialization.

hut.description: Dinwa Prime is poorly documented; reliable sources describe later occupations rather than its Clone Wars condition. Republica charts confirm a settled strategic stop but give no trustworthy climate, census, resource, or surface survey. Campaign intel therefore treats it as a known political location with an unfinished planetary ledger. Access and administration, not any verified industry, define its present value.

Planet.name: Bimmisaari
Planet.description: A mostly dense jungle planet with normal forests and plains. The near-humanoids that live here build their sky scraping cities amongst the few plains that exist on their planet.

high_value_targets.name: Rogue Clone
high_value_targets.title: Clone Deserter
high_value_targets.intel: Clone deserter

pl.description: Bimmisaari w większości pokrywa gęsta dżungla, przechodząca miejscami w zwyczajne lasy i nieliczne równiny. Zamieszkująca świat bliskoludzka ludność wznosi strzeliste miasta właśnie na tych rzadkich otwartych obszarach, oszczędzając trudniejsze do opanowania tereny. Rozmieszczenie osad sprawia, że równiny mają szczególną wartość gospodarczą i komunikacyjną, podczas gdy dżungle dominują w naturalnym krajobrazie planety.

en.description: A mostly dense jungle planet with normal forests and plains. The near-humanoids that live here build their sky scraping cities amongst the few plains that exist on their planet.

hut.description: Bimmisaari is mostly dense jungle, broken by common forests and rare plains. Its near-human people raise towering cities upon those scarce open lands. The plains therefore carry the greatest settlement and transport value, while jungle remains master of the planet's natural landscape.

Planet.name: Janix
Planet.description: A blue world with dense cities scattered across the surface. The main attraction of this planet is Janix City, which is built inside of a crater with towering sky scrapers and gangsters around every corner.

pl.description: Janix to błękitny świat, na którego powierzchni rozproszyły się gęsto zabudowane miasta. Najważniejszym ośrodkiem jest Janix City, wzniesione wewnątrz olbrzymiego krateru i zdominowane przez strzeliste wieżowce. Miasto przyciąga handel i ludność, lecz jego zaułki pozostają pod silnym wpływem organizacji przestępczych. Kontrast między imponującą zabudową a wszechobecną działalnością gangów określa reputację całej planety.

en.description: A blue world with dense cities scattered across the surface. The main attraction of this planet is Janix City, which is built inside of a crater with towering sky scrapers and gangsters around every corner.

hut.description: Janix is a blue world dotted with dense cities. Its great attraction is Janix City, built inside a crater beneath towering structures. Trade and people gather there, but gangs hold influence around every corner. The planet's reputation rests on the bargain between magnificent urban wealth and organized crime.

Planet.name: Kotab
Planet.description: Kotab is a warm world of jungles and deserts and the home world of the bald Kotabi. The population lives in pyramid shaped stone buildings and are loyal to their King who possesses ancient Sith artifacts now deemed just symbols of his authority.

high_value_targets.name: King Koag
high_value_targets.title: King
high_value_targets.intel: The Koabi King of Kotab the Jedi considers him tainted by Sith artifacts.

pl.description: Kotab jest ciepłym światem dżungli i pustyń oraz ojczyzną łysych Kotabich. Ludność zamieszkuje kamienne budowle o piramidalnych kształtach i pozostaje wierna monarchii. Król przechowuje starożytne artefakty Sithów, które z czasem utraciły pierwotne znaczenie i funkcjonują przede wszystkim jako insygnia jego władzy. Tradycja, architektura i królewski autorytet silniej kształtują planetę niż słabo udokumentowana gospodarka.

en.description: Kotab is a warm world of jungles and deserts and the home world of the bald Kotabi. The population lives in pyramid shaped stone buildings and are loyal to their King who possesses ancient Sith artifacts now deemed just symbols of his authority.

hut.description: Kotab is a warm world of jungle and desert, home to the bald Kotabi. Its people live in pyramid-shaped stone buildings and remain loyal to their king. The monarch keeps ancient Sith artifacts now treated chiefly as symbols of authority. Tradition, architecture, and royal power shape the world more than any poorly recorded economy.

Planet.name: Rajtiri
Planet.description: An arid world of ancient buildings, colossal pavilions, and elaborate mausoleums. Rajtiri is a smuggling hub with a thriving black market. Powerful families profit from the smuggling. As part of the republic they are only proof of how corrupt it is.

pl.description: Rajtiri jest suchym światem starożytnych budowli, kolosalnych pawilonów i kunsztownych mauzoleów. Położenie oraz rozbudowane kontakty uczyniły planetę znaczącym węzłem przemytu i czarnego rynku. Najpotężniejsze rody czerpią z tych sieci ogromne zyski, umacniając wpływy zarówno gospodarcze, jak i polityczne. Choć Rajtiri formalnie należy do Republiki, jego funkcjonowanie stanowi wymowny przykład korupcji podważającej republikańskie instytucje.

en.description: An arid world of ancient buildings, colossal pavilions, and elaborate mausoleums. Rajtiri is a smuggling hub with a thriving black market. Powerful families profit from the smuggling. As part of the republic they are only proof of how corrupt it is.

hut.description: Rajtiri is an arida world of ancient buildings, colossal pavilions, and elaborate tombs. Smuggling and shadow trade make it a busy market, enriching powerful families that turn credits into political pull. The planet formally belongs to Republica, yet its prosperity is also a sharp entry in the ledger of Republic corruption.

Planet.name: Basthata
Planet.description: Due to the super red giant as the planet’s sun, everything on the surface is super heated and charred. As such any life that does exist lives underground in massive cave formations that were either drilled or formed by lava.

pl.description: Basthata krąży wokół czerwonego nadolbrzyma, którego żar przegrzewa i zwęgla powierzchnię. Życie może przetrwać wyłącznie głęboko pod ziemią, w olbrzymich systemach jaskiń wydrążonych sztucznie albo uformowanych przez lawę. Osadnictwo zależy od ochrony przed promieniowaniem i temperaturą, a każda infrastruktura powierzchniowa wymaga wyjątkowo odpornej konstrukcji. Podziemia stanowią zarazem schronienie, przestrzeń mieszkalną i jedyne trwałe zaplecze planety.

en.description: Due to the super red giant as the planet’s sun, everything on the surface is super heated and charred. As such any life that does exist lives underground in massive cave formations that were either drilled or formed by lava.

hut.description: Basthata circles a red supergiant whose heat scorches the surface. Life survives only far below in immense caverns drilled by inhabitants or carved by lava. Settlement depends on protection from heat and radiation, while surface machinery must endure extreme punishment. The underground is shelter, living space, and the planet's only lasting koona.

Planet.name: Tehar
Planet.description: Tehar is an obscure terrestrial world in the Mid Rim near the frontier of the Unknown Regions. A human community known as the Teharans maintains at least one village and an old temple connected with traditions of the Force. Canon sources do not describe a planetary climate, census or notable export during the Clone Wars, so those details remain unknown. The world is quiet and poorly represented on common navigation charts, with its historical importance resting on its isolated settlement and ancient religious site rather than a documented large-scale economy.

pl.description: Tehar jest mało znanym światem skalistym w Środkowych Rubieżach, nieopodal granicy Nieznanych Regionów. Ludzka społeczność Teharan utrzymuje co najmniej jedną wioskę i dawną świątynię powiązaną z tradycjami Mocy. Źródła kanoniczne nie opisują klimatu, spisu ludności ani znaczącego eksportu w okresie Wojen Klonów, dlatego dane te pozostają nieznane. Znaczenie planety wynika z odosobnionej osady i starożytnego miejsca kultu, nie z udokumentowanej gospodarki wielkiej skali.

en.description: Tehar is an obscure terrestrial world in the Mid Rim near the frontier of the Unknown Regions. A human community known as the Teharans maintains at least one village and an old temple connected with traditions of the Force. Canon sources do not describe a planetary climate, census or notable export during the Clone Wars, so those details remain unknown. The world is quiet and poorly represented on common navigation charts, with its historical importance resting on its isolated settlement and ancient religious site rather than a documented large-scale economy.

hut.description: Tehar is an obscure terrestrial world in the Mid Rim near the Unknown Regions frontier. A human Teharan community maintains at least one village and an old temple tied to traditions of the Force. Canon records give no reliable Clone Wars climate, census, or export. Its value lies in the isolated settlement and ancient sacred site, not in any known great economy.

Planet.name: Iberius
Planet.description: Iberius is a campaign world whose documented surface is dominated by dense vegetation and whose local census records roughly two million inhabitants. The available archive does not identify a canonical counterpart or confirm major exports, extractive deposits or a distinctive manufacturing tradition. Settlements are therefore described as dispersed among broad living landscapes rather than as the refineries shown in the previous mismatched entry. Its earlier political history remains incomplete. In the present campaign Iberius matters as a populated UNSC position in the Mid Rim, supported by its mapped routes and natural cover.

pl.description: Iberius jest światem kampanii o powierzchni zdominowanej przez gęstą roślinność i ludności liczącej około dwóch milionów mieszkańców. Archiwa nie wskazują kanonicznego odpowiednika ani nie potwierdzają znaczącego eksportu, złóż czy szczególnej tradycji przemysłowej. Osady są rozproszone pośród rozległych żywych krajobrazów, a wcześniejsza historia polityczna pozostaje niepełna. W bieżącej kampanii Iberius ma znaczenie jako zaludniona pozycja UNSC w Środkowych Rubieżach, wsparta siecią tras i naturalną osłoną terenu.

en.description: Iberius is a campaign world whose documented surface is dominated by dense vegetation and whose local census records roughly two million inhabitants. The available archive does not identify a canonical counterpart or confirm major exports, extractive deposits or a distinctive manufacturing tradition. Settlements are therefore described as dispersed among broad living landscapes rather than as the refineries shown in the previous mismatched entry. Its earlier political history remains incomplete. In the present campaign Iberius matters as a populated UNSC position in the Mid Rim, supported by its mapped routes and natural cover.

hut.description: Iberius is a campaign world of dense vegetation and roughly two million residents. The archive confirms no canonical counterpart, major export, rich deposit, or distinct manufacturing tradition. Settlements lie scattered through broad living landscapes, while earlier political history remains incomplete. In the campaign, the planet matters as a populated UNSC position in the Mid Rim, strengthened by mapped routes and natural cover.

Planet.name: Circumtore
Planet.description: This planetoid is in the shape of a ring. With the “planet” surface being on the inside of that ring. The Hutts have control and inhabit this ring-shaped artificial planet. It has every biome that we know of perfectly spaced throughout the ring. Its gravity is artificially made through centripetal force. The ring provides a space for life to grow on its surface to make a breathable atmosphere, but beneath is complex technology that sustains the ring.

pl.description: Circumtore jest sztucznym planetoidem w kształcie pierścienia, którego zamieszkana powierzchnia znajduje się po stronie wewnętrznej. Kontrolowany przez Huttów obiekt zawiera starannie rozmieszczone strefy odpowiadające wszystkim znanym biomom. Sztuczna grawitacja powstaje dzięki sile odśrodkowej, a roślinność na powierzchni podtrzymuje atmosferę zdatną do oddychania. Pod warstwą życia kryje się jednak złożona infrastruktura technologiczna, od której zależy trwałość całego pierścienia i bezpieczeństwo jego mieszkańców.

en.description: This planetoid is in the shape of a ring. With the “planet” surface being on the inside of that ring. The Hutts have control and inhabit this ring-shaped artificial planet. It has every biome that we know of perfectly spaced throughout the ring. Its gravity is artificially made through centripetal force. The ring provides a space for life to grow on its surface to make a breathable atmosphere, but beneath is complex technology that sustains the ring.

hut.description: Circumtore is an artificial ring-world with its inhabited surface on the inside. Hutt control extends across carefully spaced examples of every known biome. Rotation creates gravity, and surface life sustains breathable air. Beneath that living skin lies the complex machinery keeping the ring whole. Whoever controls this hidden koona controls every breath, field, and city above it.

Planet.name: Cyrillia
Planet.description: An industrialized planet solely focused upon making the DUM-series pit droid.

pl.description: Cyrillia jest wysoko uprzemysłowionym światem niemal całkowicie podporządkowanym produkcji droidów technicznych serii DUM. Zakłady, logistyka i miejscowe kompetencje rozwijano wokół jednej specjalizacji, co zapewnia wielką wydajność, lecz uzależnia gospodarkę od popytu na ten konkretny model. Planeta pełni rolę wyspecjalizowanego zaplecza przemysłowego, a jej znaczenie rośnie wszędzie tam, gdzie potrzebne są proste i masowo dostępne jednostki obsługowe.

en.description: An industrialized planet solely focused upon making the DUM-series pit droid.

hut.description: Cyrillia is an industrial world devoted almost entirely to DUM-series pit droids. Factories, cargo systems, and skilled labor all serve this single product. The arrangement yields great efficiency but ties the economy to demand for one model. Its profit rises wherever cheap, common maintenance droids are needed in large numbers.

Planet.name: Espirion
Planet.description: A pale blue planet with only one city on it. The city was made of softly curving white buildings.

pl.description: Espirion jest bladoniebieskim światem posiadającym tylko jedno miasto. Jego zabudowę tworzą łagodnie wygięte, białe konstrukcje, które nadają osadzie jednolity i niemal ceremonialny wygląd. Brak innych ośrodków sprawia, że cała administracja, handel i życie społeczne planety skupiają się w tym pojedynczym mieście.

en.description: A pale blue planet with only one city on it. The city was made of softly curving white buildings.

hut.description: Espirion is a pale blue world with one city of softly curved white buildings. With no rival settlement, administration, trade, and social life gather in that single urban center. The city's clean form is both the planet's identity and its entire practical koona.

Planet.name: Erebus
Planet.description: Erebus is in the Colonies regions of the Galaxy, Grid Square N-13, with no major trade route attached. A terrestrial planet with a breathable atmosphere, it is a mountainous and muddy world, featuring lakes and canyons. As well as a persisting fog that encapsules the planet. The planet was known for its valuable resources not taken advantage of by any major faction in the Galaxy.

pl.description: Erebus leży w Koloniach, w kwadracie N-13, poza głównymi szlakami handlowymi. To górzysty i błotnisty świat o zdatnej do oddychania atmosferze, poprzecinany jeziorami i kanionami oraz stale spowity mgłą. Znajdują się tam cenne, lecz dotąd niewykorzystywane na wielką skalę zasoby. Brak zainteresowania najważniejszych frakcji zachował ich potencjał, ale również ograniczył rozwój infrastruktury.

en.description: Erebus is in the Colonies regions of the Galaxy, Grid Square N-13, with no major trade route attached. A terrestrial planet with a breathable atmosphere, it is a mountainous and muddy world, featuring lakes and canyons. As well as a persisting fog that encapsules the planet. The planet was known for its valuable resources not taken advantage of by any major faction in the Galaxy.

hut.description: Erebus lies in the Colonies' N-13 grid away from major trade lanes. Mountains, mud, lakes, canyons, and lasting fog cover its breathable world. Valuable resources remain largely untouched by the great powers. That neglect preserves future profit but leaves little infrastructure to claim it.

Planet.name: Triffis
Planet.description: Triffis is home to the sentient humanoid Triffians. Their home planet is a forest world with overgrown trees. They were some of the first to start forming advanced technology. Their short stature led them to make quick ground vehicles. Some were adapted to be pod racers.

pl.description: Triffis jest leśną ojczyzną rozumnych, humanoidalnych Triffian. Przerośnięte drzewa dominują w krajobrazie, a niewielki wzrost mieszkańców wpłynął na kierunek rozwoju techniki. Triffianie należeli do wczesnych twórców zaawansowanych rozwiązań, szczególnie szybkich pojazdów naziemnych. Część tych konstrukcji przystosowano później do wyścigów ścigaczy, łącząc praktyczną inżynierię z widowiskowym sportem.

en.description: Triffis is home to the sentient humanoid Triffians. Their home planet is a forest world with overgrown trees. They were some of the first to start forming advanced technology. Their short stature led them to make quick ground vehicles. Some were adapted to be pod racers.

hut.description: Triffis is the overgrown forest home of the short humanoid Triffians. Among the early makers of advanced technology, they turned their stature into an advantage by building fast ground vehicles. Some designs became podracers, joining useful engineering with a profitable and dangerous spectacle.

Planet.name: Arkanis
Planet.description: Arkanis is a temperate planet with a comfortable atmosphere. It's known to be very rainy and flourishing with life. As well as large mountain ranges and deep seas. The settlements are very industrialized due to the Techno Union's influence on the planet. Military complexes and orbital defense platforms sprawl the planet's urban areas.

pl.description: Arkanis jest umiarkowanym, deszczowym światem o bogatej biosferze, rozległych pasmach górskich i głębokich morzach. Wpływy Unii Technokratycznej doprowadziły do silnego uprzemysłowienia osad. Kompleksy wojskowe i orbitalne platformy obronne otaczają obszary miejskie, nadając planecie znaczenie produkcyjne oraz strategiczne. Naturalne bogactwo współistnieje tu z ciężką infrastrukturą podporządkowaną interesom Konfederacji.

en.description: Arkanis is a temperate planet with a comfortable atmosphere. It's known to be very rainy and flourishing with life. As well as large mountain ranges and deep seas. The settlements are very industrialized due to the Techno Union's influence on the planet. Military complexes and orbital defense platforms sprawl the planet's urban areas.

hut.description: Arkanis is a rainy mild-world rich in life, mountain ranges, and deep seas. Techno Union influence industrialized its settlements, spreading military complexes and orbital defense platforms around the cities. Natural wealth and heavy Confederacy koona now share the same ground.

Planet.name: Savareen
Planet.description: Savareen is a world of sandy dunes and massive oceans, with the vocational ramshackle town made of scrap parts from various ships. It is host to the infamous Crimson Dawn mercenary group who will fight for the highest bidder but will also attack anyone not willing to pay them. The world also serves as a smuggling hub with a thriving black market willing to engage in many forbidden trades. Most of its inhabitants are wanted in the Republic.

pl.description: Savareen łączy piaszczyste wydmy z ogromnymi oceanami i prowizorycznymi osadami wzniesionymi ze szczątków statków. Działa tu niesławny Szkarłatny Świt, oferujący przemoc najwyżej płacącemu i wymuszający opłaty na tych, którzy odmawiają współpracy. Świat stanowi również ważny ośrodek przemytu oraz czarnego rynku. Wielu mieszkańców figuruje w rejestrach poszukiwanych Republiki, a miejscowa gospodarka opiera się na usługach poza prawem.

en.description: Savareen is a world of sandy dunes and massive oceans, with the vocational ramshackle town made of scrap parts from various ships. It is host to the infamous Crimson Dawn mercenary group who will fight for the highest bidder but will also attack anyone not willing to pay them. The world also serves as a smuggling hub with a thriving black market willing to engage in many forbidden trades. Most of its inhabitants are wanted in the Republic.

hut.description: Savareen mixes dunes, great oceans, and rough towns built from ship scrap. Crimson Dawn sells violence to the highest bidder and attacks those who refuse its price. Smuggling and shadow trade sustain the world, while many residents sit on Republica wanted lists. Law is weak; contracts and fear keep business moving.

Planet.name: Sevarcos II
Planet.description: This planet was the only inhabitable planet in the Severcos System, and the only source for the Spice variants, Carsunum and Andris. At the time jedi Master Dooku was responsible for the resolution of the Sevarcos Dispute. The planet is conquered by vast plains in brown and amber shades with a dry and rugged temperature. The northern hemisphere was mountainous and jagged, the center belt of the planet was vast plains, and the south was dominated by harsh winds and sandstorms that shaped the terrain. The planet gained the nickname of “The World of Endless Wind” due to the gale force around certain annual equinoxes. Comparatively to Tatooine, the planet was measurably hot during the day, and cool at night. Underground was a haven of sorts rich with networks of rivers, lakes and pools which made for loads of flora and fauna to prosper, to include burrowing sandworms named spice eels. The planet was also home to spice mining, slavery, and six star ports. The Separatists hold two of these Star ports, and the rest are dominated by the spice slavers of the Sevari Society. Hundreds of spice mines dotted the planet using slave labor to feed and fund the main and only exportable goods of the planet.

pl.description: Sevarcos II jest jedynym zdatnym do życia światem układu i wyłącznym źródłem odmian przyprawy Carsunum oraz Andris. Brunatne równiny, poszarpane góry północy i południowe burze piaskowe przyniosły mu miano „Świata Nieskończonego Wiatru”. Pod powierzchnią kryją się rzeki, jeziora i bogata biosfera, w tym węgorze przyprawowe. Setki kopalń korzystają z pracy niewolniczej. Dwa z sześciu portów kontrolują Separatyści, pozostałe zaś handlarze niewolników ze Stowarzyszenia Sevari.

The planet was also home to spice mining, slavery, and six star ports. The Separatists hold two of these Star ports, and the rest are dominated by the spice slavers of the Sevari Society. Hundreds of spice mines dotted the planet using slave labor to feed and fund the main and only exportable goods of the planet.

hut.description: Sevarcos II is its system's only habitable world and sole source of Carsunum and Andris spice. Brown plains, jagged northern mountains, and southern sandstorms earned it the name World of Endless Wind. Underground rivers support rich life and spice eels. Hundreds of slave-worked mines feed six starports: two held by Separatistas, the rest by Sevari spice slavers.

Planet.name: Kabal
Planet.description: The Trade Federation abandoned the planet of Kabal and its entire Trade Corridor in protest of Galactic Republic taxation, so the planet fell into deep food shortage riots. The Separatist, using this for momentum, seized the opportunity to win the planet over to their allegiance by air dropping in food supplies. A massive riot broke out and four Jedi were killed, as well as Premiere Jan Dovu, the Planet’s leader. The planet itself features lots of quiet, coastal finishing towns, large forested islands, and an array of aquatic life. The Capital city of Shoribus is home to the Kabal Central Citadel, which is where the four Jedi were killed in the riots of 22 BBY.

pl.description: Kabal pogrążył się w kryzysie po wycofaniu Federacji Handlowej z całego korytarza w proteście przeciw podatkom Republiki. Niedobory żywności wywołały zamieszki, które Separatyści wykorzystali, zrzucając zaopatrzenie i zdobywając poparcie. W walkach zginęło czterech Jedi oraz premier Jan Dovu. Sama planeta słynie z cichych nadmorskich osad, zalesionych wysp i bogatego życia wodnego. Stolica Shoribus mieści Centralną Cytadelę Kabal, miejsce tragicznych wydarzeń.

en.description: The Trade Federation abandoned the planet of Kabal and its entire Trade Corridor in protest of Galactic Republic taxation, so the planet fell into deep food shortage riots. The Separatist, using this for momentum, seized the opportunity to win the planet over to their allegiance by air dropping in food supplies. A massive riot broke out and four Jedi were killed, as well as Premiere Jan Dovu, the Planet’s leader. The planet itself features lots of quiet, coastal finishing towns, large forested islands, and an array of aquatic life. The Capital city of Shoribus is home to the Kabal Central Citadel, which is where the four Jedi were killed in the riots of 22 BBY.

hut.description: Kabal fell into food riots after Trade Federation abandoned its corridor over Republica taxes. Separatistas bought support by dropping supplies into the crisis. Four Jedi and Premier Jan Dovu died in the violence. Beyond politics, the world holds quiet fishing towns, forest islands, and rich seas. Shoribus and its Central Citadel remain the center of the tragedy.

Planet.name: Kooriva
Planet.description: An orange tropical world and current home world of the Koorivar. It is a key world of the Corporate Alliance and CIS as such it is host to large corporate compounds. It is also home to Magistrate Passel Argente who lives in the largest compound in the world and known to host a variety of exotic plants from across the Galaxy in his garden.

high_value_targets.name: Magistrate Passel Argente
high_value_targets.title: Koorivar leader of Corporate Alliance
high_value_targets.intel: One the most important members of the CIS and has an appropriate body guard for someone of his status. He lives in the largest and most fortified corporate compound in the world.

pl.description: Kooriva jest pomarańczowym światem tropikalnym i ojczyzną Koorivarów. Jako kluczowy ośrodek Sojuszu Korporacyjnego oraz CIS mieści rozległe kompleksy należące do wielkich przedsiębiorstw. Największą posiadłość zajmuje magistrat Passel Argente. Jego rezydencję otacza ogród gromadzący egzotyczne rośliny z całej galaktyki, będący zarazem demonstracją bogactwa i wpływów korporacyjnej elity.

en.description: An orange tropical world and current home world of the Koorivar. It is a key world of the Corporate Alliance and CIS as such it is host to large corporate compounds. It is also home to Magistrate Passel Argente who lives in the largest compound in the world and known to host a variety of exotic plants from across the Galaxy in his garden.

hut.description: Kooriva is an orange tropica world and Koorivar homeworld. Corporate Alliance and CIS interests fill it with immense private compounds. Magistrate Passel Argente controls the largest estate, whose garden collects exotic plants from across the galaxy. It is both luxury and a public display of corporate power.

Planet.name: Farstine
Planet.description: Farstine is a world loyal to the Republic, with a methane atmosphere that requires all locals to wear gas masks. Other than its toxic atmosphere, it is a bleak temperate world with mountains, plains, and oceans. Farstine is also home to many grey, metallic industrial cities and spaceports. Every settlement consists of interconnected, sealed buildings designed to keep out the hostile atmosphere.

high_value_targets.name: Marath Vooro
high_value_targets.title: Nemodian Customs Vizier
high_value_targets.intel: Unlike most members of the trade federation he prefers hit and run tactics. He excels at raids and guerrilla warfare.

pl.description: Farstine pozostaje lojalnym światem Republiki, lecz jego metanowa atmosfera zmusza mieszkańców do noszenia masek oddechowych. Poza toksycznym powietrzem planeta ma surowy, umiarkowany krajobraz gór, równin i oceanów. Szare, metaliczne miasta przemysłowe oraz porty kosmiczne składają się ze szczelnie połączonych budynków, zaprojektowanych tak, by całkowicie odizolować ludność od wrogiego środowiska.

en.description: Farstine is a world loyal to the Republic, with a methane atmosphere that requires all locals to wear gas masks. Other than its toxic atmosphere, it is a bleak temperate world with mountains, plains, and oceans. Farstine is also home to many grey, metallic industrial cities and spaceports. Every settlement consists of interconnected, sealed buildings designed to keep out the hostile atmosphere.

hut.description: Farstine is loyal to Republica, but its methane air forces every local to wear a mask. Mountains, plains, and oceans surround grey industrial cities and spaceports. Each settlement is a chain of sealed buildings built to keep the hostile atmosphere outside. Survival and industry depend on the same airtight koona.

Planet.name: Inusagi
Planet.description: The planet Inusagi’s natural beauty reflected itself upon the peoples’ traditional values and wealth. The lush forests and sparkling rivers that formed into brilliant lakes all played a part in the culture of the people on Inusagi representing their nobility. As the planet lies next to wealthy planets, like Naboo, its economy was able to thrive through exports within the protected trade routes of the Republic.

pl.description: Inusagi zawdzięcza swą kulturę bujnym lasom, lśniącym rzekom i jeziorom, które mieszkańcy utożsamiają ze szlachetnością i tradycyjnymi wartościami. Bliskość zamożnych światów, w tym Naboo, umożliwiła rozwój eksportu przez chronione szlaki Republiki. Naturalne piękno stało się równocześnie symbolem społecznym i podstawą dobrobytu, łącząc miejscową tożsamość z handlem regionalnym.

en.description: The planet Inusagi’s natural beauty reflected itself upon the peoples’ traditional values and wealth. The lush forests and sparkling rivers that formed into brilliant lakes all played a part in the culture of the people on Inusagi representing their nobility. As the planet lies next to wealthy planets, like Naboo, its economy was able to thrive through exports within the protected trade routes of the Republic.

hut.description: Inusagi's forests, shining rivers, and brilliant lakes shape a culture that equates natural beauty with nobility. Nearby wealthy worlds, including Naboo, provide export markets along protected Republica routes. Landscape, status, and trade form one profitable tradition.

Planet.name: Socorro
Planet.description: Socorro is a mostly human occupied hot arid planet with black sandy deserts, some volcanoes, and the occasional city. It is a smuggling hub with a thriving black market, and home to many nomadic tribes. It also hosts a remote Jedi Academy that trains Jedi Guardians making it vital to the Jedi.

pl.description: Socorro jest gorącym, suchym światem o czarnych pustyniach, aktywnych wulkanach i nielicznych miastach, zamieszkanym głównie przez ludzi oraz plemiona koczownicze. Rozwinięty przemyt i czarny rynek czynią go ważnym ośrodkiem działalności poza prawem. W odległym rejonie działa również Akademia Jedi szkoląca Strażników, co nadaje planecie szczególne znaczenie dla Zakonu mimo jej przestępczej reputacji.

en.description: Socorro is a mostly human occupied hot arid planet with black sandy deserts, some volcanoes, and the occasional city. It is a smuggling hub with a thriving black market, and home to many nomadic tribes. It also hosts a remote Jedi Academy that trains Jedi Guardians making it vital to the Jedi.

hut.description: Socorro is a hot arida world of black sand, volcanoes, rare cities, and nomad tribes. Smuggling and shadow markets bring steady profit. Far from those trades stands a remote Jedi Academy training Guardians, giving the world sacred value to the Order despite its criminal reputation.

Planet.name: Orto Plutonia
Planet.description: A snowy desolate world that the nearby Pantorans lay claim to. As such it is host to a Republic outpost to deter any CIS presence although it might be angering the local primitives instead.

pl.description: Orto Plutonia jest śnieżnym, pozornie opustoszałym światem, do którego prawa roszczą sobie pobliscy Pantoranie. Republika utrzymuje tam posterunek mający odstraszać obecność CIS. Rozmieszczenie wojsk może jednak naruszać terytorium miejscowej, słabo poznanej ludności i zaostrzać konflikt, którego zewnętrzne mocarstwa nie rozumieją w pełni. Znaczenie planety jest zatem bardziej polityczne i strategiczne niż gospodarcze.

en.description: A snowy desolate world that the nearby Pantorans lay claim to. As such it is host to a Republic outpost to deter any CIS presence although it might be angering the local primitives instead.

hut.description: Orto Plutonia is a snowy, seemingly empty world claimed by nearby Pantorans. Republica keeps an outpost there to deter CIS, but the garrison may be angering a poorly understood native people. The planet offers little known profit; its value and danger lie in politics, territory, and military presence.

Planet.name: Pantora
Planet.description: Pantora is an arid and marshy world characterized by its cities with colorful doomed buildings. The world is a loyal member of the republic but is under constant threat from the Separatists who had tried every dirty trick to get them to join the CIS.

high_value_targets.name: Baron Notluwiski Papanoida
high_value_targets.title: Pantoran Chairman
high_value_targets.intel: He has constantly been threatened by the CIS in an effort to blackmail him into joining the CIS. We can not let him get into their hands.

pl.description: Pantora jest światem suchym i miejscami podmokłym, rozpoznawalnym dzięki miastom pełnym kolorowych, kopulastych budowli. Pozostaje wiernym członkiem Republiki, lecz stale doświadcza nacisku Separatystów, którzy wykorzystują propagandę, presję i zakulisowe działania, aby skłonić planetę do zmiany strony. Lojalność Pantory ma więc znaczenie zarówno polityczne, jak i strategiczne.

en.description: Pantora is an arid and marshy world characterized by its cities with colorful doomed buildings. The world is a loyal member of the republic but is under constant threat from the Separatists who had tried every dirty trick to get them to join the CIS.

hut.description: Pantora combines arida land and marshes beneath cities of colorful domes. It remains loyal to Republica despite constant Separatista pressure, propaganda, and hidden schemes meant to force a change of allegiance. Its loyalty is therefore both political value and strategic prize.

Planet.name: Yerbana
Planet.description: The terrestrial body consisted of mountains, oceans, vegetation and deep canyons. The diverse ecosystem allowed for life to thrive on Yerbana. Plus, it was on the Correlian Run trade route allowing for its economy to prosper. Their cities often were placed in high elevations allowing their towers to pierce permanent clouds.

pl.description: Yerbana posiada góry, oceany, głębokie kaniony i zróżnicowaną roślinność, tworząc środowisko sprzyjające bogatemu życiu. Położenie przy Koreliańskim Szlaku zapewnia gospodarce stały dopływ handlu. Miasta wznoszono na dużych wysokościach, dzięki czemu ich wieże przebijają trwałą warstwę chmur. Naturalne walory i dostęp do trasy czynią z planety zarówno atrakcyjne miejsce osadnictwa, jak i ważny punkt gospodarczy.

en.description: The terrestrial body consisted of mountains, oceans, vegetation and deep canyons. The diverse ecosystem allowed for life to thrive on Yerbana. Plus, it was on the Correlian Run trade route allowing for its economy to prosper. Their cities often were placed in high elevations allowing their towers to pierce permanent clouds.

hut.description: Yerbana holds mountains, oceans, deep canyons, and rich life. Position on the Corellian Run feeds its economy with passing trade. Cities occupy high ground, their towers piercing permanent clouds. Natural wealth and route access make the world both desirable land and valuable market.

Planet.name: Rugosa
Planet.description: A temperate moon that used to be a vast ocean, now dried up leaving the surface covered in large forests of coral and rocky cavernous areas. Home to King Katuunko of the Toydarian People. The Toydarians are unsure what side to join in the Clone War at this time. Young Neebray also use this moon as a nursery before embarking on a long migration across space.

high_value_targets.name: T Series Tactical Droid
high_value_targets.title: Tactical Lead
high_value_targets.intel: Controlling a droid element on the ground.

high_value_targets.name: B-1 Droid Commander
high_value_targets.title: Commander
high_value_targets.intel: Commanding droid on the ground.

pl.description: Rugosa jest umiarkowanym księżycem, który niegdyś pokrywał rozległy ocean. Po jego wyschnięciu pozostały lasy skamieniałych koralowców i skaliste jaskinie. Rezyduje tu toydariański król Katuunko, a jego lud wciąż rozważa, po której stronie Wojen Klonów stanąć. Młode Neebray wykorzystują księżyc jako miejsce rozwoju przed długą migracją przez przestrzeń, nadając Rugosie dodatkowe znaczenie przyrodnicze.

en.description: A temperate moon that used to be a vast ocean, now dried up leaving the surface covered in large forests of coral and rocky cavernous areas. Home to King Katuunko of the Toydarian People. The Toydarians are unsure what side to join in the Clone War at this time. Young Neebray also use this moon as a nursery before embarking on a long migration across space.

hut.description: Rugosa is a mild moon once covered by ocean. Its dry surface now carries coral forests and rocky caverns. Toydarian King Katuunko resides there while his people weigh both sides of the Clone Mala. Young Neebray also use the moon as a nursery before their long migration through space.

Planet.name: Marleyvane
Planet.description: A forest asteroid too small to be called a planet. This rock hosts a shipyard. It hosts diverse alien fauna as well as long winding rivers. The wildlife of this planet is very docile and its land is very fertile for agriculture.

pl.description: Marleyvane jest zalesioną asteroidą zbyt małą, by uznać ją za planetę. Mimo rozmiaru mieści stocznię, kręte rzeki, urodzajne tereny i zróżnicowaną faunę. Miejscowe zwierzęta są przeważnie łagodne, a gleba sprzyja rolnictwu. Połączenie zaplecza okrętowego i zasobnego środowiska czyni z asteroidy nietypowy, samowystarczalny punkt logistyczny.

en.description: A forest asteroid too small to be called a planet. This rock hosts a shipyard. It hosts diverse alien fauna as well as long winding rivers. The wildlife of this planet is very docile and its land is very fertile for agriculture.

hut.description: Marleyvane is a forest asteroid too small for planet status. It still holds a shipyard, winding rivers, fertile ground, and varied docile wildlife. Agriculture and naval service share the same small habitat, making it an unusual and partly self-sufficient logistics post.

Planet.name: Baroonda
Planet.description: A planet of gorgeous beach lines and mild forests. Waterfalls and palm trees line every beach. Baroonda is known for its podracing tracks.

pl.description: Baroonda słynie z malowniczych wybrzeży, łagodnych lasów, wodospadów i palm rosnących wzdłuż plaż. Naturalne walory uczyniły planetę popularnym miejscem wypoczynku, lecz galaktyczną rozpoznawalność przyniosły jej przede wszystkim tory wyścigów ścigaczy. Turystyka i widowiskowy sport stanowią najważniejsze filary miejscowej gospodarki.

en.description: A planet of gorgeous beach lines and mild forests. Waterfalls and palm trees line every beach. Baroonda is known for its podracing tracks.

hut.description: Baroonda offers beautiful coasts, mild forests, waterfalls, and palm-lined beaches. Pleasure travel supports the world, but podracing tracks brought its galactic fame. Tourism and dangerous spectacle remain the two chief sources of local profit.

Planet.name: Toshara
Planet.description: Toshara is a wind swept arid planet. The strong winds have eroded most of the landscape features, making it mostly flat. There are also massive canyons with an amber-like substance called amberine that flows like lava.

pl.description: Toshara jest suchym światem nieustannie smaganym silnym wiatrem, który wyrównał znaczną część krajobrazu. Wyjątek stanowią olbrzymie kaniony, gdzie występuje bursztynowa substancja zwana amberiną, płynąca niczym lawa. Surowe warunki utrudniają osadnictwo, lecz niezwykły materiał może mieć znaczenie gospodarcze i badawcze.

en.description: Toshara is a wind swept arid planet. The strong winds have eroded most of the landscape features, making it mostly flat. There are also massive canyons with an amber-like substance called amberine that flows like lava.

hut.description: Toshara is an arida world scoured nearly flat by constant wind. Great canyons remain, carrying amberine, an amber-like substance that flows like lava. The climate punishes settlement, but the strange material offers possible scientific and market value.

Planet.name: Boonta
Planet.description: A devastated desert world of nothing but dust. In orbit there is a scarp yard for spaceships to be repaired. Here the Hutts started their famous pod-racing.

pl.description: Boonta jest zdewastowanym światem pustynnym, którego powierzchnię pokrywa niemal wyłącznie pył. Na orbicie działa złomowisko i warsztat naprawczy dla statków kosmicznych. To właśnie tutaj Huttowie zapoczątkowali słynne wyścigi ścigaczy, nadając jałowej planecie trwałe znaczenie kulturowe i rozrywkowe mimo ubogiego środowiska.

en.description: A devastated desert world of nothing but dust. In orbit there is a scarp yard for spaceships to be repaired. Here the Hutts started their famous pod-racing.

hut.description: Boonta is a devastated dust-world with little upon its surface. An orbital scrapyard repairs starships above it. The Hutts began their famous podracing here, turning a barren place into a lasting symbol of spectacle, wagers, and profitable danger.

Planet.name: Chad
Planet.description: Chad’s humid and dense forest that surrounds the planet is home to the sentient species Chadra-Fans. The trees of Chad are thick and hold deep roots within the moist soil proving their long age.

pl.description: Chad pokrywają wilgotne, gęste lasy będące ojczyzną rozumnych Chadra-Fanów. Stare drzewa mają masywne pnie i głęboko zakorzeniają się w nasiąkniętej glebie, świadcząc o długowieczności ekosystemu. Krajobraz planety jest niemal całkowicie podporządkowany bujnej roślinności, która zapewnia mieszkańcom schronienie i podstawę ich rodzimej kultury.

en.description: Chad’s humid and dense forest that surrounds the planet is home to the sentient species Chadra-Fans. The trees of Chad are thick and hold deep roots within the moist soil proving their long age.

hut.description: Chad is wrapped in humid dense forest, home to the Chadra-Fans. Ancient thick trees drive deep roots into wet soil, revealing the ecosystem's age. The forest provides shelter, identity, and the natural foundation of native life.

Planet.name: Klatooine
Planet.description: An arid desert planet with many Hutt buildings. The planet also has a fissure named “Fountain of the Ancients” by the locals and no technology is allowed near it.

pl.description: Klatooine jest suchą, pustynną planetą pełną zabudowań związanych z wpływami Huttów. Szczególnym miejscem pozostaje szczelina zwana przez mieszkańców „Fontanną Pradawnych”. Tradycja zakazuje używania technologii w jej pobliżu, co czyni ją chronionym obszarem kulturowym. Świat łączy zatem huttiańską obecność polityczną z lokalnymi zwyczajami starszymi niż współczesna infrastruktura.

en.description: An arid desert planet with many Hutt buildings. The planet also has a fissure named “Fountain of the Ancients” by the locals and no technology is allowed near it.

hut.description: Klatooine is an arida dune-world marked by Hutt buildings. Its sacred fissure, the Fountain of the Ancients, admits no technology nearby. The world joins Hutt political influence with a local tradition older than modern machinery and guarded from its reach.

Planet.name: Sleheyron
Planet.description: A planet based on slave trade and the refineminet of tibanna gas, it was one of the most powerful economically of the Hutt worlds. A volcanic world littered with spaceports, refinery districts, industrial areas and countless urban areas and very little flora/fauna. Sleheyron as far as its economy went was second only to Nar Shaddaa.

pl.description: Sleheyron należy do najpotężniejszych gospodarczo światów Huttów. Jego bogactwo opiera się na handlu niewolnikami i rafinacji gazu tibanna. Wulkaniczny krajobraz wypełniają porty kosmiczne, dzielnice rafineryjne, zakłady przemysłowe oraz rozległa zabudowa miejska, przy niemal całkowitym braku naturalnej flory i fauny. Pod względem gospodarczym planetę przewyższa w przestrzeni Huttów właściwie tylko Nar Shaddaa.

en.description: A planet based on slave trade and the refineminet of tibanna gas, it was one of the most powerful economically of the Hutt worlds. A volcanic world littered with spaceports, refinery districts, industrial areas and countless urban areas and very little flora/fauna. Sleheyron as far as its economy went was second only to Nar Shaddaa.

hut.description: Sleheyron is among the richest Hutt worlds, built on slave trade and tibanna refining. Spaceports, refineries, factories, and endless urban districts cover a volcanic surface almost empty of native life. In the Hutt economic ledger, only Nar Shaddaa stands clearly above it.

Planet.name: Oba Diah
Planet.description: A jagged rocky planet with crystals everywhere. This planet is overcast, but never rainy. Oba Diah is the homeworld of the Pyke Syndicate and has many of the Syndicate’s hideouts and fortresses.

pl.description: Oba Diah jest poszarpanym, skalistym światem usianym kryształami. Niebo pozostaje stale zachmurzone, choć opady występują rzadko. Planeta stanowi ojczyznę Syndykatu Pyke i mieści liczne kryjówki oraz umocnione siedziby organizacji. Surowy teren sprzyja ukrywaniu infrastruktury, a kryminalne znaczenie świata dalece przewyższa jego słabo opisane zasoby naturalne.

en.description: A jagged rocky planet with crystals everywhere. This planet is overcast, but never rainy. Oba Diah is the homeworld of the Pyke Syndicate and has many of the Syndicate’s hideouts and fortresses.

hut.description: Oba Diah is a jagged rocky world scattered with crystals beneath permanent cloud and little rain. It is the Pyke Syndicate homeworld, filled with hideouts and fortresses. Harsh terrain conceals criminal koona, making underworld power more important than any poorly recorded natural resource.

Planet.name: Eadu
Planet.description: As if it was caught in a neverending maelstrom, Eadu is a mountainous planet in the Outer Rim. An isolated planet in the far reaches of the galaxy where there aren’t any suspicious onlookers.

pl.description: Eadu jest górzystym światem Zewnętrznych Rubieży, nieustannie smaganym burzami przypominającymi wieczny wir. Odosobnienie na krańcach galaktyki ogranicza obecność przypadkowych obserwatorów, dlatego planeta nadaje się do ukrytych instalacji i działalności wymagającej tajemnicy. Wrogie środowisko utrudnia dostęp, lecz zarazem stanowi naturalną osłonę przed rozpoznaniem.

en.description: As if it was caught in a neverending maelstrom, Eadu is a mountainous planet in the Outer Rim. An isolated planet in the far reaches of the galaxy where there aren’t any suspicious onlookers.

hut.description: Eadu is an Outer Rim mountain world trapped beneath an endless maelstrom. Its isolation keeps suspicious eyes away, making the planet suitable for secret facilities and hidden work. The same hostile weather that makes access costly also buys natural concealment.

Planet.name: Ord Radama
