Planet.description: Ord Radama is a heavily defended Separatist Stronghold. Ord Radama was a planet in the Radama Void of the Outer Rim Territories' Esstran sector. Once a world of marshes and wetlands, it was built up with cities and streets over the years. The planet was the home world of the Devlikk species.

pl.description: Ord Radama jest silnie ufortyfikowaną twierdzą Separatystów w Pustce Radama, w sektorze Esstran Zewnętrznych Rubieży. Dawne mokradła i tereny podmokłe stopniowo zabudowano miastami oraz gęstą siecią ulic. Planeta pozostaje ojczyzną gatunku Devlikk. Wieloletnia urbanizacja i militaryzacja niemal całkowicie przekształciły pierwotny krajobraz, czyniąc świat ważnym punktem obronnym CIS.

en.description: Ord Radama is a heavily defended Separatist Stronghold. Ord Radama was a planet in the Radama Void of the Outer Rim Territories' Esstran sector. Once a world of marshes and wetlands, it was built up with cities and streets over the years. The planet was the home world of the Devlikk species.

hut.description: Ord Radama is a fortified Separatista stronghold in the Radama Void of the Outer Rim's Esstran sector. Cities and streets replaced much of its old marshland. Home to the Devlikk, the world has been reshaped by urban growth and mala defenses into an important CIS bastion.

Planet.name: Raydonia
Planet.description: An often overlooked, temperate, small forested planet. Sites of several small unallied settlements are here, all needing constant shipments from regularly scheduled transport ships for supplies. The planet is similar to Felucia in which it is large, colorful, and overgrown with flora and fauna.

pl.description: Raydonia jest niewielkim, często pomijanym światem umiarkowanym, porośniętym barwną i bujną roślinnością przypominającą Felucię. Kilka niezależnych osad pozostaje rozproszonych wśród lasów i wymaga regularnych dostaw z zewnątrz. Zależność od transportów ogranicza samowystarczalność mieszkańców, mimo bogactwa miejscowej flory i fauny.

en.description: An often overlooked, temperate, small forested planet. Sites of several small unallied settlements are here, all needing constant shipments from regularly scheduled transport ships for supplies. The planet is similar to Felucia in which it is large, colorful, and overgrown with flora and fauna.

hut.description: Raydonia is a small overlooked mild-world, colorful and overgrown like Felucia. Several unaligned settlements depend on scheduled supply ships. Rich native life surrounds them, but reliance on imported goods keeps the communities from true self-sufficiency.

Planet.name: Yalbeck Prime
Planet.description: Home to the Yalbec which is a bee-like creature. Little to none is known about the rest of this planet.

pl.description: Yalbeck Prime jest ojczyzną Yalbeców, istot przypominających pszczoły. Poza potwierdzoną obecnością tego rozumnego gatunku wiarygodne archiwa nie opisują powierzchni, klimatu, zasobów ani historii planety. Świat pozostaje zatem niemal niepoznany, a wszelkie bardziej szczegółowe twierdzenia wymagałyby nowego rozpoznania.

en.description: Home to the Yalbec which is a bee-like creature. Little to none is known about the rest of this planet.

hut.description: Yalbeck Prime is home to the bee-like Yalbec. Beyond that confirmed native species, reliable ledgers say almost nothing of its surface, climate, resources, or history. Any richer claim must wait for a new survey.

Planet.name: Quell
Planet.description: A non-descript blue-hazy planet with brown dirt and round bulging stones scattered across the flat plains.

pl.description: Quell jest niepozornym światem spowitym niebieskawą mgłą. Płaskie równiny pokrywa brunatna gleba, a ich monotonny krajobraz przerywają zaokrąglone, wybrzuszone głazy. Dostępne opisy nie wskazują znaczącego osadnictwa ani szczególnych zasobów, dlatego planeta pozostaje przede wszystkim punktem geograficznym o słabo rozpoznanym znaczeniu.

en.description: A non-descript blue-hazy planet with brown dirt and round bulging stones scattered across the flat plains.

hut.description: Quell is an unremarkable world beneath blue haze. Brown soil and round bulging stones cover its flat plains. Available records name no major settlement or resource, leaving the planet a geographic entry with little surveyed value.

Planet.name: Daro
Planet.description: The planet's surface was covered in vast verdant forests and jungles of pine trees, ferns, and other plants, which were home to carrier butterflies and massiffs. The thousands of trees engulfed Daro's landscape, which was peppered with towering rocky mountains and buttes, the cliffs of which were in turn enveloped by the trees' expansive roots. The planet featured snow-covered portions at its topmost regions as well as numerous bodies of water of variable sizes that were scattered throughout the forested areas.

pl.description: Daro pokrywają rozległe zielone lasy i dżungle złożone z sosen, paproci i innych roślin. Żyją tam motyle transportowe oraz massiffy. Tysiące drzew otaczają wysokie skaliste góry i ostańce, a korzenie oplatają ich urwiska. W najwyższych partiach zalega śnieg, podczas gdy pomiędzy zalesionymi obszarami leżą liczne jeziora i inne zbiorniki wodne. Zróżnicowanie wysokości tworzy wyjątkowo bogaty ekosystem.

en.description: The planet's surface was covered in vast verdant forests and jungles of pine trees, ferns, and other plants, which were home to carrier butterflies and massiffs. The thousands of trees engulfed Daro's landscape, which was peppered with towering rocky mountains and buttes, the cliffs of which were in turn enveloped by the trees' expansive roots. The planet featured snow-covered portions at its topmost regions as well as numerous bodies of water of variable sizes that were scattered throughout the forested areas.

hut.description: Daro is covered by vast green forests and jungles of pine, fern, and other growth, home to carrier butterflies and massiffs. Trees climb around towering mountains and buttes, roots wrapping their cliffs. Snow lies at the highest elevations, while waters of many sizes break the forest below. Altitude and moisture sustain a rich living world.

Planet.name: Agamar
Planet.description: Agamar is a solitary rocky planet. Used often as a staging ground for military purposes or hiding spots for smugglers. However, farmers continue to succeed in production despite the cold climate.

pl.description: Agamar jest odosobnionym, skalistym światem o chłodnym klimacie. Położenie i ukształtowanie terenu sprawiają, że służy jako punkt koncentracji wojsk albo kryjówka przemytników. Mimo trudnych warunków miejscowi rolnicy utrzymują skuteczną produkcję, dowodząc odporności osadnictwa. Planeta łączy więc strategiczną użyteczność z gospodarką opartą na wytrwałym rolnictwie.

en.description: Agamar is a solitary rocky planet. Used often as a staging ground for military purposes or hiding spots for smugglers. However, farmers continue to succeed in production despite the cold climate.

hut.description: Agamar is a solitary rocky cold-world used as a mala staging ground and smuggler refuge. Despite the climate, local farmers continue to produce reliable harvests. Strategic use and stubborn agriculture share the planet's modest ledger.

Planet.name: Zeffo
Planet.description: Small settlements were often attacked by electromagnetic winds on Zeffo. The world is rich with water and a sustained ecosystem. Rocky edges scattered Zeffo’s surface with buildings often being built into the surface.

pl.description: Zeffo jest skalistym światem bogatym w wodę i podtrzymującym trwały ekosystem. Niewielkie osady regularnie zmagają się z elektromagnetycznymi wichrami, które zagrażają łączności i infrastrukturze. Liczne budynki wzniesiono bezpośrednio w skalnych zboczach, wykorzystując naturalną osłonę terenu przed niszczycielską pogodą.

en.description: Small settlements were often attacked by electromagnetic winds on Zeffo. The world is rich with water and a sustained ecosystem. Rocky edges scattered Zeffo’s surface with buildings often being built into the surface.

hut.description: Zeffo is a rocky water-rich world with a stable ecosystem. Electromagnetic winds repeatedly strike its small settlements, threatening comms and machinery. Many buildings are cut into rock faces, using the land itself as protection from the hostile weather.

Planet.name: Pabu
Planet.description: A tiny planet that most ignore. The majority of the planet is bright blue oceans. Though there are many tiny islands scattered around the planet with small settlements on some of them. One of such settlements is a place of refuge for those who have been displaced.

pl.description: Pabu jest niewielkim, często pomijanym światem niemal całkowicie pokrytym jasnoniebieskimi oceanami. Pośród wód rozrzucone są liczne wysepki, z których część mieści małe osady. Jedna z nich służy jako bezpieczne schronienie dla osób wypędzonych z własnych domów, nadając spokojnej planecie szczególne znaczenie humanitarne.

en.description: A tiny planet that most ignore. The majority of the planet is bright blue oceans. Though there are many tiny islands scattered around the planet with small settlements on some of them. One of such settlements is a place of refuge for those who have been displaced.

hut.description: Pabu is a tiny overlooked world of bright blue ocean and scattered islands. Several islands hold small settlements; one offers refuge to people driven from their homes. The planet's quiet isolation has become a humanitarian asset greater than any market wealth.

Planet.name: Ajan Kloss
Planet.description: This planet is a moon to a massive gas giant. The gas giant shades the planet and its own moons from the radiation of their star. The planet is covered with one massive forest with random clearings from a civilization that once inhabited the planet. In certain areas the forest is perched upon massive cliffs. The weather is very moist which is a problem for electronics and brings on fungal infections very easily.

pl.description: Ajan Kloss jest księżycem olbrzyma gazowego, który częściowo osłania go przed promieniowaniem miejscowej gwiazdy. Powierzchnię pokrywa rozległy las, przerywany polanami pozostawionymi przez dawną cywilizację i urwiskami porośniętymi roślinnością. Stała wilgoć sprzyja grzybom, uszkadza elektronikę i wywołuje infekcje, czyniąc długotrwałą obecność wymagającą dla ludzi oraz sprzętu.

en.description: This planet is a moon to a massive gas giant. The gas giant shades the planet and its own moons from the radiation of their star. The planet is covered with one massive forest with random clearings from a civilization that once inhabited the planet. In certain areas the forest is perched upon massive cliffs. The weather is very moist which is a problem for electronics and brings on fungal infections very easily.

hut.description: Ajan Kloss is a moon sheltered from stellar radiation by its gas giant. One immense forest covers the surface, broken by old clearings and cliff-bound growth. Constant moisture damages electronics and breeds fungal infection, making every long stay expensive in maintenance and medicine.

Planet.name: Kaller
Planet.description: Kaller is a temperate world characterized by its red snow capped mountains, lakes, and pine forests. The local Kallerians either live in primitive stone villages or urban modern mountain top cities. The dense nature gives the planet a blushing ecosystem. An important planet surrounded by Banking Clan owned systems.

pl.description: Kaller jest umiarkowanym światem czerwonych, ośnieżonych gór, jezior i lasów iglastych. Kallerianie mieszkają zarówno w prostych kamiennych wioskach, jak i nowoczesnych miastach wzniesionych na szczytach. Bujna przyroda tworzy bogaty ekosystem. Położenie pośród systemów kontrolowanych przez Klan Bankowy nadaje planecie istotne znaczenie polityczne i strategiczne.

en.description: Kaller is a temperate world characterized by its red snow capped mountains, lakes, and pine forests. The local Kallerians either live in primitive stone villages or urban modern mountain top cities. The dense nature gives the planet a blushing ecosystem. An important planet surrounded by Banking Clan owned systems.

hut.description: Kaller is a mild-world of red snowcapped mountains, lakes, and pine forests. Kallerians live in stone villages and modern cities on high peaks. Rich nature surrounds a politically important world bordered by Banking Clan systems.

Planet.name: Scipio
Planet.description: Scipio is a major Banking Clan planet and is host to their Vaults, and is used by the Banking clan as a vacationing spot. Scipio is characterized by snowy mountains with the Banking clan making modern mountainside villas for pleasure or massive Vault Cities on long tentacle-like stilts. Wealthy elites live atop lush homes as large trade deals are made here. Money speaks more than people on Scipio.

pl.description: Scipio jest jednym z najważniejszych światów Klanu Bankowego, mieszczącym jego skarbce i luksusowe ośrodki wypoczynkowe. Pośród śnieżnych gór stoją nowoczesne wille oraz ogromne miasta-skarbce oparte na długich podporach. Elity zawierają tu wielkie umowy handlowe, a bogactwo wyznacza pozycję społeczną znacznie skuteczniej niż pochodzenie czy zasługi.

en.description: Scipio is a major Banking Clan planet and is host to their Vaults, and is used by the Banking clan as a vacationing spot. Scipio is characterized by snowy mountains with the Banking clan making modern mountainside villas for pleasure or massive Vault Cities on long tentacle-like stilts. Wealthy elites live atop lush homes as large trade deals are made here. Money speaks more than people on Scipio.

hut.description: Scipio is a principal Banking Clan world of vaults and mountain retreats. Villas and immense vault-cities stand above snow on long supports. Great contracts are signed in lavish homes, and credits speak louder than people. Finance is landscape, government, and social rank alike.

Planet.name: Ferrix
Planet.description: The people of Ferrix lived in tightly built communities and cities around Starships that were parked and being scrapped. The planet was also teeming with Corporate ran subsectors, mostly as leftovers as the sector that Ferrix is located in, used to be entirely Corporate ran before joining the Republic. This planet's position between multiple important Hyperspace Lanes makes it a crucial staging area for any mass deployments further down those lanes.

pl.description: Mieszkańcy Ferrix tworzą zwarte wspólnoty skupione wokół lądowisk i złomowanych statków. Wiele podsektorów nadal nosi ślady dawnych rządów korporacyjnych sprzed przyłączenia regionu do Republiki. Położenie między ważnymi trasami nadprzestrzennymi czyni planetę kluczowym punktem koncentracji wojsk i logistyki przed dalszymi operacjami wzdłuż tych szlaków.

en.description: The people of Ferrix lived in tightly built communities and cities around Starships that were parked and being scrapped. The planet was also teeming with Corporate ran subsectors, mostly as leftovers as the sector that Ferrix is located in, used to be entirely Corporate ran before joining the Republic. This planet's position between multiple important Hyperspace Lanes makes it a crucial staging area for any mass deployments further down those lanes.

hut.description: Ferrix communities crowd around parked ships and salvage yards. Corporate subsectors remain from the era before the region joined Republica. Its position between major hyperspace lanes makes the world a valuable staging ground for mass deployment and cargo moving farther down those routes.

Planet.name: Lola Sayu
Planet.description: Lola Sayu is a half destroyed world full of lava and steep cliffs. It is the location of the Citadel, a heavily fortified top security prison.

high_value_targets.name: Osi Sobeck
high_value_targets.title: Separatist Commandant
high_value_targets.intel: He is a Phindian who manages the Citadel and all CIS defences on world. He is responsible for torturing multiple Republic personnel as such we plan to give him a taste of his own medicine and find what intel has been leaked.

high_value_targets.name: Wilhuff Tarkin
high_value_targets.title: Republic Admiral
high_value_targets.intel: He is a human republic Admiral who is to be rescued by special order of the Chancellor himself. Therefore refusal to make him a priority can be considered treason, failure is not an option.

pl.description: Lola Sayu jest częściowo zniszczonym światem pełnym lawy, urwisk i niestabilnego terenu. Znajduje się tu Cytadela — ściśle strzeżone więzienie o najwyższym poziomie zabezpieczeń. Wrogie środowisko wzmacnia naturalną izolację kompleksu, utrudniając zarówno ucieczkę, jak i zewnętrzny szturm.

en.description: Lola Sayu is a half destroyed world full of lava and steep cliffs. It is the location of the Citadel, a heavily fortified top security prison.

hut.description: Lola Sayu is a half-destroyed world of lava and sheer cliffs. It holds the Citadel, a maximum-security prison whose defenses exploit the lethal terrain. Nature and fortification together make escape or assault an exceptionally costly bargain.

Planet.name: Jabiim
Planet.description: Jabiim to a majority of the galaxy is a hellhole, violent storms lasting almost every day, except for five days in the year, with rain that breaks for only an hour, acid rain and violent electrical whirlwinds that destroy under armored vehicles, and an ionized atmosphere that made oxygen breathing lifeforms swell in population, but also made repulsive based vehicles nearly impossible to use properly, as well as hampering long range communication and making gunship support impossible. As a result, the Republic had largely abandoned the idea of maintaining the world, instead focusing its efforts on mining the world's rich resources as quickly and efficiently as possible. Once a vast ocean and continental world with beautiful bamboo rainforests and green landscapes, the planet has now started to become abused and in some areas has even turned into a desert. Much to the displeasure of the rapidly growing Jabiim Nationalists movement, who have been displeased with the Republic tampering with their home world.

high_value_targets.name: Alto Stratus
high_value_targets.title: Faction Leader
high_value_targets.intel: Stratus has managed to gain a cult following relatively quickly within the planet's population, much to the discomfort of the Senate. Founder of the Nationalist movement, he is a threat with confirmed ties to the Separatists. This Nationalist movement may become one of the most feverishly loyal to the Separatist cause.

pl.description: Jabiim jest światem niemal codziennych burz, kwaśnego deszczu i elektrycznych trąb powietrznych niszczących lekkie pojazdy. Zjonizowana atmosfera utrudnia łączność, wsparcie lotnicze oraz działanie napędów repulsorowych. Republika ograniczyła stałą obecność, koncentrując się na szybkim wydobyciu bogatych zasobów. Dawne oceany i bambusowe lasy deszczowe ustępują zniszczeniom oraz pustynnieniu, wzmacniając nacjonalistyczny sprzeciw mieszkańców wobec eksploatacji planety.

en.description: Jabiim to a majority of the galaxy is a hellhole, violent storms lasting almost every day, except for five days in the year, with rain that breaks for only an hour, acid rain and violent electrical whirlwinds that destroy under armored vehicles, and an ionized atmosphere that made oxygen breathing lifeforms swell in population, but also made repulsive based vehicles nearly impossible to use properly, as well as hampering long range communication and making gunship support impossible. As a result, the Republic had largely abandoned the idea of maintaining the world, instead focusing its efforts on mining the world's rich resources as quickly and efficiently as possible. Once a vast ocean and continental world with beautiful bamboo rainforests and green landscapes, the planet has now started to become abused and in some areas has even turned into a desert. Much to the displeasure of the rapidly growing Jabiim Nationalists movement, who have been displeased with the Republic tampering with their home world.

hut.description: Jabiim suffers near-constant storms, acid rain, and electrical vortices that destroy light machines. Ionized air blocks long comms, gunships, and repulsors. Republica largely abandoned stewardship for rapid extraction of rich resources. Former oceans and bamboo rainforests now yield to ruin and desert, feeding Jabiimi nationalist anger.

Planet.name: Boz Pity
Planet.description: An uninhabited world of bright green foliage, tiny oceans, rocky fields, grassy fields, and sand filled valleys. Among the valleys and mountains are the death monuments left by the species that went extinct on the planet.

pl.description: Boz Pity jest niezamieszkanym światem o jasnozielonej roślinności, niewielkich oceanach, kamienistych polach, trawiastych równinach i piaszczystych dolinach. Wśród gór i obniżeń terenu stoją monumentalne pomniki śmierci pozostawione przez wymarły gatunek. To właśnie te relikty nadają planecie największą wartość historyczną i archeologiczną.

en.description: An uninhabited world of bright green foliage, tiny oceans, rocky fields, grassy fields, and sand filled valleys. Among the valleys and mountains are the death monuments left by the species that went extinct on the planet.

hut.description: Boz Pity is an uninhabited world of bright green growth, small seas, rock fields, grassland, and sandy valleys. Mountains and hollows contain death monuments left by an extinct species. Those relics are its greatest historical and archaeological wealth.

Planet.name: Ruusan
Planet.description: Ruusan is a low plant life planet with bright green waters. Everything on the surface, when the sun is out, is bright lavender and gold. We only know of this planet due to the Jedi knowing of something called “The Valley of the Jedi”. It is almost inaccessible due to the nebula nearby cutting of hyperspace routes.

pl.description: Ruusan ma skąpą roślinność, jaskrawozielone wody oraz powierzchnię mieniącą się w słońcu odcieniami lawendy i złota. Jedi znają planetę dzięki tajemniczej Dolinie Jedi. Dostęp utrudnia pobliska mgławica odcinająca trasy nadprzestrzenne, co chroni miejsce przed przypadkowymi przybyszami i podtrzymuje jego odosobniony, niemal mityczny charakter.

en.description: Ruusan is a low plant life planet with bright green waters. Everything on the surface, when the sun is out, is bright lavender and gold. We only know of this planet due to the Jedi knowing of something called “The Valley of the Jedi”. It is almost inaccessible due to the nebula nearby cutting of hyperspace routes.

hut.description: Ruusan has sparse plant life, bright green waters, and land shining lavender and gold in sunlight. Jedi records speak of the Valley of the Jedi. A nearby nebula severs hyperspace routes, guarding the world through isolation and preserving its near-mythic character.

Planet.name: Bracca
Planet.description: A rocky inhospitable planet that almost never stops raining. Filled mostly with junkyards of massive unusable starships waiting to be deconstructed.

pl.description: Bracca jest skalistym, niegościnnym światem nawiedzanym przez niemal nieustanne opady. Powierzchnię wypełniają ogromne złomowiska wycofanych i niezdatnych do użycia statków kosmicznych, które oczekują na rozbiórkę. Gospodarka opiera się na odzysku metali, części i wyposażenia, a deszcz oraz trudny teren zwiększają ryzyko pracy.

en.description: A rocky inhospitable planet that almost never stops raining. Filled mostly with junkyards of massive unusable starships waiting to be deconstructed.

hut.description: Bracca is a rocky hostile world beneath almost endless rain. Vast yards hold dead starships awaiting dismantling. Salvage of metal, parts, and equipment drives the economy, while weather and unstable wrecks add danger to every recovered credit.

Planet.name: Dotharian
Planet.description: Dotharian is a planet purely of sheer rock cliffs with planets growing unnaturally on the faces of those cliffs. There are a few castles and temples scattered around the planet hanging off of the mountains.

pl.description: Dotharian tworzą niemal wyłącznie pionowe skalne urwiska, na których ścianach roślinność rozwija się w nienaturalny sposób. Nieliczne zamki i świątynie wiszą przytwierdzone do gór, wykorzystując każdy dostępny występ. Osadnictwo wymaga niezwykłej inżynierii i sprawnego transportu pionowego, a sam krajobraz nadaje budowlom charakter odosobnionych twierdz.

en.description: Dotharian is a planet purely of sheer rock cliffs with planets growing unnaturally on the faces of those cliffs. There are a few castles and temples scattered around the planet hanging off of the mountains.

hut.description: Dotharian is a world of sheer rock cliffs where plants grow unnaturally upon vertical faces. A few castles and temples hang from the mountains. Settlement demands rare engineering and vertical transport, turning each structure into an isolated natural fortress.

Planet.name: Syvris
Planet.description: The small moon Syvris is a dedicated trade hub for repeat customers with the Hutts. Although pirates are often seen in nearby space the Hutt royals make sure to protect their trade routes. Operations are handled in a large space station within the moon's orbit.

pl.description: Niewielki księżyc Syvris jest stałym ośrodkiem handlu dla klientów utrzymujących relacje z Huttami. Piraci często pojawiają się w pobliskiej przestrzeni, lecz huttiańscy władcy chronią dochodowe trasy. Większość operacji prowadzi duża stacja kosmiczna na orbicie, skupiająca przeładunek, negocjacje i zabezpieczenie handlu.

en.description: The small moon Syvris is a dedicated trade hub for repeat customers with the Hutts. Although pirates are often seen in nearby space the Hutt royals make sure to protect their trade routes. Operations are handled in a large space station within the moon's orbit.

hut.description: Syvris is a small moon serving repeat customers of the Hutts. Pirates frequent nearby space, but Hutt rulers protect profitable routes. A large orbital station handles cargo, negotiation, and security, making the moon a compact but reliable trade hub.

Planet.name: Gamorr
Planet.description: Gamorr is a planet with a range of climates from tundra to jungle. It is the home world of the Gamorrans who are constantly engaged in primitive tribal warfare. They are mercenaries and will fight for goods. The Hutts are hated by them as they regularly enslave the Gamorrans. A CIS taskforce led by the Zygerrian Commander Daynar has established a supply depot on the planet Gamorr. This supply depot is operated by slaves owned by the Zygerrians and other CIS affiliated slave traders. The Hutts previously held a monopoly on slave trading on Gamorr and currently do not appreciate the competition. Additionally the Hutts run a major pod racing event on the world at the ancient ruined Carnuss Gorguul Fortress.

high_value_targets.name: Daynar
high_value_targets.title: CIS Allied Commander
high_value_targets.intel: The Zygerrian undercutting the Hutts in the Gamorran slave trade. He is of immense value to the Hutts and as such if we can capture him we will have a valuable bargaining chip in our dealings with them.

pl.description: Gamorr obejmuje strefy od tundry po dżunglę i jest ojczyzną Gamorrean prowadzących nieustanne wojny plemienne. Wojownicy służą jako najemnicy za towary, lecz nienawidzą Huttów za regularne niewolenie ich ludu. Zygerriański dowódca Daynar utworzył tu bazę zaopatrzeniową CIS obsługiwaną przez niewolników, naruszając huttiański monopol. Huttowie prowadzą także wielkie wyścigi ścigaczy przy ruinach twierdzy Carnuss Gorguul.

en.description: Gamorr is a planet with a range of climates from tundra to jungle. It is the home world of the Gamorrans who are constantly engaged in primitive tribal warfare. They are mercenaries and will fight for goods. The Hutts are hated by them as they regularly enslave the Gamorrans. A CIS taskforce led by the Zygerrian Commander Daynar has established a supply depot on the planet Gamorr. This supply depot is operated by slaves owned by the Zygerrians and other CIS affiliated slave traders. The Hutts previously held a monopoly on slave trading on Gamorr and currently do not appreciate the competition. Additionally the Hutts run a major pod racing event on the world at the ancient ruined Carnuss Gorguul Fortress.

hut.description: Gamorr ranges from tundra to jungle and is home to tribal Gamorrean warriors who sell service for goods. They hate Hutt slavers. Zygerrian Commander Daynar now runs a slave-worked CIS depot, challenging the old Hutt monopoly. The Hutts also profit from a major podrace at ruined Carnuss Gorguul Fortress.

Planet.name: Rothana
Planet.description: This is the planet from where our armies get their vehicles. This is a high priority planet to protect. The planet itself is an arctic tundra. In orbit, the majority of the planet is surrounded by honeycomb ship docks where Kuat Drive Yards work on our future machines.

pl.description: Rothana jest arktycznym światem o najwyższym znaczeniu dla zaopatrzenia armii Republiki w pojazdy. Orbitę otacza rozległa sieć doków o strukturze plastra miodu, gdzie Kuat Drive Yards opracowuje i produkuje przyszłe maszyny wojenne. Utrata planety zagroziłaby kluczowym liniom produkcyjnym, dlatego jej ochrona pozostaje priorytetem strategicznym.

en.description: This is the planet from where our armies get their vehicles. This is a high priority planet to protect. The planet itself is an arctic tundra. In orbit, the majority of the planet is surrounded by honeycomb ship docks where Kuat Drive Yards work on our future machines.

hut.description: Rothana is an arctic world supplying Republica armies with vehicles. Honeycomb docks surround much of its orbit, where Kuat Drive Yards builds future mala machines. Losing the planet would break vital production lines, making its defense a strategic priority.

Planet.name: Fetilia
Planet.description: Fetilia is a planet in the Mid Rim Territories and “The Slice”, Grid Square Q-12, located along the Gamor Run trade route. Fetilia is home to native population of the Fetillians, a species known for having to breathe Tibanna Gas. This would naturally imply that Fetilia does not have a breathable atmosphere. The planet is under Hutt control by the start of the Clone Wars but was not considerably protected given its distance to the inner planets controlled by the Hutt Cartel. The planet itself is quite barren, not able to support oxygen breathing lifeforms. It's just a rocky and desolate planet not too far from being a common asteroid. Its only real strategic value is its high abundance of natural Tibanna Gas which exists as both Liquid and Gas form throughout the planet, while on Fetilia the fuel source is inert due to natural high count of elements that act against the natural combustible nature of Tibana.

pl.description: Fetilia leży przy Gamor Run w Środkowych Rubieżach i należy do Huttów. Rodzimi Fetillianie oddychają tibanną, gdyż atmosfera nie nadaje się dla organizmów tlenowych. Jałowy, skalisty świat przypomina asteroidę i pozostaje słabo broniony. Jego główną wartością są obfite złoża tibanny w postaci gazowej i ciekłej, naturalnie obojętnej dzięki miejscowym pierwiastkom ograniczającym jej palność.

en.description: Fetilia is a planet in the Mid Rim Territories and “The Slice”, Grid Square Q-12, located along the Gamor Run trade route. Fetilia is home to native population of the Fetillians, a species known for having to breathe Tibanna Gas. This would naturally imply that Fetilia does not have a breathable atmosphere. The planet is under Hutt control by the start of the Clone Wars but was not considerably protected given its distance to the inner planets controlled by the Hutt Cartel. The planet itself is quite barren, not able to support oxygen breathing lifeforms. It's just a rocky and desolate planet not too far from being a common asteroid. Its only real strategic value is its high abundance of natural Tibanna Gas which exists as both Liquid and Gas form throughout the planet, while on Fetilia the fuel source is inert due to natural high count of elements that act against the natural combustible nature of Tibana.

hut.description: Fetilia lies on the Gamor Run under Hutt control. Native Fetillians breathe tibanna; oxygen life cannot survive its barren air. The weakly defended rock-world holds abundant liquid and gaseous tibanna, rendered inert by local elements. That fuel is its only great strategic profit.

Planet.name: Trillia
Planet.description: A large asteroid that is a little too small to be called a planet and is home to the notorious dwarf rathtars. The celestial body is known by smugglers as a dangerous way to gain a fortune. Those who took part in it were looked down upon by fellow smugglers.

pl.description: Trillia jest wielką asteroidą, zbyt małą, by uznać ją za planetę, zamieszkaną przez niesławne karłowate rathtary. Przemytnicy postrzegają wyprawę na ten obiekt jako wyjątkowo ryzykowny sposób zdobycia fortuny. Nawet w ich środowisku uczestników takich przedsięwzięć uznaje się za lekkomyślnych, co świadczy o skali zagrożenia.

en.description: A large asteroid that is a little too small to be called a planet and is home to the notorious dwarf rathtars. The celestial body is known by smugglers as a dangerous way to gain a fortune. Those who took part in it were looked down upon by fellow smugglers.

hut.description: Trillia is a large asteroid below planet size and home to dwarf rathtars. Smugglers know it as a deadly path to fortune. Even other smugglers despise or mock those who take the wager, revealing how poor the odds truly are.

Planet.name: Aridus
Planet.description: This planet is largely covered by deserts. Through the deserts were some volcanoes with lava pits. There are some small bodies of water in the form of oases and lakes. Though, there are only a few cities scattered around the planet and they normally are next to a body of water in spire-like tower-cities.

pl.description: Aridus w większości pokrywają pustynie, pośród których występują wulkany i rozlewiska lawy. Nieliczne oazy oraz jeziora umożliwiają stałe osadnictwo. Rozproszone miasta zwykle wznoszą się tuż przy wodzie w postaci wysokich, iglicowych wież. Kontrola nad zbiornikami decyduje o rozmieszczeniu ludności i gospodarczym przetrwaniu świata.

en.description: This planet is largely covered by deserts. Through the deserts were some volcanoes with lava pits. There are some small bodies of water in the form of oases and lakes. Though, there are only a few cities scattered around the planet and they normally are next to a body of water in spire-like tower-cities.

hut.description: Aridus is mostly desert broken by volcanoes, lava pits, oases, and a few lakes. Sparse settlements rise as spire-cities beside water. Control of each oasis determines population, trade, and survival.

Planet.name: Leritor
Planet.description: The surface of this world is covered mostly by oceans. On the continents, there are very fertile plains due to the never-ending rain storms in the mountains.

pl.description: Leritor jest światem zdominowanym przez oceany. Na kontynentach występują niezwykle żyzne równiny, nawadniane przez niemal nieustanne burze deszczowe powstające w górach. Obfitość wody sprzyja rolnictwu, lecz wymaga infrastruktury odpornej na długotrwałe opady i gwałtowne spływy z wyżej położonych terenów.

en.description: The surface of this world is covered mostly by oceans. On the continents, there are very fertile plains due to the never-ending rain storms in the mountains.

hut.description: Leritor is mostly ocean. Its continents hold fertile plains watered by endless mountain rainstorms. Water creates strong agricultural profit, but settlements require durable drainage and storm-resistant koona.

Planet.name: Monastery
Planet.description: A rainforest engulfed planet that houses many fierce predators. The topography can be described as bizarre and weird. There is a crystal valley where many jagged crystalline structures jet out of the ground. These structures can burst out of the ground on their own at random times.

pl.description: Monastery spowija las deszczowy pełen groźnych drapieżników i niezwykłych form terenu. Szczególnym miejscem jest Kryształowa Dolina, gdzie ostre struktury krystaliczne wyrastają wysoko ponad powierzchnię. Nowe kryształy mogą gwałtownie przebić ziemię bez ostrzeżenia, czyniąc eksplorację i osadnictwo nieprzewidywalnymi oraz niebezpiecznymi.

en.description: A rainforest engulfed planet that houses many fierce predators. The topography can be described as bizarre and weird. There is a crystal valley where many jagged crystalline structures jet out of the ground. These structures can burst out of the ground on their own at random times.

hut.description: Monastery is engulfed by rainforest and fierce predators beneath bizarre terrain. In Crystal Valley, jagged formations rise from the ground and may erupt without warning. Exploration promises rare material but carries sudden lethal risk.

Planet.name: Nexus Ortai
Planet.description: Nexus Ortai is classified in both the Mid Rim and “The Slice” regions of the Galaxy, Grid Square Q-14, along two separate trade routes, the Reena Trade Route and the Askar Trace. It is considered a strategic position given its position at the intersection of two hyper lanes. A peaceful planet known for its many trade hubs and a good place to get food, known really for its “Hyper lane Freighter stop” a place one could get a bite to eat, rest and have their ship worked on before moving further. Otherwise the planet is known for its rolling hills and very scenic lakes.

pl.description: Nexus Ortai leży na przecięciu Reena Trade Route i Askar Trace, dzięki czemu stanowi strategiczny węzeł handlowy Środkowych Rubieży. Spokojna planeta słynie z licznych targowisk i postoju dla frachtowców, oferującego posiłek, wypoczynek oraz naprawy. Poza portami krajobraz tworzą łagodne wzgórza i malownicze jeziora, co wzmacnia znaczenie świata jako bezpiecznego przystanku.

en.description: Nexus Ortai is classified in both the Mid Rim and “The Slice” regions of the Galaxy, Grid Square Q-14, along two separate trade routes, the Reena Trade Route and the Askar Trace. It is considered a strategic position given its position at the intersection of two hyper lanes. A peaceful planet known for its many trade hubs and a good place to get food, known really for its “Hyper lane Freighter stop” a place one could get a bite to eat, rest and have their ship worked on before moving further. Otherwise the planet is known for its rolling hills and very scenic lakes.

hut.description: Nexus Ortai sits where Reena Trade Route meets Askar Trace. Its freighter stop sells food, rest, repairs, and access to many markets. Rolling hills and scenic lakes surround this peaceful strategic crossroads, making safety itself a valuable service.

Planet.name: Carlac
Planet.description: Carlac is a snowy planet with mountains and plains. In those plains can be seen trees with bright pink leaves all year ‘round, despite being in the frigid cold. It is also the home of the peaceful Ming Po human clan.

pl.description: Carlac jest śnieżnym światem gór i równin. Mimo dotkliwego chłodu rosną tam drzewa zachowujące przez cały rok jaskraworóżowe liście. Planetę zamieszkuje pokojowy ludzki klan Ming Po, którego osady współistnieją z niezwykłą roślinnością. Kontrast bieli śniegu i różowych koron stanowi najbardziej rozpoznawalną cechę krajobrazu.

en.description: Carlac is a snowy planet with mountains and plains. In those plains can be seen trees with bright pink leaves all year ‘round, despite being in the frigid cold. It is also the home of the peaceful Ming Po human clan.

hut.description: Carlac is a snowy world of mountains and plains where trees keep bright pink leaves through the cold year. The peaceful human Ming Po clan lives among them. White land and vivid canopies form the planet's unmistakable image.

Planet.name: Kholo
Planet.description: Kholo is a human Outer Colony in the Equinox system, founded in 2439 and inhabited by millions before the UNKNOWN ENEMY located it during the war. Canon sources describe a settled world with weak defenses but provide only limited detail about its original terrain and economy. Campaign surveys classify the environment as a harsh, scorched nuclear desert, reflecting the local state used by the map rather than the grassy plains in the previous mismatched entry. Its history is defined by vulnerable colonial settlements and its exposure to UNKNOWN ENEMY reconnaissance, not by the treaty politics of another galaxy.

pl.description: Kholo jest ludzką kolonią zewnętrzną w układzie Equinox, założoną w 2439 roku i zamieszkaną przez miliony przed wykryciem przez Przymierze. Źródła opisują zasiedlony, słabo broniony świat, lecz niewiele mówią o pierwotnym terenie i gospodarce. Kampania przedstawia go jako spaloną nuklearną pustynię. Historia planety wynika z bezbronności kolonii i narażenia na rozpoznanie Przymierza, nie z polityki innego uniwersum.

en.description: Kholo is a human Outer Colony in the Equinox system, founded in 2439 and inhabited by millions before the UNKNOWN ENEMY located it during the war. Canon sources describe a settled world with weak defenses but provide only limited detail about its original terrain and economy. Campaign surveys classify the environment as a harsh, scorched nuclear desert, reflecting the local state used by the map rather than the grassy plains in the previous mismatched entry. Its history is defined by vulnerable colonial settlements and its exposure to UNKNOWN ENEMY reconnaissance, not by the treaty politics of another galaxy.

hut.description: Kholo is a human Outer Colony founded in 2439 in the Equinox system. Millions lived on the weakly defended world before UNKNOWN RIVAL discovery. Original terrain and economy are poorly recorded; campaign surveys show a scorched nuclear wasteland. Its history is one of exposed settlements and hostile reconnaissance.

Planet.name: Glee Anselm
Planet.description: An ocean planet with very little land mass. The sentient species that lives here live deep under the ocean, and due to the darkness of the water night vision is necessary to see anything. The islands that do dot the oceans hold jungles, mountains, and grassy fields.

pl.description: Glee Anselm jest planetą oceaniczną z niewielką ilością lądu. Rozumne gatunki mieszkają głęboko pod powierzchnią morza, gdzie ciemność wymaga widzenia nocnego. Nieliczne wyspy mieszczą dżungle, góry i trawiaste równiny. Zasadnicza część cywilizacji oraz zasobów biologicznych pozostaje jednak związana z głębinami.

en.description: An ocean planet with very little land mass. The sentient species that lives here live deep under the ocean, and due to the darkness of the water night vision is necessary to see anything. The islands that do dot the oceans hold jungles, mountains, and grassy fields.

hut.description: Glee Anselm is an ocean-world with little land. Sentient peoples live deep below, using night vision in the dark water. Scattered islands hold jungle, mountains, and grassland, but most civilization and living wealth belong to the sea.

Planet.name: Numidian Prime
Planet.description: One of the most beautiful jungle planets in the galaxy, Numidian Prime is a prime location for an exotic vacation. It also has many rivers that flow into scattered seas and a few swamps.

pl.description: Numidian Prime uchodzi za jeden z najpiękniejszych światów dżunglowych galaktyki. Bujną roślinność przecinają liczne rzeki wpadające do rozproszonych mórz, a miejscami występują mokradła. Egzotyczny krajobraz czyni planetę atrakcyjnym celem podróży i podstawą gospodarki turystycznej.

en.description: One of the most beautiful jungle planets in the galaxy, Numidian Prime is a prime location for an exotic vacation. It also has many rivers that flow into scattered seas and a few swamps.

hut.description: Numidian Prime is famed as one of the galaxy's most beautiful jungle worlds. Rivers cross lush land toward scattered seas and swamps. Exotic scenery makes tourism the planet's clearest and most pleasant profit.

Planet.name: Markez
Planet.description: A large moon of an uninhabitable planet. The moon itself is a host for a Rhydonium mine, a highly unstable ship fuel. The mine covers half of the entire moon.

pl.description: Markez jest dużym księżycem krążącym wokół niezdatnej do życia planety. Połowę jego powierzchni zajmuje kopalnia rhydonium — niezwykle niestabilnego paliwa okrętowego. Skala wydobycia nadaje obiektowi wysoką wartość strategiczną, lecz łatwopalność surowca sprawia, że awaria lub atak mogłyby doprowadzić do katastrofalnych skutków.

en.description: A large moon of an uninhabitable planet. The moon itself is a host for a Rhydonium mine, a highly unstable ship fuel. The mine covers half of the entire moon.

hut.description: Markez is a large moon of an uninhabitable planet. A rhydonium mine covers half its surface, extracting highly unstable starship fuel. The scale promises strategic profit, but accident or attack could turn the whole operation into catastrophe.

Planet.name: Dorin
Planet.description: A small planet stuck between two black holes. Making the planet mostly devoid of any oxygen. The planet itself was mountainous with large plateaus on those mountains. The weather is also extreme, making it hard to stay outside of shelter when a strom hits.

pl.description: Dorin jest niewielkim światem uwięzionym pomiędzy dwiema czarnymi dziurami. Niemal pozbawiona tlenu atmosfera i gwałtowna pogoda utrudniają życie poza schronieniami. Krajobraz tworzą góry z rozległymi płaskowyżami, na których osady muszą być przygotowane na nagłe, niszczycielskie burze. Warunki orbitalne i atmosferyczne czynią planetę wyjątkowo wymagającą.

en.description: A small planet stuck between two black holes. Making the planet mostly devoid of any oxygen. The planet itself was mountainous with large plateaus on those mountains. The weather is also extreme, making it hard to stay outside of shelter when a strom hits.

hut.description: Dorin is a small world between two black holes. Its air holds almost no oxygen, and violent storms make exposed travel dangerous. Mountains and broad plateaus offer settlement ground, but every habitat must endure extreme orbital and atmospheric conditions.

Planet.name: Rakata Prime
Planet.description: The planet of Rakata Prime, or Lehon to its people, is an ocean world clustered and dotted with numerous islands and archipelagos. It is the only habitable planet within the Lehon system, and was inevitably isolated from the rest of the galaxy due to this. Because of this the Rakatan species would have a silent but rapid rise to power through advanced technology. However, the Rakatans would become a tribalistic people slowly killing themselves in border conflicts and territorial claims. Now the planet is long abandoned and deathly silent. Artifacts, relics, and the remnants of ancient super structures is all that remains.

pl.description: Rakata Prime, zwana przez mieszkańców Lehonem, jest oceanicznym światem licznych wysp i archipelagów oraz jedyną zdatną do życia planetą układu. Izolacja sprzyjała szybkiemu rozwojowi technologii Rakatan, lecz późniejsze konflikty plemienne doprowadziły ich cywilizację do upadku. Dziś planeta pozostaje opuszczona i milcząca. Po dawnym imperium przetrwały artefakty, relikty oraz szczątki olbrzymich konstrukcji.

en.description: The planet of Rakata Prime, or Lehon to its people, is an ocean world clustered and dotted with numerous islands and archipelagos. It is the only habitable planet within the Lehon system, and was inevitably isolated from the rest of the galaxy due to this. Because of this the Rakatan species would have a silent but rapid rise to power through advanced technology. However, the Rakatans would become a tribalistic people slowly killing themselves in border conflicts and territorial claims. Now the planet is long abandoned and deathly silent. Artifacts, relics, and the remnants of ancient super structures is all that remains.

hut.description: Rakata Prime, or Lehon, is an isolated ocean-world of islands and the only habitable planet in its system. Rakatan technology rose swiftly, but tribal wars consumed the civilization. The world now stands silent, holding artifacts, relics, and remnants of ancient superstructures as its final inheritance.

Planet.name: Lafete
Planet.description: A desert planet used for factories and mega-corporations. The land of Lafete has been drained of all of its fertility and is no longer usable for its agriculture. The barren planet is a popular destination for fugitives and wanderers.

pl.description: Lafete jest pustynnym światem podporządkowanym fabrykom i wielkim korporacjom. Intensywna eksploatacja wyjałowiła ziemię, uniemożliwiając dalsze wykorzystanie rolnicze. Opustoszały krajobraz oraz rozległa infrastruktura przemysłowa przyciągają zbiegów i wędrowców szukających anonimowości. Gospodarczy rozwój pozostawił po sobie produkcję, lecz odebrał planecie naturalną zdolność podtrzymywania życia.

en.description: A desert planet used for factories and mega-corporations. The land of Lafete has been drained of all of its fertility and is no longer usable for its agriculture. The barren planet is a popular destination for fugitives and wanderers.

hut.description: Lafete is a desert world drained by factories and megacorporations until its soil could no longer farm. Barren land and industrial ruins attract fugitives and wanderers seeking anonymity. Corporate profit survived longer than the planet's fertility.

Planet.name: Merokia
Planet.description: An non-descript desert planet near the Unknown Regions with no inhabitants. Although, there are a few areas where destroyed ships can be found.

pl.description: Merokia jest niezamieszkaną, słabo rozpoznaną planetą pustynną w pobliżu Nieznanych Regionów. Na powierzchni znajdują się nieliczne wraki zniszczonych statków, lecz dostępne źródła nie wyjaśniają ich pochodzenia. Brak osadnictwa i udokumentowanych zasobów sprawia, że świat pozostaje przede wszystkim odległym miejscem katastrof oraz potencjalnym celem badań lub odzysku.

en.description: An non-descript desert planet near the Unknown Regions with no inhabitants. Although, there are a few areas where destroyed ships can be found.

hut.description: Merokia is an uninhabited, poorly surveyed desert near the Unknown Regions. A few fields of wrecked ships mark its surface, with no clear record of their origin. The world offers little beyond salvage, unanswered disaster, and possible investigation.

Planet.name: Zondula
Planet.description: A planet with many rolling mountains that have lush green fields on top of those mountain plateaus. With small oceans of near black water and beaches of sheer cliffs. On this planet there are many temples, which are guarded by jedi.

pl.description: Zondula jest światem falistych gór zwieńczonych zielonymi płaskowyżami. Pomiędzy nimi leżą niewielkie, niemal czarne oceany otoczone urwistymi brzegami. Liczne świątynie pozostają pod strażą Jedi, dzięki czemu naturalnie obronny krajobraz ma również duże znaczenie duchowe i historyczne.

en.description: A planet with many rolling mountains that have lush green fields on top of those mountain plateaus. With small oceans of near black water and beaches of sheer cliffs. On this planet there are many temples, which are guarded by jedi.

hut.description: Zondula has rolling mountains crowned by green plateaus and small near-black seas beneath sheer coasts. Jedi guard its many temples. Natural defense, sacred inheritance, and isolation make the world valuable beyond ordinary resources.

Planet.name: Gerrigon
Planet.description: A terrestrial astronomical object with an atmosphere. On this object was a once thriving hub for culture and commerce and has since been abandoned. Now the object that was completely filled with a city of white stone and glass is overgrown with nature.

pl.description: Gerrigon posiada atmosferę i był niegdyś kwitnącym ośrodkiem kultury oraz handlu. Całą powierzchnię zajmowało miasto z białego kamienia i szkła, dziś opuszczone oraz stopniowo pochłaniane przez roślinność. Ruiny zachowują wielką wartość archeologiczną i stanowią świadectwo cywilizacji, której przyczyny upadku nie wyjaśniają dostępne archiwa.

en.description: A terrestrial astronomical object with an atmosphere. On this object was a once thriving hub for culture and commerce and has since been abandoned. Now the object that was completely filled with a city of white stone and glass is overgrown with nature.

hut.description: Gerrigon once flourished as a center of culture and trade, its surface filled by a city of white stone and glass. Now abandoned, the city yields to nature. Its ruins hold archaeological wealth and the unanswered account of a vanished civilization.

Planet.name: Lutrilla
Planet.description: Lutrillia is an arid and cold planet with only windswept tundras. The world itself is relatively flat with all of its ancient oceans dried up into tiny oases. The local sentient species are a nomad people who live on massive cities on wheels to stay mobile, strip the planet of recourse, and avoid the large predators of the planet who live underground.

pl.description: Lutrillia jest zimnym, suchym światem płaskich, smaganych wiatrem tundr. Dawne oceany wyschły, pozostawiając jedynie małe oazy. Miejscowy lud koczowniczy mieszka w olbrzymich miastach na kołach, przemieszczając się w poszukiwaniu zasobów i unikając wielkich podziemnych drapieżników. Mobilność stanowi podstawę przetrwania, gospodarki i kultury planety.

en.description: Lutrillia is an arid and cold planet with only windswept tundras. The world itself is relatively flat with all of its ancient oceans dried up into tiny oases. The local sentient species are a nomad people who live on massive cities on wheels to stay mobile, strip the planet of recourse, and avoid the large predators of the planet who live underground.

hut.description: Lutrillia is a flat cold arida world where old oceans have shrunk to small oases. Nomads live in immense rolling cities, stripping resources while avoiding great underground predators. Movement is survival, economy, and culture together.

Planet.name: Lorta
Planet.description: A planet where all foliage is a shade of bright blue making it look like an ocean planet from space. But there are actually no oceans to be found on this planet, just fields, forests, canyons, and mountains. This planet is home to the violent Lortans who keep threatening the systems nearby. Hopefully they don’t do anything they keep threatening.

pl.description: Cała roślinność Lorty ma jaskrawoniebieską barwę, przez co z orbity planeta przypomina świat oceaniczny, choć nie posiada mórz. Powierzchnię tworzą pola, lasy, kaniony i góry. Jest ojczyzną wojowniczych Lortan, którzy regularnie grożą sąsiednim systemom, nadając planecie reputację niestabilnego zagrożenia regionalnego.

en.description: A planet where all foliage is a shade of bright blue making it look like an ocean planet from space. But there are actually no oceans to be found on this planet, just fields, forests, canyons, and mountains. This planet is home to the violent Lortans who keep threatening the systems nearby. Hopefully they don’t do anything they keep threatening.

hut.description: Lorta's bright blue plant life makes it resemble an ocean-world from orbit, though it has no seas—only fields, forests, canyons, and mountains. Violent Lortans repeatedly threaten nearby systems, making their world a regional danger.

Planet.name: Regis Kor
Planet.description: A rocky dwarf planet with a very small atmosphere. There were only 3 inhabited locations on the planet of a primitive sentient species.

pl.description: Regis Kor jest skalistą planetą karłowatą o bardzo rozrzedzonej atmosferze. Istnieją na niej zaledwie trzy zamieszkane ośrodki należące do prymitywnego, rozumnego gatunku. Niewielka liczba osad i trudne środowisko ograniczają rozwój, a dostępne rejestry nie potwierdzają znaczącej gospodarki ani zasobów.

en.description: A rocky dwarf planet with a very small atmosphere. There were only 3 inhabited locations on the planet of a primitive sentient species.

hut.description: Regis Kor is a rocky dwarf planet with a very thin atmosphere. Only three settlements of a primitive sentient species are known. Harsh conditions and small population leave little developed economy or documented resource wealth.

Planet.name: Kartoosh
Planet.description: A large object floating in space used by the CIS as a shipyard. A place to build the current Separatist fleet of warships. A discrete complex that allows for swift manufacturing of ships.

pl.description: Kartoosh jest dużą instalacją kosmiczną wykorzystywaną przez CIS jako dyskretna stocznia. Kompleks prowadzi szybki montaż okrętów wojennych dla floty Separatystów, pozostając z dala od najbardziej oczywistych ośrodków przemysłowych. Jego znaczenie wynika z wydajności produkcji i trudniejszego do wykrycia położenia.

en.description: A large object floating in space used by the CIS as a shipyard. A place to build the current Separatist fleet of warships. A discrete complex that allows for swift manufacturing of ships.

hut.description: Kartoosh is a large spaceborne CIS shipyard. The discreet complex rapidly builds Separatista warships away from obvious industrial centers. Concealment and production speed are its entire strategic profit.

Planet.name: Castilion
Planet.description: Castilion is an ocean planet while also having tropical warm weather. There are underwater facilities under the ocean. However, the sea life of Castilion are leviathan in size and highly aggressive.

pl.description: Castilion jest ciepłym, tropikalnym światem oceanicznym. Pod powierzchnią morza działają rozbudowane instalacje, które muszą wytrzymywać ciśnienie i ataki miejscowej fauny. Żyjące w oceanach stworzenia osiągają rozmiary lewiatanów i są wyjątkowo agresywne, dlatego każda podwodna działalność wymaga silnych zabezpieczeń.

en.description: Castilion is an ocean planet while also having tropical warm weather. There are underwater facilities under the ocean. However, the sea life of Castilion are leviathan in size and highly aggressive.

hut.description: Castilion is a warm tropica ocean-world with facilities beneath the sea. Native life reaches leviathan size and is highly aggressive. Every underwater operation requires strong walls, constant watch, and expensive protection.

Planet.name: Blood Gulch
Planet.description: Blood Gulch is a campaign adaptation of the enclosed canyon battlefield recorded on Installation 04 rather than a canonical Halo planet. Its usable terrain consists of a dry basin enclosed by high rock walls, with sparse vegetation, caves and separated military structures controlling the few practical approaches. No permanent planetary population, natural resource base or independent political history is documented. In campaign terms its importance is tactical: the canyon offers defensible positions, short supply lines and limited avenues of advance, but little verified civilian infrastructure.

pl.description: Blood Gulch jest kampanijną adaptacją zamkniętego pola walki w kanionie znanego z Instalacji 04, a nie kanoniczną planetą Halo. Suchą nieckę otaczają wysokie ściany skalne, skąpa roślinność, jaskinie i oddzielone instalacje wojskowe kontrolujące nieliczne podejścia. Nie ma stałej ludności ani samodzielnej historii politycznej. Znaczenie obszaru jest czysto taktyczne: sprzyja obronie, skraca zaopatrzenie i ogranicza kierunki natarcia.

en.description: Blood Gulch is a campaign adaptation of the enclosed canyon battlefield recorded on Installation 04 rather than a canonical Halo planet. Its usable terrain consists of a dry basin enclosed by high rock walls, with sparse vegetation, caves and separated military structures controlling the few practical approaches. No permanent planetary population, natural resource base or independent political history is documented. In campaign terms its importance is tactical: the canyon offers defensible positions, short supply lines and limited avenues of advance, but little verified civilian infrastructure.

hut.description: Blood Gulch adapts the enclosed canyon battlefield of Installation 04 rather than a canonical Halo planet. High walls, caves, sparse growth, and separated bases control a few approaches. It has no permanent population or economy; its value is purely tactical—short supply lines and defensible ground.

Planet.name: Delphania
Planet.description: Dalphania is a colorful planet of red and deep valleys. The fauna is diverse and the native trees can grow to be very large. The lakes are shallow, but there are many of them.

pl.description: Delphania jest barwnym, czerwonawym światem głębokich dolin, licznych płytkich jezior i ogromnych rodzimych drzew. Zróżnicowana fauna korzysta z mozaiki wodnych oraz leśnych siedlisk. Naturalne bogactwo stanowi główną cechę planety, podczas gdy jej gospodarka i historia polityczna pozostają słabo opisane.

en.description: Dalphania is a colorful planet of red and deep valleys. The fauna is diverse and the native trees can grow to be very large. The lakes are shallow, but there are many of them.

hut.description: Delphania is a colorful red world of deep valleys, many shallow lakes, immense native trees, and varied fauna. Its mosaic of water and forest is the chief known wealth; economy and political history remain poorly recorded.

Planet.name: Pam'ba
Planet.description: Pam'ba's climate was diverse due to its carrying terrestrial biomes. Marshlands, rainforests, tall and dry mountains, or deserts that lined the equator.

pl.description: Pam'ba ma wyjątkowo zróżnicowany klimat dzięki licznym biomom lądowym. Występują tam mokradła, lasy deszczowe, wysokie suche góry oraz pustynie biegnące wzdłuż równika. Ta mozaika środowisk sprzyja bogatej biosferze, lecz wymaga od osadnictwa dostosowania infrastruktury do skrajnie różnych warunków.

en.description: Pam'ba's climate was diverse due to its carrying terrestrial biomes. Marshlands, rainforests, tall and dry mountains, or deserts that lined the equator.

hut.description: Pam'ba contains marshes, rainforests, tall dry mountains, and equatorial deserts. This diversity supports rich life but forces settlements to maintain different infrastructure for radically different environments.

Planet.name: Codia
Planet.description: A desolate planet with 2 moons. The first is tidally locked to the star, and the second of which is covered in forests and moss.

pl.description: Codia jest opustoszałą planetą posiadającą dwa księżyce. Pierwszy pozostaje pływowo związany z gwiazdą, natomiast drugi pokrywają lasy i mchy. Kontrast pomiędzy jałowym światem a zielonym satelitą nadaje układowi wartość badawczą, choć dostępne źródła nie wskazują trwałego osadnictwa ani rozwiniętej gospodarki.

en.description: A desolate planet with 2 moons. The first is tidally locked to the star, and the second of which is covered in forests and moss.

hut.description: Codia is a desolate world with two moons. One is tidally locked to the star; the other carries forests and moss. The contrast offers scientific interest, but records name no lasting settlement or developed market.

Planet.name: Xala
Planet.description: Xala is a poorly surveyed world in Wild Space. Available galactic records identify the system and describe a nearby moon, but they do not establish that the planet shares that satellite's environment. No dependable account gives Xala's surface conditions, permanent population, major settlements or exploitable resources during the Clone Wars. The campaign archive therefore preserves it as a distinct independent world without transferring facts from another body. Its history before the present conflict remains fragmentary, and its strategic relevance follows from its remote position and connected hyperspace routes.

pl.description: Xala jest słabo rozpoznanym, niezależnym światem Dzikiej Przestrzeni. Rejestry potwierdzają układ i pobliski księżyc, lecz nie pozwalają przenosić jego cech na planetę. Brakuje wiarygodnych danych o powierzchni, ludności, osadach i zasobach z epoki Wojen Klonów. Znaczenie Xali wynika z odległego położenia i połączonych tras nadprzestrzennych, a wcześniejsza historia pozostaje fragmentaryczna.

en.description: Xala is a poorly surveyed world in Wild Space. Available galactic records identify the system and describe a nearby moon, but they do not establish that the planet shares that satellite's environment. No dependable account gives Xala's surface conditions, permanent population, major settlements or exploitable resources during the Clone Wars. The campaign archive therefore preserves it as a distinct independent world without transferring facts from another body. Its history before the present conflict remains fragmentary, and its strategic relevance follows from its remote position and connected hyperspace routes.

hut.description: Xala is a poorly surveyed independent world in Wild Space. Records confirm the system and nearby moon but not shared conditions. Surface, population, resources, and earlier history remain unknown. Remote position and connected hyperspace routes define its present strategic value.

Planet.name: Batuu
Planet.description: A world of lush forests and mountains, it is a known CIS smuggling hub. It is believed there are hidden CIS factories in the world as well. There is an old abandoned Jedi planet on the world as well. The plantation here comes from all around the galaxy.

pl.description: Batuu jest światem bujnych lasów i gór, wykorzystywanym przez CIS jako ośrodek przemytu. Wywiad podejrzewa istnienie ukrytych fabryk Separatystów. Na planecie znajduje się również opuszczona świątynia Jedi, a miejscowa roślinność pochodzi z wielu zakątków galaktyki. Połączenie tajnej produkcji, nielegalnego handlu i dawnych ruin zwiększa znaczenie świata.

en.description: A world of lush forests and mountains, it is a known CIS smuggling hub. It is believed there are hidden CIS factories in the world as well. There is an old abandoned Jedi planet on the world as well. The plantation here comes from all around the galaxy.

hut.description: Batuu is a lush mountain-and-forest world used as a CIS smuggling hub, with suspected hidden factories. An abandoned Jedi temple and plant life gathered from across the galaxy add historical and biological value. Secret production, shadow trade, and ruins share one world.

Planet.name: Seatos
Planet.description: Seatos is a verdant world of broad oceans and dense forests distinguished by their red foliage. On a coastal cliff stands an ancient henge built around a mechanism associated with an old star map, making the otherwise quiet planet significant to archaeologists and Force traditions. Canon material does not provide a Clone Wars-era census or a developed export economy, so its population and commercial resources remain unknown. Later events connected with the henge are outside the campaign period and are not treated as part of the planet's current history.

pl.description: Seatos jest zielonym światem rozległych oceanów i gęstych lasów o czerwonych liściach. Na nadmorskim urwisku stoi starożytny krąg otaczający mechanizm związany z dawną mapą gwiezdną, ważny dla archeologów i tradycji Mocy. Źródła nie podają spisu ludności ani rozwiniętej gospodarki z epoki Wojen Klonów. Późniejsze wydarzenia nie należą do obecnego okresu kampanii.

en.description: Seatos is a verdant world of broad oceans and dense forests distinguished by their red foliage. On a coastal cliff stands an ancient henge built around a mechanism associated with an old star map, making the otherwise quiet planet significant to archaeologists and Force traditions. Canon material does not provide a Clone Wars-era census or a developed export economy, so its population and commercial resources remain unknown. Later events connected with the henge are outside the campaign period and are not treated as part of the planet's current history.

hut.description: Seatos is a verdant world of broad oceans and red-leaf forests. An ancient coastal henge surrounds a mechanism tied to an old star map, giving the quiet planet value to archaeologists and Force traditions. Clone Wars population and economy remain unknown; later events lie outside the campaign.

Planet.name: Bakura
Planet.description: This is an agricultural and mining planet with great plains and high mountain ranges. There are only 3 continents with tons of plantations in the west and the mines in the east. Away from the mining there are factories that are integral to the production of repulsorlift coils (giving vehicles the ability to hover). The main city, Salis D'aar, is a massive circular city at the center of the planet.

pl.description: Bakura jest światem rolniczym i górniczym o rozległych równinach oraz wysokich pasmach górskich. Trzy kontynenty dzielą się na zachodnie plantacje i wschodnie kopalnie. Fabryki wytwarzają kluczowe cewki repulsorowe dla pojazdów. Stolicę Salis D'aar zbudowano jako olbrzymie koliste miasto w centrum planety, skupiające administrację i przemysł.

en.description: This is an agricultural and mining planet with great plains and high mountain ranges. There are only 3 continents with tons of plantations in the west and the mines in the east. Away from the mining there are factories that are integral to the production of repulsorlift coils (giving vehicles the ability to hover). The main city, Salis D'aar, is a massive circular city at the center of the planet.

hut.description: Bakura is an agricultural and mining world of plains and high mountains. Western plantations, eastern mines, and factories producing vital repulsorlift coils divide its three continents. The immense circular capital Salis D'aar anchors administration and industry.

Planet.name: Dalna
Planet.description: This small planet orbits two suns. Due to the suns, anyone not used to living on this planet will feel sun sickness. Also the weather is very unstable with flooding rains. From orbit the planet is bright blue and white. The planet’s population relies upon agriculture for their economy.

pl.description: Dalna jest niewielką planetą krążącą wokół dwóch słońc. Przybysze cierpią na chorobę słoneczną, a niestabilna pogoda przynosi gwałtowne deszcze i powodzie. Z orbity świat wydaje się jasnoniebieski i biały. Mieszkańcy opierają gospodarkę na rolnictwie, które musi radzić sobie zarówno z nadmiarem światła, jak i nieprzewidywalną wodą.

en.description: This small planet orbits two suns. Due to the suns, anyone not used to living on this planet will feel sun sickness. Also the weather is very unstable with flooding rains. From orbit the planet is bright blue and white. The planet’s population relies upon agriculture for their economy.

hut.description: Dalna circles two suns, causing sun sickness in unadapted visitors. Unstable weather brings flooding rain, while the world appears blue and white from orbit. Agriculture sustains the population despite excessive light and unpredictable water.

Planet.name: Ponemah
Planet.description: Another sand planet near the likes of Ogem and Jakku. On the southern pole there are constant electromagnetic storms and sandworms.

pl.description: Ponemah jest kolejnym piaszczystym światem w pobliżu Ogem i Jakku. Wokół południowego bieguna nieustannie szaleją burze elektromagnetyczne, a pod wydmami żyją piaskowe robaki. Połączenie zakłóceń energetycznych i agresywnej fauny czyni południe szczególnie niebezpiecznym dla transportu, osadnictwa i pracy badawczej.

en.description: Another sand planet near the likes of Ogem and Jakku. On the southern pole there are constant electromagnetic storms and sandworms.

hut.description: Ponemah is a sand-world near Ogem and Jakku. Constant electromagnetic storms rage at the southern pole, where sandworms move beneath the dunes. Energy interference and dangerous fauna make the region costly for travel, settlement, and research.

Planet.name: Cerea
Planet.description: Cerea is relatively underdeveloped technologically speaking. As such the planet is lush farmland, green, and mountains. It is the home world of the Cerean species who are intelligent due to their complex brain formations.

pl.description: Cerea pozostaje technologicznie słabo rozwinięta, dzięki czemu zachowała bujne pola uprawne, zielone krajobrazy i góry. Jest ojczyzną Cerean, których złożona budowa mózgu sprzyja wysokiej inteligencji. Miejscowa kultura i gospodarka opierają się bardziej na rolnictwie oraz tradycji niż na ciężkim przemyśle.

en.description: Cerea is relatively underdeveloped technologically speaking. As such the planet is lush farmland, green, and mountains. It is the home world of the Cerean species who are intelligent due to their complex brain formations.

hut.description: Cerea is technologically restrained, preserving farmland, green landscapes, and mountains. It is home to the highly intelligent Cereans, whose complex brains shape their society. Agriculture and tradition matter more than heavy industry.

Planet.name: Akiva
Planet.description: A lush jungle planet controlled by the CIS. This planet has multiple large underground droid construction facilities producing B-1 and B-2 Battle Droids, however it is possible a hidden BX Construction Facility is on this planet. Myrra, the Planet’s Capital, was built over a maze of catacombs. Inside of these underground temples is an old Jedi Temple, a Sith Trap, and Hutt Breeding Grounds, not to mention another active Droid Factory.

pl.description: Akiva jest bujną planetą dżunglową kontrolowaną przez CIS. Pod powierzchnią działają wielkie fabryki droidów B-1 i B-2, a wywiad podejrzewa również tajną linię BX. Stolica Myrra stoi nad labiryntem katakumb mieszczących dawną świątynię Jedi, pułapkę Sithów, huttiańskie lęgowiska i kolejną czynną fabrykę. Warstwy ruin oraz produkcji czynią świat ważnym i niebezpiecznym celem.

en.description: A lush jungle planet controlled by the CIS. This planet has multiple large underground droid construction facilities producing B-1 and B-2 Battle Droids, however it is possible a hidden BX Construction Facility is on this planet. Myrra, the Planet’s Capital, was built over a maze of catacombs. Inside of these underground temples is an old Jedi Temple, a Sith Trap, and Hutt Breeding Grounds, not to mention another active Droid Factory.

hut.description: Akiva is a lush jungle world controlled by CIS. Underground factories build B-1 and B-2 droids, with a hidden BX line suspected. Beneath capital Myrra, catacombs hold a Jedi temple, Sith trap, Hutt breeding grounds, and another active factory. Ruins and production make one dangerous prize.

Planet.name: Rekelos
Planet.description: A large metropolis planet with densely populated cities. Its diverse citizens and communities creates a utopia for outcasts. Bounty hunters are also often found here looking for work wherever possible. A cold planet always shrouded by clouds but always bright because of the neon lights

pl.description: Rekelos jest chłodnym światem-metropolią, którego gęsto zaludnione miasta pozostają stale spowite chmurami, lecz rozświetlone neonami. Różnorodność mieszkańców uczyniła planetę schronieniem dla wyrzutków. Łowcy nagród chętnie poszukują tu zleceń, korzystając z anonimowości tłumu i nieustannego zapotrzebowania na dyskretne usługi.

en.description: A large metropolis planet with densely populated cities. Its diverse citizens and communities creates a utopia for outcasts. Bounty hunters are also often found here looking for work wherever possible. A cold planet always shrouded by clouds but always bright because of the neon lights

hut.description: Rekelos is a cold metropolis-world beneath permanent cloud and endless neon. Diverse communities offer refuge to outcasts, while bounty hunters find work in crowded streets. Anonymity and demand for discreet services drive its shadow economy.

Planet.name: Genetia
Planet.description: A purple temperate human world. The Genetians are known to be a very peaceful people protesting any military presence on their world.

pl.description: Genetia jest umiarkowanym, purpurowym światem zamieszkanym przez ludzi. Genetianie słyną z pokojowego usposobienia i aktywnie protestują przeciw każdej obecności wojskowej. Sprzeciw wobec garnizonów stanowi podstawową cechę ich politycznej tożsamości i utrudnia zewnętrznym mocarstwom wykorzystanie planety strategicznie.

en.description: A purple temperate human world. The Genetians are known to be a very peaceful people protesting any military presence on their world.

hut.description: Genetia is a purple mild-world of peaceful humans. Genetians protest any military presence, making opposition to garrisons central to political identity. Their stance sharply limits the planet's usefulness to outside powers.

Planet.name: Ephemera
Planet.description: A spa/resort world that has no solid ground. As such everything is built in the skies and all there is are skies and clouds. The cities are just large resorts where people come to relax and heal due to the gas in the atmosphere that has healing properties.

pl.description: Ephemera jest światem uzdrowiskowym pozbawionym stałego gruntu. Miasta i kurorty unoszą się pośród chmur, a atmosfera zawiera gazy o właściwościach leczniczych. Przybysze podróżują tu dla wypoczynku i rekonwalescencji. Cała gospodarka zależy od bezpiecznych platform powietrznych oraz utrzymania dostępu do naturalnych właściwości atmosfery.

en.description: A spa/resort world that has no solid ground. As such everything is built in the skies and all there is are skies and clouds. The cities are just large resorts where people come to relax and heal due to the gas in the atmosphere that has healing properties.

hut.description: Ephemera has no solid ground; cities and resorts float among clouds. Healing gases in the atmosphere attract visitors for rest and recovery. Tourism depends entirely on safe aerial platforms and preserving the world's natural remedy.

Planet.name: Polyneus
Planet.description: A backwater and primitive jungle planet with no strategic value. The sentient beings are tribal and live close with nature.

pl.description: Polyneus jest zacofanym, prymitywnym światem dżunglowym bez istotnego znaczenia strategicznego. Rozumni mieszkańcy żyją w społecznościach plemiennych, pozostając blisko związani z naturą. Brak rozwiniętej infrastruktury ogranicza handel i wpływy zewnętrzne, lecz pozwala zachować tradycyjny sposób życia.

en.description: A backwater and primitive jungle planet with no strategic value. The sentient beings are tribal and live close with nature.

hut.description: Polyneus is a primitive jungle backwater with little strategic value. Sentient tribes live close to nature, with scant infrastructure or outside trade. Isolation limits profit but preserves their traditional life.

Planet.name: Minfar
Planet.description: Minfar is the homeworld of the Zixon, a species whose communities extend through extensive underground passages and include the subterranean city of Ghikjil. The surviving accounts emphasize the inhabitants' close relationship with their world and their preference for life below the surface, but do not provide a dependable climate classification, census or catalogue of commercial resources.
