During the Clone Wars Minfar remains a little-known independent world. Its tunnels and native civilization are established facts; broader claims about the surface or later Imperial activity are excluded from the current campaign description.

pl.description: Minfar jest ojczyzną Zixonów, których społeczności rozciągają się przez rozległe podziemne przejścia i obejmują miasto Ghikjil. Źródła podkreślają więź mieszkańców z planetą oraz upodobanie do życia pod powierzchnią, lecz nie podają wiarygodnego klimatu, spisu ludności ani zasobów. W okresie Wojen Klonów pozostaje mało znanym światem niezależnym; potwierdzone są tunele i rodzima cywilizacja, nie późniejsza aktywność Imperium.

en.description: Minfar is the homeworld of the Zixon, a species whose communities extend through extensive underground passages and include the subterranean city of Ghikjil. The surviving accounts emphasize the inhabitants' close relationship with their world and their preference for life below the surface, but do not provide a dependable climate classification, census or catalogue of commercial resources. During the Clone Wars Minfar remains a little-known independent world. Its tunnels and native civilization are established facts; broader claims about the surface or later Imperial activity are excluded from the current campaign description.

hut.description: Minfar is the Zixon homeworld, with communities spread through vast tunnels and the underground city Ghikjil. Records confirm native civilization and preference for life below, but not climate, census, or trade resources. It remains a little-known independent world; later Imperial activity lies outside the campaign.

Planet.name: Patrolia
Planet.description: Patrolia is the aquatic home world of the fishlike Patrolians. As a water world most settlements are under water except for a few floating cities for visitors. The underwater cities do have breathable atmosphere inside many interconnected buildings.

pl.description: Patrolia jest oceaniczną ojczyzną rybopodobnych Patrolian. Większość osad znajduje się pod wodą i składa się z połączonych, wypełnionych zdatną do oddychania atmosferą budynków. Dla przybyszów utrzymywane są nieliczne pływające miasta. Dwupoziomowa infrastruktura pozwala mieszkańcom zachować wodny tryb życia i prowadzić handel z gatunkami lądowymi.

en.description: Patrolia is the aquatic home world of the fishlike Patrolians. As a water world most settlements are under water except for a few floating cities for visitors. The underwater cities do have breathable atmosphere inside many interconnected buildings.

hut.description: Patrolia is the aquatic home of the fishlike Patrolians. Most settlements are connected breathable buildings beneath the sea, while a few floating cities receive visitors. This two-level koona supports native life and offworld trade.

Planet.name: Montross
Planet.description: Located in the mid rim territories. Host to sky cities similar to Bespin. The atmosphere is thin, but still breathable. Often used for military flight academies.

pl.description: Montross leży w Środkowych Rubieżach i posiada podniebne miasta podobne do zabudowy Bespina. Atmosfera jest rozrzedzona, lecz nadal zdatna do oddychania. Warunki oraz infrastruktura lotnicza sprawiają, że planeta często mieści wojskowe akademie pilotażu, nadając jej znaczenie szkoleniowe i strategiczne.

en.description: Located in the mid rim territories. Host to sky cities similar to Bespin. The atmosphere is thin, but still breathable. Often used for military flight academies.

hut.description: Montross is a Mid Rim world of sky cities resembling Bespin. Its thin air remains breathable, and aerial infrastructure supports military flight academies. Training value gives the planet strategic importance.

Planet.name: Tirahnn
Planet.description: A warm trade world of forests and mountains, Tirahnn is famous for its grand bazaars. The planet is ruled by the merchant princes and attracts many rich tourists to its markets. As a major trade nexus it is valuable to all the major Galactic Powers.

pl.description: Tirahnn jest ciepłym światem handlowym lasów i gór, słynącym z rozległych bazarów. Rządzą nim książęta kupieccy, a zamożni turyści przybywają po towary i rozrywkę. Jako ważny węzeł wymiany planeta ma znaczenie dla wszystkich głównych potęg galaktycznych, które zabiegają o dostęp do jej rynków.

en.description: A warm trade world of forests and mountains, Tirahnn is famous for its grand bazaars. The planet is ruled by the merchant princes and attracts many rich tourists to its markets. As a major trade nexus it is valuable to all the major Galactic Powers.

hut.description: Tirahnn is a warm trade world of forests, mountains, and grand bazaars. Merchant princes rule while wealthy travelers fill the markets. As a major nexus, it offers valuable access to every galactic power.

Planet.name: Uviuy Exen
Planet.description: A moderately populated temperate world it has many ancient ruins from the Alsakan wars. It also hosts some major Republic fortresses acting as a defensive world against any CIS incursion into the core.

pl.description: Uviuy Exen jest umiarkowanym, średnio zaludnionym światem, na którym zachowały się liczne ruiny z czasów wojen alsakańskich. Republika utrzymuje tam ważne fortyfikacje osłaniające podejścia do Rdzenia przed ewentualnym natarciem CIS. Dziedzictwo dawnych konfliktów współistnieje z nowoczesną rolą planety jako świata obronnego.

en.description: A moderately populated temperate world it has many ancient ruins from the Alsakan wars. It also hosts some major Republic fortresses acting as a defensive world against any CIS incursion into the core.

hut.description: Uviuy Exen is a moderately populated mild-world with ruins from the Alsakan conflicts. Major Republica fortresses defend approaches to the Core against CIS. Ancient war remains beside a modern defensive role.

Planet.name: Bandomeer
Planet.description: An agricultural and major mining planet, Bandomeer was laden with issues between the miners and the corporations running the mines due to mistreatment. The farming plots here were one of the most major resources of the Republic as this was the primary location for food made for the Grand Army of the Republic and her Clone Troopers. "The planet-wide farms provide a crucial service for the Republic... Without us, clone troopers across the galaxy would starve from lack of rations."

pl.description: Bandomeer jest ważnym światem rolniczym i górniczym, lecz stosunki między pracownikami a korporacjami pozostają napięte z powodu złego traktowania górników. Planetarne gospodarstwa należą do kluczowych źródeł żywności dla Wielkiej Armii Republiki i jej klonów. Bez ich produkcji zaopatrzenie frontów w racje zostałoby poważnie zagrożone, co nadaje miejscowemu rolnictwu znaczenie strategiczne.

en.description: An agricultural and major mining planet, Bandomeer was laden with issues between the miners and the corporations running the mines due to mistreatment. The farming plots here were one of the most major resources of the Republic as this was the primary location for food made for the Grand Army of the Republic and her Clone Troopers. "The planet-wide farms provide a crucial service for the Republic... Without us, clone troopers across the galaxy would starve from lack of rations."

hut.description: Bandomeer is a major farming and mining world troubled by corporate abuse of workers. Its planetwide farms provide crucial rations to the Grand Army and clone troopers. Without them, Republica supply lines would face hunger, making agriculture a strategic asset.

Planet.name: Bonadan
Planet.description: Bonadan was a planet in the Corporate Sector and the primary world in the Bonadan system at the end of the Hydian Way, boasting ten large spaceports. The densely populated planet housed many exotic species from around the galaxy. Bonadanians found off-world were either from wealthy corporate families or those that had escaped the life of corporate servitude.

pl.description: Bonadan jest głównym światem swego układu w Sektorze Korporacyjnym, położonym na końcu Hydian Way i wyposażonym w dziesięć wielkich portów kosmicznych. Gęsto zaludnioną planetę zamieszkują liczne egzotyczne gatunki. Bonadanie spotykani poza światem pochodzą zwykle z bogatych rodzin korporacyjnych albo należą do tych, którym udało się uciec od życia w korporacyjnej zależności.

en.description: Bonadan was a planet in the Corporate Sector and the primary world in the Bonadan system at the end of the Hydian Way, boasting ten large spaceports. The densely populated planet housed many exotic species from around the galaxy. Bonadanians found off-world were either from wealthy corporate families or those that had escaped the life of corporate servitude.

hut.description: Bonadan is the primary world of its Corporate Sector system at the end of the Hydian Way, with ten great spaceports. Dense cities host species from across the galaxy. Offworld Bonadanians are usually corporate heirs—or people who escaped corporate servitude.

Planet.name: Corsin
Planet.description: A warm world known for its swoop races, Corsin is a fortress world of the Republic historically used by the Judicial Forces and the Jedi. Now it serves as bulwark against the CIS and a staging ground for Republic assaults. Corsin is also a retreat world with a series of tropical islands that are a gambling hot spot. RSB agents like to use these Casinos for meetings as they are great for privacy while having tight Republic security.

pl.description: Corsin jest ciepłym światem-twierdzą Republiki, historycznie wykorzystywanym przez Siły Sądowe i Jedi. Obecnie osłania region przed CIS oraz służy jako punkt wyjściowy republikańskich ofensyw. Tropikalne wyspy, kasyna i wyścigi ścigaczy czynią go także popularnym miejscem wypoczynku. Agenci RSB wykorzystują silnie chronione kasyna do dyskretnych spotkań, łącząc prywatność z republikańskim bezpieczeństwem.

en.description: A warm world known for its swoop races, Corsin is a fortress world of the Republic historically used by the Judicial Forces and the Jedi. Now it serves as bulwark against the CIS and a staging ground for Republic assaults. Corsin is also a retreat world with a series of tropical islands that are a gambling hot spot. RSB agents like to use these Casinos for meetings as they are great for privacy while having tight Republic security.

hut.description: Corsin is a warm Republica fortress once used by Judicial Forces and Jedi. It now shields the region from CIS and stages assaults. Tropical islands, casinos, and swoop races also make it a retreat. RSB agents favor secure casinos for private meetings where pleasure and state protection share one table.

Planet.name: Mikkia
Planet.description: Mikkia has both Icy polar regions and tropical equatorial regions. It is the home world of the Mikkians and a loyal member of the Republic. There are a few cities and some farm land but it is not too heavily populated. The main industry in the world is mining red ore.

pl.description: Mikkia łączy lodowe obszary polarne z tropikalnym pasem równikowym. Jest ojczyzną Mikkian i lojalnym członkiem Republiki. Nieliczne miasta oraz pola uprawne obsługują niezbyt liczną populację, natomiast podstawą gospodarki pozostaje wydobycie czerwonej rudy. Zróżnicowanie klimatu wymaga od osadnictwa odmiennych rozwiązań w zależności od szerokości geograficznej.

en.description: Mikkia has both Icy polar regions and tropical equatorial regions. It is the home world of the Mikkians and a loyal member of the Republic. There are a few cities and some farm land but it is not too heavily populated. The main industry in the world is mining red ore.

hut.description: Mikkia combines icy poles with a tropica equator. Home to the Mikkians and loyal to Republica, it supports a modest population in a few cities and farming zones. Red ore mining drives the chief market, while settlement must adapt to sharply divided climates.

Planet.name: Daalang
Planet.description: Large planet shaped asteroids have enough atmosphere to house life. Though the surface is still just space rock with scattered cities.

pl.description: Daalang tworzą wielkie asteroidy o rozmiarach zbliżonych do planet, zdolne utrzymać atmosferę i życie. Ich powierzchnie pozostają jednak niemal nagą skałą kosmiczną, pośród której rozrzucono pojedyncze miasta. Osadnictwo zależy od lokalnych kieszeni atmosfery, infrastruktury podtrzymującej życie oraz sprawnego transportu pomiędzy oddzielonymi ośrodkami.

en.description: Large planet shaped asteroids have enough atmosphere to house life. Though the surface is still just space rock with scattered cities.

hut.description: Daalang consists of planet-sized asteroids able to hold air and life. Their surfaces remain bare space rock dotted by scattered cities. Settlement depends on atmospheric pockets, life-support koona, and reliable transport between isolated urban centers.

Planet.name: Daiyu
Planet.description: An urbanized city planet for the lowest and most cut throat criminals. There is a planetwide jammer that does not allow any communication in or out to protect the criminals that live on world. Many fugitives call Daiyu their home.

pl.description: Daiyu jest całkowicie zurbanizowanym światem przestępczym, przyciągającym najbrutalniejszych przedstawicieli galaktycznego półświatka. Planetarny system zakłócający blokuje łączność przychodzącą i wychodzącą, chroniąc mieszkańców przed wykryciem. Liczni zbiegowie traktują Daiyu jako bezpieczną przystań, a anonimowość oraz brak skutecznej kontroli stanowią podstawę miejscowej gospodarki.

en.description: An urbanized city planet for the lowest and most cut throat criminals. There is a planetwide jammer that does not allow any communication in or out to protect the criminals that live on world. Many fugitives call Daiyu their home.

hut.description: Daiyu is an urban crime-world sheltering the galaxy's most ruthless fugitives. A planetwide jammer blocks all outside communication and protects those hiding below. Anonymity, silence, and weak law are the services upon which its shadow economy is built.

Planet.name: Antar
Planet.description: Antar is a gas giant with no inhabitants. Antar 4, one of the gas giant’s moons, is home to the Gotal hunters. This moon was a planet on its own. Due to orbiting the gas giant the seasons varied wildly, the magnetism of the planet is extremely strong and can mess with a being's abilities and tech not properly tuned to it. The world moon is water rich with mostly plains.

pl.description: Antar jest niezamieszkanym gazowym olbrzymem. Jego księżyc Antar 4, niegdyś samodzielna planeta, stanowi ojczyznę łowców Gotal. Silny magnetyzm zakłóca nieprzystosowaną technologię oraz zdolności zmysłowe mieszkańców, a nietypowa orbita powoduje gwałtowne zmiany pór roku. Bogaty w wodę księżyc pokrywają głównie równiny, na których koncentruje się osadnictwo.

en.description: Antar is a gas giant with no inhabitants. Antar 4, one of the gas giant’s moons, is home to the Gotal hunters. This moon was a planet on its own. Due to orbiting the gas giant the seasons varied wildly, the magnetism of the planet is extremely strong and can mess with a being's abilities and tech not properly tuned to it. The world moon is water rich with mostly plains.

hut.description: Antar is an uninhabited gas giant. Antar 4, once a free planet, is home to Gotal hunters. Powerful magnetism disrupts uncalibrated machines and senses, while its orbit causes extreme seasons. Water-rich plains provide the moon's principal settlement ground.

Planet.name: Exodeen
Planet.description: Exodeen is in the Colonies regions of the Galaxy, Grid Square M-12, along two separate trade routes, Hydian Way and the Nanth’ri Trade Route. Homeworld of the Exodeenians a non-humanoid species that had six arms, six legs and six rows of uneven teeth. The planet has a very dense jungle environment with sparse plains, it features a breathable atmosphere with noticeably high humidity with often long and wet seasons known to the locals as “Daksheshn” which featured heavy rain. The Exodeenians live on the vertical cliff faces commonly found across the planet, adapting the extra limbs for ease of mobility within the environment and extra teeth to crack open the fruit of the Quillvaxia trees.

pl.description: Exodeen leży przy Hydian Way i Nanth'ri Trade Route w Koloniach. Gęstą, wilgotną dżunglę nawiedzają długie pory deszczowe zwane Daksheshn. Sześcioręcy i sześcionodzy Exodeenianie mieszkają na pionowych urwiskach, wykorzystując budowę ciała do sprawnego poruszania się. Sześć rzędów zębów pozwala im rozłupywać owoce drzew Quillvaxia. Środowisko i anatomia ukształtowały tu jedną, ściśle powiązaną kulturę.

en.description: Exodeen is in the Colonies regions of the Galaxy, Grid Square M-12, along two separate trade routes, Hydian Way and the Nanth’ri Trade Route. Homeworld of the Exodeenians a non-humanoid species that had six arms, six legs and six rows of uneven teeth. The planet has a very dense jungle environment with sparse plains, it features a breathable atmosphere with noticeably high humidity with often long and wet seasons known to the locals as “Daksheshn” which featured heavy rain. The Exodeenians live on the vertical cliff faces commonly found across the planet, adapting the extra limbs for ease of mobility within the environment and extra teeth to crack open the fruit of the Quillvaxia trees.

hut.description: Exodeen lies on Hydian Way and Nanth'ri Trade Route. Dense humid jungle endures long wet Daksheshn seasons. Six-armed, six-legged Exodeenians live on cliff faces, using their limbs for movement and many teeth to crack Quillvaxia fruit. Biology and terrain form one adapted society.

Planet.name: Chardaan
Planet.description: Chardaan is located in the Inner Rim Territories the Galaxy, Grid Square N-14, it used to be in Grid Square N-13, along two separate trade routes, Shipwrights' Trace and Hydian Way. Chardaan is not actually a planet but an astronomical object, likely a rogue planet, ejected from its home star centuries ago and came to rest in its current position, although study shows it is slowly moving towards the galactic center at a rate of 1 AU per 100 years. Despite not having a home star the planet does house a thriving population. The planet is a swamp jungle environment however it is almost entirely pitch black as having no home star to illuminate its surface the planet's flora and inhabitants have adapted to life without light, either going blind or creating their own light to attract prey. Be wary of large carnivorous plants on its surface. However the planet does feature some form of relief with a breathable atmosphere. Chardaan Shipyards are located here. Chardaan is the headquarters for the Republic 16th Sector Army and the capital of the Pallis Oversector.

pl.description: Chardaan jest planetą samotną, wyrzuconą przed wiekami z macierzystego układu i powoli dryfującą ku centrum galaktyki. Bez gwiazdy powierzchnia pozostaje niemal całkowicie ciemna; bagienna dżungla, drapieżne rośliny i mieszkańcy przystosowali się do życia bez światła. Planeta posiada zdatną do oddychania atmosferę, stocznie oraz liczną ludność. Jest kwaterą 16. Armii Sektorowej Republiki i stolicą Pallis Oversector.

en.description: Chardaan is located in the Inner Rim Territories the Galaxy, Grid Square N-14, it used to be in Grid Square N-13, along two separate trade routes, Shipwrights' Trace and Hydian Way. Chardaan is not actually a planet but an astronomical object, likely a rogue planet, ejected from its home star centuries ago and came to rest in its current position, although study shows it is slowly moving towards the galactic center at a rate of 1 AU per 100 years. Despite not having a home star the planet does house a thriving population. The planet is a swamp jungle environment however it is almost entirely pitch black as having no home star to illuminate its surface the planet's flora and inhabitants have adapted to life without light, either going blind or creating their own light to attract prey. Be wary of large carnivorous plants on its surface. However the planet does feature some form of relief with a breathable atmosphere. Chardaan Shipyards are located here. Chardaan is the headquarters for the Republic 16th Sector Army and the capital of the Pallis Oversector.

hut.description: Chardaan is a rogue planet cast from its star and drifting toward the galactic center. Its lightless swamp-jungle holds blind or luminous life and dangerous carnivorous plants. Despite darkness, breathable air supports population, shipyards, the Republica 16th Sector Army headquarters, and the Pallis Oversector capital.

Planet.name: Kira
Planet.description: The uninhabitable planet holds no real value for resources. It’s an empty world filled with raw materials, but too hard to extract and refine on the surface.

pl.description: Kira jest niezdatnym do zamieszkania światem bez łatwo dostępnej wartości gospodarczej. Występują tam surowce, lecz warunki powierzchniowe czynią ich wydobycie i rafinację nadmiernie trudnymi oraz kosztownymi. Bez przełomu technologicznego planeta pozostaje pustym rezerwuarem materiałów, którego potencjał nie uzasadnia inwestycji.

en.description: The uninhabitable planet holds no real value for resources. It’s an empty world filled with raw materials, but too hard to extract and refine on the surface.

hut.description: Kira is uninhabitable and offers no practical profit. Raw materials exist, but surface conditions make extraction and refining prohibitively difficult. Without new technology, it remains an empty reserve whose cost exceeds its value.

Planet.name: Pax
Planet.description: Pax is a Gas Giant with many industrial floating Cities and massive space stations going around it. It provides the CIS with much needed Tibbanna Gas serving as a vital refueling station in the region. This makes Pax key to any Naval actions in nearby sectors.

pl.description: Pax jest gazowym olbrzymem otoczonym przemysłowymi miastami unoszącymi się w atmosferze oraz wielkimi stacjami orbitalnymi. Dostarcza CIS niezbędnego gazu tibanna i pełni funkcję kluczowego punktu tankowania. Kontrola nad Paxem ma zasadnicze znaczenie dla działań flot w sąsiednich sektorach, ponieważ wpływa bezpośrednio na ich zasięg i tempo operacyjne.

en.description: Pax is a Gas Giant with many industrial floating Cities and massive space stations going around it. It provides the CIS with much needed Tibbanna Gas serving as a vital refueling station in the region. This makes Pax key to any Naval actions in nearby sectors.

hut.description: Pax is a gas giant ringed by floating industrial cities and great stations. It supplies vital tibanna to CIS and serves as a regional refueling point. Whoever controls Pax controls the endurance and tempo of nearby fleets.

Planet.name: Tibrin
Planet.description: An aquatic planet where the waters are phosphorescent and have skyscraper coral reefs. All cities were either underwater or embedded into the coral reef.

pl.description: Tibrin jest planetą oceaniczną o fosforyzujących wodach i olbrzymich rafach koralowych przypominających wieżowce. Wszystkie miasta znajdują się pod powierzchnią albo zostały wbudowane w koralowe struktury. Światło biologiczne i pionowe rafy kształtują architekturę, transport oraz codzienne życie miejscowej cywilizacji.

en.description: An aquatic planet where the waters are phosphorescent and have skyscraper coral reefs. All cities were either underwater or embedded into the coral reef.

hut.description: Tibrin is an ocean-world of glowing water and skyscraper coral reefs. Every city lies underwater or within the coral itself. Living light and vertical reefs shape architecture, travel, and daily life.

Planet.name: Nevarro
Planet.description: A world of purely black sands and ashen wastelands. Rocky and flat hills that were enveloped in lava lakes and streams. The population lived in the between the lava/ashen fields and the mountains of now dead volcanoes. Their homes are thrown together with white cement in contrast to the blackened ground.

pl.description: Nevarro pokrywają czarne piaski, popielne pustkowia oraz płaskie skaliste wzgórza przecięte jeziorami i strumieniami lawy. Ludność mieszka pomiędzy polami wulkanicznymi a górami wygasłych wulkanów. Jasne domy z prowizorycznie łączonego cementu wyraźnie odcinają się od sczerniałego podłoża, świadcząc o przystosowaniu osadników do surowego środowiska.

en.description: A world of purely black sands and ashen wastelands. Rocky and flat hills that were enveloped in lava lakes and streams. The population lived in the between the lava/ashen fields and the mountains of now dead volcanoes. Their homes are thrown together with white cement in contrast to the blackened ground.

hut.description: Nevarro is a world of black sand, ash, flat rock, and flowing lava. People settle between volcanic fields and dead volcano mountains. Rough white-cement homes stand sharply against the dark ground, showing stubborn adaptation to a severe land.

Planet.name: Vondarc
Planet.description: Vondarc is a separatist aligned world and home base of the Malevolence Subjugator-class heavy cruiser. It is a calm temperate world of oceans, and forests with many modern cities.

pl.description: Vondarc jest światem sprzymierzonym z Separatystami i bazą ciężkiego krążownika Malevolence typu Subjugator. Poza znaczeniem wojskowym pozostaje spokojną, umiarkowaną planetą oceanów, lasów i licznych nowoczesnych miast. Kontrast pomiędzy łagodnym krajobrazem a obecnością potężnej jednostki CIS nadaje mu wyjątkową rolę strategiczną.

en.description: Vondarc is a separatist aligned world and home base of the Malevolence Subjugator-class heavy cruiser. It is a calm temperate world of oceans, and forests with many modern cities.

hut.description: Vondarc is Separatista-aligned and home base of the Subjugator-class Malevolence. Beyond mala value, it is a calm mild-world of oceans, forests, and modern cities. Peaceful land and a feared warship create a striking strategic contrast.

Planet.name: Steergard
Planet.description: An industrialized astronomical object used for manufacturing naval parts. The air is heavily polluted due to the dense industrial factories spread across the planet. Living conditions are known to be unforgiving, yet the planet’s government does nothing to improve them, as it reaps the wealth generated by manufacturing.

pl.description: Steergard jest uprzemysłowionym obiektem astronomicznym produkującym części dla okrętów. Gęsta sieć fabryk silnie zanieczyszcza atmosferę, a warunki życia pozostają wyjątkowo ciężkie. Rząd nie podejmuje skutecznych działań naprawczych, ponieważ czerpie ogromne dochody z produkcji. Bogactwo administracji powstaje zatem bezpośrednio kosztem zdrowia mieszkańców i środowiska.

en.description: An industrialized astronomical object used for manufacturing naval parts. The air is heavily polluted due to the dense industrial factories spread across the planet. Living conditions are known to be unforgiving, yet the planet’s government does nothing to improve them, as it reaps the wealth generated by manufacturing.

hut.description: Steergard manufactures naval parts beneath heavily polluted air. Dense factories create brutal living conditions, yet the government refuses reform while collecting industrial wealth. Administrative profit is purchased with workers' health and the environment.

Planet.name: Tiferep
Planet.description: A planet with continental landmasses of grassy plains and thick deserts surrounded by oceans. The inhabitants are space faring but do not live in large cities but in more hut-like villages.

pl.description: Tiferep posiada kontynenty złożone z trawiastych równin i gęstych pustyń, otoczone rozległymi oceanami. Mieszkańcy opanowali podróże kosmiczne, lecz nie tworzą wielkich metropolii; żyją głównie w niewielkich osadach o zabudowie przypominającej chaty. Zaawansowana technologia współistnieje tu z rozproszonym, tradycyjnym modelem osadnictwa.

en.description: A planet with continental landmasses of grassy plains and thick deserts surrounded by oceans. The inhabitants are space faring but do not live in large cities but in more hut-like villages.

hut.description: Tiferep has continents of grassland and dense desert surrounded by ocean. Its spacefaring people avoid great cities and live in hut-like villages. Advanced travel and traditional dispersed settlement coexist.

Planet.name: Vandelhelm
Planet.description: A mining planet within the Vandelhelm Cloud. The planet is devoid of much plant life after thousands of years of mining the planet. The sky looks like a never ending rainbow from the space cloud the planet sits in.

pl.description: Vandelhelm jest planetą górniczą położoną w Obłoku Vandelhelm. Tysiące lat wydobycia niemal całkowicie pozbawiły ją roślinności. Otaczający obłok sprawia, że niebo przypomina niekończącą się tęczę, tworząc niezwykłe piękno ponad wyeksploatowanym krajobrazem. Gospodarka wciąż pozostaje zależna od zasobów, które doprowadziły środowisko do obecnego stanu.

en.description: A mining planet within the Vandelhelm Cloud. The planet is devoid of much plant life after thousands of years of mining the planet. The sky looks like a never ending rainbow from the space cloud the planet sits in.

hut.description: Vandelhelm is a mining world inside its namesake cloud. Millennia of extraction stripped most plant life, while the cloud paints an endless rainbow sky. Beauty hangs above exhausted land, and the economy remains tied to the resources that caused its decline.

Planet.name: Terminus
Planet.description: Terminus is a red desert world full of mesas, yet also has many long canals, and urban centers. A trading hub on the edge of known space, many unfamiliar spaceships are known to frequent Terminus. The architecture in its many urban centers is likewise exotic.

pl.description: Terminus jest czerwonym, pustynnym światem pełnym płaskowyżów, długich kanałów i ośrodków miejskich. Położenie na krańcu znanej przestrzeni uczyniło go ważnym węzłem handlu odwiedzanym przez nieznane konstrukcje statków. Egzotyczna architektura miast odzwierciedla różnorodność przybyszów i rolę planety jako bramy ku mniej poznanym regionom.

en.description: Terminus is a red desert world full of mesas, yet also has many long canals, and urban centers. A trading hub on the edge of known space, many unfamiliar spaceships are known to frequent Terminus. The architecture in its many urban centers is likewise exotic.

hut.description: Terminus is a red desert world of mesas, long canals, and cities. At the edge of known space, it receives unfamiliar ships and serves as a trade gateway. Exotic architecture reflects the diversity passing through its markets.

Planet.name: Anoat
Planet.description: Anoat is an ecumenopolis, a city wide planet, the capital of the sector, and the seat of the Nothoiin Noble court. It is a very industrial world with its fair share of slums, and toxic seas. The underworld of toxic sewers is a hub for all kinds of shady activity.

pl.description: Anoat jest ekumenopolis, stolicą sektora i siedzibą dworu szlacheckiego Nothoiin. Silnie uprzemysłowiona planeta posiada zarówno bogate dzielnice, jak i rozległe slumsy oraz toksyczne morza. Podziemna sieć skażonych kanałów ściekowych stała się schronieniem dla przestępczości. Władza polityczna, przemysł i półświatek funkcjonują tu w różnych warstwach jednego globalnego miasta.

en.description: Anoat is an ecumenopolis, a city wide planet, the capital of the sector, and the seat of the Nothoiin Noble court. It is a very industrial world with its fair share of slums, and toxic seas. The underworld of toxic sewers is a hub for all kinds of shady activity.

hut.description: Anoat is an ecumenopolis, sector capital, and seat of the Nothoiin noble court. Industry, slums, and toxic seas cover the world. Poisoned sewer levels shelter shadow trade and crime beneath political wealth.

Planet.name: Gerrenthum
Planet.description: Due to the intersection of three major hyperspace lanes, Gerrenthum has become a massive city planet. This is due to the never ending commerce and trade afforded to them from those lanes convergence. As well as a place of respite for individuals partaking in illegal trade.

pl.description: Gerrenthum rozwinęło się w olbrzymi świat miejski dzięki przecięciu trzech głównych tras nadprzestrzennych. Nieustanny przepływ handlu i podróżnych zapewnia ogromne dochody oraz stałą rozbudowę. Miasto-planeta oferuje także schronienie uczestnikom nielegalnej wymiany, którzy wykorzystują tłok i mnogość połączeń do ukrywania działalności.

en.description: Due to the intersection of three major hyperspace lanes, Gerrenthum has become a massive city planet. This is due to the never ending commerce and trade afforded to them from those lanes convergence. As well as a place of respite for individuals partaking in illegal trade.

hut.description: Gerrenthum became a massive city-world where three hyperspace lanes meet. Endless commerce fuels expansion and wealth. The same crowds and connections offer respite and concealment to illegal traders.

Planet.name: Geptish
Planet.description: An average floral planet of dense jungle and swamps. There is an old Jedi temple located in one of these jungles which has gone into disrepair from a few hundred years of no use. Though it still houses Jedi secrets that need to be kept from the CIS.

pl.description: Geptish jest przeciętnym, bujnie porośniętym światem gęstych dżungli i bagien. W jednym z lasów znajduje się zaniedbana świątynia Jedi, nieużywana od kilku stuleci. Mimo zniszczeń nadal skrywa wiedzę Zakonu, która musi pozostać poza zasięgiem CIS. Ochrona ruin stanowi najważniejsze strategiczne zadanie na planecie.

en.description: An average floral planet of dense jungle and swamps. There is an old Jedi temple located in one of these jungles which has gone into disrepair from a few hundred years of no use. Though it still houses Jedi secrets that need to be kept from the CIS.

hut.description: Geptish is a floral world of jungle and swamp. A Jedi temple abandoned for centuries decays within the forest, yet still holds Order secrets. Keeping that knowledge from CIS gives the otherwise ordinary planet strategic value.

Planet.name: Kriselist
Planet.description: A highly urbanized planet, but not with the sky scrapers of Coruscant. Large cities sprawl the planet with very little vegetation left to be seen.

pl.description: Kriselist jest silnie zurbanizowaną planetą, choć jego miasta nie przyjmują pionowej formy wieżowców Coruscant. Rozległa, niska zabudowa rozlewa się po powierzchni, pozostawiając bardzo niewiele naturalnej roślinności. Gęstość infrastruktury świadczy o wielkiej skali osadnictwa, ale zarazem o daleko posuniętym przekształceniu środowiska.

en.description: A highly urbanized planet, but not with the sky scrapers of Coruscant. Large cities sprawl the planet with very little vegetation left to be seen.

hut.description: Kriselist is highly urbanized without Coruscant's vertical towers. Broad low cities spread across the surface, leaving little vegetation. Its settlement scale is immense, and natural land has paid the price.

Planet.name: Kinyen
Planet.description: This planet is an agriworld, or a farming planet. Most of the planet was covered in farms. But in the few places where farms were not present, mountains and forests could be found. Also large dome structures where the majority of the people resided while most of the land was used for farming.

pl.description: Kinyen jest agriświatem niemal całkowicie pokrytym gospodarstwami. Nieliczne obszary nieprzeznaczone pod uprawy zajmują góry i lasy. Większość ludności mieszka w wielkich kopułach, dzięki czemu pozostała ziemia może służyć produkcji żywności. Układ przestrzenny podporządkowuje osadnictwo maksymalnej wydajności rolniczej.

en.description: This planet is an agriworld, or a farming planet. Most of the planet was covered in farms. But in the few places where farms were not present, mountains and forests could be found. Also large dome structures where the majority of the people resided while most of the land was used for farming.

hut.description: Kinyen is an agriworld covered almost entirely by farms. Mountains and forests survive where cultivation does not. Most people live in great domes, leaving maximum land for food production.

Planet.name: Roona
Planet.description: Home world of the Roonan Species, it holds an important spot among the sector as it holds a strategic importance of the Corellian Trade Spine. Roona is represented by Senator Aang who is of a neutral seat in the Senate, serving on the Military Oversight Committee.

pl.description: Roona jest ojczyzną gatunku Roonan i zajmuje strategiczną pozycję przy Koreliańskim Grzbiecie Handlowym. W Senacie reprezentuje ją senator Aang, utrzymujący neutralne stanowisko i zasiadający w Komisji Nadzoru Wojskowego. Położenie planety oraz polityczna rola jej przedstawiciela nadają jej znaczenie większe niż słabo opisane zasoby.

en.description: Home world of the Roonan Species, it holds an important spot among the sector as it holds a strategic importance of the Corellian Trade Spine. Roona is represented by Senator Aang who is of a neutral seat in the Senate, serving on the Military Oversight Committee.

hut.description: Roona is the Roonan homeworld at a strategic point on the Corellian Trade Spine. Senator Aang holds a neutral Senate seat and serves on the Military Oversight Committee. Route position and political influence outweigh poorly documented resources.

Planet.name: Yag'Dhul
Planet.description: A harsh world where the moons made the tide shift from one side of the planet to the other every few days. Also, due to the erratic movement of the moons, areas of the world will combust into powerful storms, the atmosphere would swirl violently, and lightning crashing onto the scorched surface of the planet. Yag’dul has green vegetation with lush flowing rivers that can suddenly turn into tidal waves washing over the once peaceful plains or even shifting to having no atmosphere in certain areas of the planet freezing everything in place. And where the massive storms are is mostly ash and lava.

pl.description: Yag'Dhul jest skrajnie niestabilnym światem, którego księżyce co kilka dni przenoszą potężne pływy z jednej strony planety na drugą. Ich chaotyczny ruch wywołuje gwałtowne burze, błyskawice i chwilowe zaniki atmosfery. Zielone równiny oraz rzeki mogą nagle zostać zalane falą albo skute mrozem, podczas gdy strefy burz pokrywają popiół i lawa. Osadnictwo wymaga ciągłego przewidywania zmian orbitalnych.

en.description: A harsh world where the moons made the tide shift from one side of the planet to the other every few days. Also, due to the erratic movement of the moons, areas of the world will combust into powerful storms, the atmosphere would swirl violently, and lightning crashing onto the scorched surface of the planet. Yag’dul has green vegetation with lush flowing rivers that can suddenly turn into tidal waves washing over the once peaceful plains or even shifting to having no atmosphere in certain areas of the planet freezing everything in place. And where the massive storms are is mostly ash and lava.

hut.description: Yag'Dhul's erratic moons move tides across the planet every few days, ignite violent storms, and can strip air from local regions. Green plains and rivers may become tidal waves, frozen emptiness, ash, or lava. Survival requires constant orbital prediction.

Planet.name: Hodi
Planet.description: Situated on the Corellian Run, Hodi was known for its red lakes scattered along the planet. The red was created by the bacteria that infest the water forcing residents to create efficient water filters. Their cities lie on the plains nearby the lakes.

pl.description: Hodi leży przy Koreliańskim Szlaku i słynie z czerwonych jezior, których barwę tworzą żyjące w wodzie bakterie. Mieszkańcy musieli opracować wydajne systemy filtracji, aby bezpiecznie korzystać z zasobów wodnych. Miasta powstały na równinach w pobliżu jezior, łącząc dostęp do wody z koniecznością stałej ochrony zdrowia.

en.description: Situated on the Corellian Run, Hodi was known for its red lakes scattered along the planet. The red was created by the bacteria that infest the water forcing residents to create efficient water filters. Their cities lie on the plains nearby the lakes.

hut.description: Hodi lies on the Corellian Run and is known for bacteria-red lakes. Residents developed efficient filters to make the water safe. Cities occupy nearby plains, balancing access with constant health protection.

Planet.name: Liwonia
Planet.description: Liwonia is a campaign adaptation of a temperate Eastern European landscape dominated by dense forests, broad fields, small settlements and partly abandoned infrastructure. Agriculture and timber are the most defensible economic themes, while woodland, wetlands and open farmland create varied conditions for ground operations. The campaign records fewer than one billion inhabitants but provide no canonical planetary founding history or exact census. Its present strategic value comes from rural resources and contested overland approaches. This description replaces the unrelated oceanic naval-world account previously stored in the record.

pl.description: Liwonia jest kampanijną adaptacją umiarkowanego krajobrazu Europy Wschodniej: gęstych lasów, rozległych pól, małych osad i częściowo opuszczonej infrastruktury. Rolnictwo i drewno stanowią najbardziej wiarygodne podstawy gospodarki, a mokradła oraz otwarte tereny różnicują działania lądowe. Archiwa mówią o mniej niż miliardzie mieszkańców, bez dokładnego spisu. Znaczenie strategiczne wynika z zasobów wiejskich i spornych dróg lądowych.

en.description: Liwonia is a campaign adaptation of a temperate Eastern European landscape dominated by dense forests, broad fields, small settlements and partly abandoned infrastructure. Agriculture and timber are the most defensible economic themes, while woodland, wetlands and open farmland create varied conditions for ground operations. The campaign records fewer than one billion inhabitants but provide no canonical planetary founding history or exact census. Its present strategic value comes from rural resources and contested overland approaches. This description replaces the unrelated oceanic naval-world account previously stored in the record.

hut.description: Liwonia adapts an Eastern European mild-world of dense forests, broad fields, small settlements, and abandoned infrastructure. Farming and timber are its clearest resources. Woodland, wetlands, and open approaches shape ground warfare; population is below one billion but not precisely known.

Planet.name: Nantoon
Planet.description: Nantoon is in the Colonies region of the galaxy, Grid Square M-13, Trade Route: Corellian Trade Spine. This planet is known for being where pirate Queen Maz Kanata hid a portion of her spoils in a buried vault which is protected by an antitamper sub-space alarm. At the time of its notation in Smuggler's Guide by Maz Kanata the alarm had not gone off. The planet does hold some importance to rival gangs and other criminal factions of the region, one such is the Guavian Death Gang, who seeked to launch an attack on the planet to rule over the Galaxy's Underworld. This would imply that the planet is a hub or major locale of criminals. During the time of the Sith Empire Darth Malora besieged the planet, however made a blunder in neglecting to disable the enemies communications. The planet aside from its criminal connections is known for being a dry and arid planet, home to somewhere around 900 million peoples. It features tall mountains and vast deserts.

pl.description: Nantoon leży przy Koreliańskim Grzbiecie Handlowym i jest ważnym ośrodkiem przestępczym. Maz Kanata ukryła tam część łupów w podziemnym skarbcu chronionym alarmem podprzestrzennym. Planetą interesują się rywalizujące gangi, w tym Guavian Death Gang. Suchy świat około dziewięciuset milionów mieszkańców posiada wysokie góry i rozległe pustynie. Jego historia obejmuje także dawne oblężenie prowadzone przez Darth Malorę.

en.description: Nantoon is in the Colonies region of the galaxy, Grid Square M-13, Trade Route: Corellian Trade Spine. This planet is known for being where pirate Queen Maz Kanata hid a portion of her spoils in a buried vault which is protected by an antitamper sub-space alarm. hut.description: Nantoon is an arida criminal hub on the Corellian Trade Spine. Maz Kanata buried spoils in an alarmed vault, drawing rival gangs including Guavian Death Gang. About nine hundred million people live among mountains and deserts. Old records also recall Darth Malora's failed siege decisions.

Planet.name: Allanteen VI
Planet.description: Allanteen VI is a major Republic shipyard. The Allanteen Six shipyards manufactured Venator-class Star Destroyers for the Grand Army of the Republic.

pl.description: Allanteen VI jest jedną z najważniejszych stoczni Republiki. Zakłady Allanteen Six produkują niszczyciele gwiezdne typu Venator dla Wielkiej Armii Republiki. Zdolność budowy ciężkich jednostek czyni planetę kluczowym elementem wojennego przemysłu i potencjalnym celem dla każdego przeciwnika pragnącego osłabić republikańską flotę.

en.description: Allanteen VI is a major Republic shipyard. The Allanteen Six shipyards manufactured Venator-class Star Destroyers for the Grand Army of the Republic.

hut.description: Allanteen VI is a major Republica shipyard. Allanteen Six yards build Venator-class Star Destroyers for the Grand Army. Heavy-warship production makes the world vital industry and an obvious enemy target.

Planet.name: Denon
Planet.description: This ecumenopolis planet is second only to Coruscant in its vastness and coverage. With many straight lines of “roads” emanating from the planet's capital. Glistening towers and endless skylines as far as the eye can see. From the planet’s surface there is little to none natural light anymore.
Planet.conflict_description: Denon is an ecumenopolis world, with city growth covering the entire surface, similar to Coruscant. It is located at the confluence of the Hydian Way and the Corellian Run. The 2nd Sector Army is in charge of defending the vital hyperlane junction at Denon.

pl.description: Denon jest ekumenopolis ustępującą skalą jedynie Coruscant. Od stolicy rozchodzą się regularne linie dróg, a lśniące wieże i niekończąca się panorama zabudowy pokrywają niemal cały glob. Na powierzchnię dociera bardzo mało naturalnego światła. Życie, transport i gospodarka zależą całkowicie od wielowarstwowej infrastruktury globalnego miasta.

en.description: This ecumenopolis planet is second only to Coruscant in its vastness and coverage. With many straight lines of “roads” emanating from the planet's capital. Glistening towers and endless skylines as far as the eye can see. From the planet’s surface there is little to none natural light anymore.

hut.description: Denon is an ecumenopolis second only to Coruscant. Straight road lines radiate from its capital through endless towers and skylines. Almost no natural light reaches the lower surface, leaving life and trade dependent on citywide infrastructure.

Planet.name: Milagro
Planet.description: The planet Milagro lies at the confluence of two important hyperroutes, the Corellian Run and the Harrin Trade Corridor. Milagro is ruled by its own noble houses, descendants of the first settlers of the planet. Milagro is a human dominated world with cities of glass domes and minarets. The planet itself is mostly inhospitable yet its shimmering silicon plains are considered scenic by many. The locals have built up much military infrastructure to defend themselves against pirates. These bases provide an important staging point for whoever controls them for assaults into nearby regions.

pl.description: Milagro leży na przecięciu Koreliańskiego Szlaku i Harrin Trade Corridor. Rządzą nim rody szlacheckie wywodzące się od pierwszych osadników. Ludzkie miasta z kopułami ze szkła i minaretami wzniesiono pośród niegościnnych, lecz malowniczych równin krzemowych. Liczne instalacje wojskowe chronią przed piratami i stanowią cenny punkt wyjściowy do operacji w sąsiednich regionach.

en.description: The planet Milagro lies at the confluence of two important hyperroutes, the Corellian Run and the Harrin Trade Corridor. Milagro is ruled by its own noble houses, descendants of the first settlers of the planet. Milagro is a human dominated world with cities of glass domes and minarets. The planet itself is mostly inhospitable yet its shimmering silicon plains are considered scenic by many. The locals have built up much military infrastructure to defend themselves against pirates. These bases provide an important staging point for whoever controls them for assaults into nearby regions.

hut.description: Milagro sits where Corellian Run meets Harrin Trade Corridor. Noble houses rule human cities of glass domes and minarets above scenic silicon plains. Strong defenses deter pirates and offer whoever controls them a valuable staging ground.

Planet.name: New Cov
Planet.description: New Cov is located in the Churba sector of the Mid Rim, at the junction of the Corellian Run and the Duros Space Run. A jungle planet where the conditions are so harsh the locals have built dome cities to shelter from the lethal flora. The diverse flora is incredibly vibrant. That even subtly glows in the night. However, there are many deadly and docile wildlife throughout the planet.

pl.description: New Cov leży na styku Koreliańskiego Szlaku i Duros Space Run w Środkowych Rubieżach. Zabójcza flora dżungli zmusiła mieszkańców do budowy miast pod kopułami. Roślinność jest niezwykle barwna i subtelnie świeci nocą, a fauna obejmuje zarówno łagodne, jak i śmiertelnie niebezpieczne gatunki. Bogactwo biologiczne stanowi zarazem zasób oraz stałe zagrożenie.

en.description: New Cov is located in the Churba sector of the Mid Rim, at the junction of the Corellian Run and the Duros Space Run. A jungle planet where the conditions are so harsh the locals have built dome cities to shelter from the lethal flora. The diverse flora is incredibly vibrant. That even subtly glows in the night. However, there are many deadly and docile wildlife throughout the planet.

hut.description: New Cov is a jungle world where Corellian Run meets Duros Space Run. Lethal flora forced residents into dome cities. Vibrant plants glow faintly at night, while wildlife ranges from docile to deadly. Biological wealth and danger are inseparable.

Planet.name: Falleen
Planet.description: Falleen is the ancient home world of the notorious species of the same name. Removed from the criminal underworld of the Black Sun, it is a monarchical society run by the Falleen King. Its jungles, vast plains, and icy mountains are both respected and well used by its people for ancestral and defensive measures. After the Battle of Naboo, the planet saw a rise in corporate interest in its landscapes, and soon, some of the most prominent manufacturers in the galaxy would begin to build operations upon its surface. Seeing an opportunity to take advantage of the trade routes and the less remote nature of the planet. This same boom in the economy would further strengthen the King, allowing them to build vast citadels and fortresses upon the planet's surface.

high_value_targets.name: King of Falleen
high_value_targets.title: King
high_value_targets.intel: The King of Falleen is the linchpin when it comes to the loyalty of the Falleen people. While the planet's independence is respected by the Republic, if he were to ever change his loyalties, the Republic must prepare to respond in kind.

pl.description: Falleen jest starożytną ojczyzną gatunku o tej samej nazwie i monarchią rządzoną przez króla, odrębną od przestępczej organizacji Czarne Słońce. Dżungle, równiny i lodowe góry służą mieszkańcom jako dziedzictwo oraz naturalna obrona. Po bitwie o Naboo rosnące inwestycje korporacyjne wykorzystały miejscowe szlaki i dostępność planety. Rozkwit handlu umocnił monarchę, finansując rozległe cytadele i fortyfikacje.

en.description: Falleen is the ancient home world of the notorious species of the same name. Removed from the criminal underworld of the Black Sun, it is a monarchical society run by the Falleen King. Its jungles, vast plains, and icy mountains are both respected and well used by its people for ancestral and defensive measures. After the Battle of Naboo, the planet saw a rise in corporate interest in its landscapes, and soon, some of the most prominent manufacturers in the galaxy would begin to build operations upon its surface. Seeing an opportunity to take advantage of the trade routes and the less remote nature of the planet. This same boom in the economy would further strengthen the King, allowing them to build vast citadels and fortresses upon the planet's surface.

hut.description: Falleen is the ancient monarchical homeworld of its species, distinct from Black Sun criminals. Jungles, plains, and icy mountains serve ancestry and defense. Corporate investment after Naboo exploited trade access, enriching the king and financing vast citadels.

Planet.name: Ando
Planet.description: Ando the homeworld of the Aqualish is a world of large oceans with only a few swampy islands on the surface, yet they are host to ancient overgrown Sith temples and some dense ancient cities. It is in an ongoing civil war over remaining with the separatists. The faction led by Vagger wants to join the republic but is opposed by Nudo who leads separatists on the world. The Hyper-Communications Cartel, the CIS propaganda and signals division also operate around the world with their headquarters having lots of valuable intel on CIS subversive activities.

high_value_targets.name: Senator Po Nudo
high_value_targets.title: Corrupt Senator
high_value_targets.intel: He is the Aqualish separatist Senator of Ando. He is also head of the Hyper-Communications Cartel, the CIS propaganda and signals division.

high_value_targets.name: Mekedrix
high_value_targets.title: Traitor
high_value_targets.intel: He is the insane human traitor to the republic and leader of the rogue Death Wind squad. These former Republic militia members are to be executed for treason.

pl.description: Ando jest oceaniczną ojczyzną Aqualishów, z nielicznymi bagnistymi wyspami mieszczącymi stare świątynie Sithów i gęste miasta. Trwa wojna domowa: Vagger dąży do przyłączenia do Republiki, a Nudo utrzymuje stronę Separatystów. Działa tu również Kartel Hiperkomunikacyjny, propagandowo-sygnałowe ramię CIS. Jego kwatera zawiera cenne dane o operacjach wywrotowych Konfederacji.

en.description: Ando the homeworld of the Aqualish is a world of large oceans with only a few swampy islands on the surface, yet they are host to ancient overgrown Sith temples and some dense ancient cities. It is in an ongoing civil war over remaining with the separatists. The faction led by Vagger wants to join the republic but is opposed by Nudo who leads separatists on the world. The Hyper-Communications Cartel, the CIS propaganda and signals division also operate around the world with their headquarters having lots of valuable intel on CIS subversive activities.

hut.description: Ando is the Aqualish ocean homeworld, with swamp islands holding Sith temples and old cities. Civil war divides Vagger's Republica supporters from Nudo's Separatistas. The CIS Hyper-Communications Cartel also operates there, holding valuable intel on subversion.

Planet.name: Druckenwell
Planet.description: Druckenwell is an industrial world in the Lambda sector, on the Corellian Run. A Trade Federation world, it is loyal to the Confederacy of Independent Systems. It is best known for a BlasTech weapons manufacturing complex that is located there.

high_value_targets.name: Arelius L’att
high_value_targets.title: CEO
high_value_targets.intel: Arelius I’att is the human CEO of I'att Armament whoever controls him controls the arms factories of the world. He is protected by his own private security including the latest model of assassin droid.

pl.description: Druckenwell jest przemysłowym światem sektora Lambda położonym przy Koreliańskim Szlaku. Należy do Federacji Handlowej i pozostaje lojalny wobec CIS. Najważniejszym zakładem jest kompleks produkcji broni BlasTech, który nadaje planecie znaczenie zaopatrzeniowe oraz czyni ją istotnym elementem separatystycznego przemysłu wojennego.

en.description: Druckenwell is an industrial world in the Lambda sector, on the Corellian Run. A Trade Federation world, it is loyal to the Confederacy of Independent Systems. It is best known for a BlasTech weapons manufacturing complex that is located there.

hut.description: Druckenwell is a Lambda sector industry-world on the Corellian Run. A Trade Federation holding loyal to CIS, it is best known for a BlasTech weapons complex. Arms production gives it strategic supply value.

Planet.name: Mon Gazza
Planet.description: The planet of Mon Gazza was once home to a spice mining colony, second only to Kessel in spice mining production. A violent, poverty-stricken world, it was controlled by the Galactic Spice Mining Guild.

high_value_targets.name: Jinn Reeso
high_value_targets.title: Guild Commander
high_value_targets.intel: Newly appointed quarren governor replaced the former neutral one. Given the fact that his species are deeply affiliated with the Trading Federation, there are speculations that he plans to support the Confederacy.

pl.description: Mon Gazza było niegdyś kolonią wydobywczą przyprawy, ustępującą wielkością produkcji jedynie Kessel. Planetą zarządzała Galaktyczna Gildia Wydobycia Przyprawy. Przemoc, ubóstwo i zależność od jednego surowca ukształtowały miejscowe społeczeństwo, w którym zysk gildii miał pierwszeństwo przed bezpieczeństwem i dobrobytem górników.

en.description: The planet of Mon Gazza was once home to a spice mining colony, second only to Kessel in spice mining production. A violent, poverty-stricken world, it was controlled by the Galactic Spice Mining Guild.

hut.description: Mon Gazza was a spice-mining colony second only to Kessel and controlled by the Galactic Spice Mining Guild. Violence, poverty, and dependence on one commodity shaped a world where guild profit outweighed miners' welfare.

Planet.name: Hypori
Planet.description: After the Invasion of Naboo in 32 BBY, Hypori was transformed into a droid factory world by the Techno Union and Trade Federation.

pl.description: Po inwazji na Naboo w 32 BBY Unia Technokratyczna i Federacja Handlowa przekształciły Hypori w świat fabryk droidów. Rozbudowana produkcja uczyniła planetę jednym z filarów separatystycznego zaplecza wojennego. Jej gospodarka, infrastruktura i znaczenie strategiczne pozostają bezpośrednio związane z masowym wytwarzaniem maszyn bojowych.

en.description: After the Invasion of Naboo in 32 BBY, Hypori was transformed into a droid factory world by the Techno Union and Trade Federation.

hut.description: After the 32 BBY invasion of Naboo, Techno Union and Trade Federation remade Hypori into a droid-factory world. Mass production now defines its economy and makes it a pillar of Separatista war koona.

Planet.name: Arctic Prime
Planet.description: Hynestia Prime was a cold tundra planet in the Colonies. Due to its frigid climate, only the area around the equator was habitable to its human population. Underground, the planet had extensive systems of caves and hot springs.

pl.description: Arctic Prime, znana również jako Hynestia Prime, jest zimnym światem tundrowym w Koloniach. Ludność może stale zamieszkiwać głównie pas równikowy. Pod powierzchnią rozciągają się rozległe jaskinie i gorące źródła, zapewniające naturalne schronienie, ciepło oraz możliwe zaplecze dla osadnictwa poza jedyną łagodniejszą strefą klimatyczną.

en.description: Hynestia Prime was a cold tundra planet in the Colonies. Due to its frigid climate, only the area around the equator was habitable to its human population. Underground, the planet had extensive systems of caves and hot springs.

hut.description: Arctic Prime, or Hynestia Prime, is a frigid Colony world habitable mainly near its equator. Extensive caves and hot springs below provide warmth, shelter, and settlement opportunities beyond the narrow surface belt.

Planet.name: Yavin IV
Planet.description: Yavin IV is considered to be a relatively unimportant planet to the majority of the galaxy at large. However, its landscapes hide deeply rooted secrets long forgotten through thousands of years of abandonment. Yavin IV had once been the temple world of Exar Kun’s Sith Empire. The massive rainforests, jungles, swamps, and mountains covering its surface made it the perfect world to hide the Sith Lords' artifacts and secrets. Yet the true purpose of these temples and the moon itself would have been long lost to time, with only the Jedi Order having records of its ancient structures. Interestingly, these same records show an underground infrastructure and city that was built into the planet sometime after Exar Kun’s removal from the world by the Jedi during the Old Republic. Records on its purpose seem to have been expunged, but the Republic has started sending archeologists to investigate.

pl.description: Yavin IV uchodzi za nieistotny księżyc, lecz jego lasy deszczowe, bagna i góry skrywają świątynie dawnego imperium Sithów Exara Kuna. Jedi zachowali zapisy o budowlach i podziemnym mieście powstałym po usunięciu Kuna, choć cel kompleksu został wymazany z archiwów. Republika wysyła archeologów, aby zbadać struktury oraz zabezpieczyć artefakty i tajemnice pozostawione przez Sithów.

en.description: Yavin IV is considered to be a relatively unimportant planet to the majority of the galaxy at large. However, its landscapes hide deeply rooted secrets long forgotten through thousands of years of abandonment. Yavin IV had once been the temple world of Exar Kun’s Sith Empire.
