Yet the true purpose of these temples and the moon itself would have been long lost to time, with only the Jedi Order having records of its ancient structures. Interestingly, these same records show an underground infrastructure and city that was built into the planet sometime after Exar Kun’s removal from the world by the Jedi during the Old Republic. Records on its purpose seem to have been expunged, but the Republic has started sending archeologists to investigate.

hut.description: Yavin IV appears unimportant, but rainforest, swamp, and mountains hide temples of Exar Kun's Sith Empire. Jedi records also describe a later underground city of erased purpose. Republica archaeologists now investigate and guard the forgotten secrets.

Planet.name: Rishi Moon
Planet.description: A desolate moon. It has holes scattered around the surface which stretch deep into the moon as well as many interconnecting cave systems. The moon is used as a listening post by the Republic.

pl.description: Księżyc Rishi jest opustoszałym obiektem pełnym głębokich otworów i połączonych systemów jaskiń. Republika wykorzystuje go jako posterunek nasłuchowy, którego odosobnienie sprzyja obserwacji ruchu i łączności. Podziemna topografia zapewnia osłonę instalacjom, lecz może również utrudniać patrolowanie całego obiektu.

en.description: A desolate moon. It has holes scattered around the surface which stretch deep into the moon as well as many interconnecting cave systems. The moon is used as a listening post by the Republic.

hut.description: Rishi Moon is desolate, riddled with deep shafts and connected caves. Republica uses it as a listening post. Subterranean terrain conceals the installation but complicates complete patrol and defense.

Planet.name: Milvayne
Planet.description: Milvayne is controlled internally by the Milvayne Authority, a harsh, justice-oriented law enforcement agency. Appearing green from above, most of Milvayne was covered in the expansive and crowded Milvayne City. Similar to Coruscant, the city had both upper and lower portions, and most were controlled extremely well by mass propaganda, that is until you get to the underworld. All citizens of Milvayne were tried for crimes at a ledge, if found guilty you were thrust off the ledge and into the underworld. Here, it was a lawless place filled with homeless in disarray, cannibals, or low tier bounty hunters and criminals.

pl.description: Milvayne kontroluje surowa Milvayne Authority, przedstawiająca się jako bezwzględny strażnik sprawiedliwości. Zielony z orbity świat niemal całkowicie pokrywa zatłoczone miasto o warstwach przypominających Coruscant. Propaganda utrzymuje porządek na górze; skazanych zrzuca się z krawędzi do bezprawnego podziemia zamieszkanego przez bezdomnych, kanibali i drobnych przestępców. System karny dosłownie spycha odrzuconych poza społeczeństwo.

en.description: Milvayne is controlled internally by the Milvayne Authority, a harsh, justice-oriented law enforcement agency. Appearing green from above, most of Milvayne was covered in the expansive and crowded Milvayne City. Similar to Coruscant, the city had both upper and lower portions, and most were controlled extremely well by mass propaganda, that is until you get to the underworld. All citizens of Milvayne were tried for crimes at a ledge, if found guilty you were thrust off the ledge and into the underworld. Here, it was a lawless place filled with homeless in disarray, cannibals, or low tier bounty hunters and criminals.

hut.description: Milvayne Authority rules a crowded city-world through harsh law and propaganda. Convicted citizens are thrown from a ledge into a lawless underworld of homeless people, cannibals, and minor criminals. Order above is purchased by casting every unwanted debt below.

Planet.name: Pijal
Planet.description: Pijal was a planet in the Inner Rim territories, controlled largely by the Czerka Corporation. A planet of large islands of green and gold with massive cliffs on the beaches. Inland there were mountains and thick forests They are only situated around the equator, whereas the rest of the planet is ocean.

pl.description: Pijal jest światem Wewnętrznych Rubieży w znacznej mierze kontrolowanym przez Czerka Corporation. Wokół równika znajdują się wielkie zielono-złote wyspy o wysokich klifach, górach i gęstych lasach; resztę planety pokrywa ocean. Skupienie lądu w jednym pasie czyni go szczególnie cennym dla osadnictwa, infrastruktury i korporacyjnej kontroli.

en.description: Pijal was a planet in the Inner Rim territories, controlled largely by the Czerka Corporation. A planet of large islands of green and gold with massive cliffs on the beaches. Inland there were mountains and thick forests They are only situated around the equator, whereas the rest of the planet is ocean.

hut.description: Pijal is an Inner Rim world largely controlled by Czerka. Green-and-gold islands with cliffs, mountains, and forests cluster around the equator; ocean covers the rest. Scarce land strengthens corporate control over settlement and resources.

Planet.name: Bilbringi
Planet.description: A nondescript planet with shipyards specifically designed for dismantling starships.

pl.description: Bilbringi jest słabo wyróżniającym się światem, którego znaczenie wynika ze stoczni wyspecjalizowanych w demontażu statków kosmicznych. Zakłady odzyskują metale, części i wyposażenie z wycofanych jednostek. Gospodarka planety opiera się zatem nie na budowie nowych okrętów, lecz na przetwarzaniu pozostałości galaktycznego transportu i wojny.

en.description: A nondescript planet with shipyards specifically designed for dismantling starships.

hut.description: Bilbringi is an otherwise unremarkable world with shipyards built to dismantle starships. Salvaged metal, parts, and equipment sustain an economy based on the remains of transport and war.

Planet.name: Roost
Planet.description: Roost is a human Outer Colony in the Lambda Aurigae system, established in 2490. At least part of its surface is known for tropical beaches and productive fishing waters, supporting coastal settlement and shore leave for UNSC crews. The planet entered naval history when Captain Preston Cole met Lyrenne Castilla there, before her connection to the Insurrectionist ship Bellicose became known. No reliable total census or major planetary export list is available. Roost is therefore a modest inhabited colony, replacing the unrelated shallow-ocean prison entry previously stored in its record.

pl.description: Roost jest ludzką kolonią zewnętrzną w układzie Lambda Aurigae, założoną w 2490 roku. Tropikalne plaże i zasobne łowiska wspierają osadnictwo oraz wypoczynek załóg UNSC. Planeta zapisała się w historii marynarki jako miejsce spotkania kapitana Prestona Cole'a z Lyrenne Castillą, zanim ujawniono jej związek z Bellicose. Brakuje pełnego spisu ludności i listy głównych towarów eksportowych.

en.description: Roost is a human Outer Colony in the Lambda Aurigae system, established in 2490. At least part of its surface is known for tropical beaches and productive fishing waters, supporting coastal settlement and shore leave for UNSC crews. The planet entered naval history when Captain Preston Cole met Lyrenne Castilla there, before her connection to the Insurrectionist ship Bellicose became known. No reliable total census or major planetary export list is available. Roost is therefore a modest inhabited colony, replacing the unrelated shallow-ocean prison entry previously stored in its record.

hut.description: Roost is a human Outer Colony founded in 2490 in Lambda Aurigae. Tropical beaches and fishing waters support settlers and UNSC shore leave. Naval history remembers Preston Cole meeting Lyrenne Castilla there before her Bellicose connection became known. Census and exports remain incomplete.

Planet.name: Couronne
Planet.description: Couronne is a cold desert world and is the homeworld of the Imzig. The population does not engage in farming, getting all their food from the outside world and they all live in urban centers. It is ruled by the High King Valois from his palatial skyscraper. There is much civil unrest amongst the High Court and the King only maintains order through the High King’s Guard, an elite force. Being a neutral in the war he plays both the Republic and the CIS against each other doing nothing to prevent raids on each other's embassies, even encouraging it. This is because he has two rivals Duke Juori who is supported by the Republic and Duke Lesanne who is supported by the CIS.

high_value_targets.name: High King Valois
high_value_targets.title: King
high_value_targets.intel: He is the Imzig High King of Couronne. His capture will give us the leverage needed to have him abdicate in favour of the Republic Loyalist Duke Juori.

high_value_targets.name: Duke Juori
high_value_targets.title: Duke
high_value_targets.intel: The Imzig Duke Juori of Couronne is under constant threat of assaination from both the neutral High King and the rival Duke Lesanne who is for his support of the Republic.

high_value_targets.name: Duke Lesanne
high_value_targets.title: Duke
high_value_targets.intel: The Imzig Duke Lesanne of Couronne is the local CIS puppet. The only thing worse than Couronne remaining neutral, is it joining the CIS. Eliminate him to stop all CIS influence on the world.

pl.description: Couronne jest zimnym, pustynnym światem Imzigów, całkowicie zależnym od importowanej żywności i skupionym w miastach. Wielki Król Valois rządzi z pałacowego wieżowca dzięki elitarnej gwardii, podczas gdy dwór rozdzierają spory. Neutralność wykorzystuje do rozgrywania Republiki i CIS przeciw sobie, tolerując ataki na ambasady. Jego rywalami są wspierany przez Republikę książę Juori i popierany przez CIS książę Lesanne.

en.description: Couronne is a cold desert world and is the homeworld of the Imzig. The population does not engage in farming, getting all their food from the outside world and they all live in urban centers. It is ruled by the High King Valois from his palatial skyscraper. There is much civil unrest amongst the High Court and the King only maintains order through the High King’s Guard, an elite force. Being a neutral in the war he plays both the Republic and the CIS against each other doing nothing to prevent raids on each other's embassies, even encouraging it. This is because he has two rivals Duke Juori who is supported by the Republic and Duke Lesanne who is supported by the CIS.

hut.description: Couronne is a cold desert Imzig world dependent on imported food. High King Valois rules from a palace tower through an elite guard, playing Republica and CIS against each other. Republic-backed Duke Juori and CIS-backed Duke Lesanne turn court unrest into a dangerous political market.

Planet.name: Madrigal
Planet.description: Madrigal is a thriving human Outer Colony in the 23 Librae system and the system's only planet inside the habitable zone. Its settlements, freight traffic and civilian economy made it an important neighbor to Harvest, while unrest and limited defenses complicated UNSC protection during the opening years of the Human-UNKNOWN ENEMY War. Canon records place its eventual destruction in 2528, but that later loss is not imposed on the active campaign state. This description replaces the unrelated entry previously stored here and leaves unsupported details of Madrigal's local resources out of the record.

pl.description: Madrigal jest kwitnącą ludzką kolonią zewnętrzną w układzie 23 Librae i jedyną jego planetą w ekosferze. Osady, fracht i cywilna gospodarka czynią ją ważnym sąsiadem Harvest, choć niepokoje i słaba obrona utrudniają ochronę UNSC. Kanoniczne zniszczenie w 2528 roku jest późniejsze niż aktywny stan kampanii i nie zostaje tu zastosowane. Niepotwierdzone informacje o zasobach pominięto.

en.description: Madrigal is a thriving human Outer Colony in the 23 Librae system and the system's only planet inside the habitable zone. Its settlements, freight traffic and civilian economy made it an important neighbor to Harvest, while unrest and limited defenses complicated UNSC protection during the opening years of the Human-UNKNOWN ENEMY War. Canon records place its eventual destruction in 2528, but that later loss is not imposed on the active campaign state. This description replaces the unrelated entry previously stored here and leaves unsupported details of Madrigal's local resources out of the record.

hut.description: Madrigal is a thriving human Outer Colony and the only habitable-zone planet of 23 Librae. Settlements and freight make it an important neighbor to Harvest, while unrest and weak defenses challenge UNSC. Its canonical 2528 destruction lies beyond the active campaign.

Planet.name: Zardossa Stix
Planet.description: Zardossa Stix was a desert moon located in the Zardossa Stix system of the galaxy's Colonies region. It was the site of an ancient temple built in honor of Malmourral, the Bardottan demon of war.

pl.description: Zardossa Stix jest pustynnym księżycem w regionie Kolonii. Znajduje się tam starożytna świątynia wzniesiona ku czci Malmourrala, bardottańskiego demona wojny. Zabytek stanowi główne źródło historycznego i religijnego znaczenia tego poza tym słabo opisanego świata.

en.description: Zardossa Stix was a desert moon located in the Zardossa Stix system of the galaxy's Colonies region. It was the site of an ancient temple built in honor of Malmourral, the Bardottan demon of war.

hut.description: Zardossa Stix is a desert moon in the Colonies. An ancient temple honors Malmourral, the Bardottan demon of war. This site provides the moon's chief historical and spiritual value.

Planet.name: Caraad
Planet.description: A cold and mountainous world, Caraad was located in the Colonies. It was connected to Palanhi by the Shwuy Exchange hyperspace route. Caraad included cities built amongst the planet's snowy peaks, the city had speeder traffic, residential housing, with vendors selling food, flowers, and more. In addition to the cold, the planet was also windy.

pl.description: Caraad jest zimnym, górzystym światem Kolonii połączonym z Palanhi trasą Shwuy Exchange. Miasta wzniesiono pośród ośnieżonych szczytów i wyposażono w ruch ścigaczy, dzielnice mieszkalne oraz targowiska. Silny wiatr i mróz wymagają przystosowanej infrastruktury, lecz nie przeszkodziły rozwojowi pełnego życia miejskiego.

en.description: A cold and mountainous world, Caraad was located in the Colonies. It was connected to Palanhi by the Shwuy Exchange hyperspace route. Caraad included cities built amongst the planet's snowy peaks, the city had speeder traffic, residential housing, with vendors selling food, flowers, and more. In addition to the cold, the planet was also windy.

hut.description: Caraad is a cold windy mountain world linked to Palanhi by Shwuy Exchange. Cities among snowy peaks contain speeder traffic, homes, and markets. Adapted infrastructure sustains urban life despite harsh weather.

Planet.name: Vakkar
Planet.description: Vakkar was a planet located within the Fakir Sector of the Colonies. It is a minor planet with a breathable atmosphere. Though it's not an inhabited planet, the world is home to a diverse range of fauna. The wildlife is also very docile with a rich amount of raw materials beneath the surface. Massive mountain ranges stretch across the planet that form impassable barriers that separate entire continents from one another.

pl.description: Vakkar jest niewielką, niezamieszkaną planetą sektora Fakir o zdatnej do oddychania atmosferze. Żyje tam różnorodna i wyjątkowo łagodna fauna, a pod powierzchnią występują obfite surowce. Olbrzymie pasma górskie tworzą niemal nieprzekraczalne bariery dzielące kontynenty. Potencjał wydobywczy jest znaczny, lecz transport lądowy i ochrona ekosystemu stanowią poważne wyzwania.

en.description: Vakkar was a planet located within the Fakir Sector of the Colonies. It is a minor planet with a breathable atmosphere. Though it's not an inhabited planet, the world is home to a diverse range of fauna. The wildlife is also very docile with a rich amount of raw materials beneath the surface. Massive mountain ranges stretch across the planet that form impassable barriers that separate entire continents from one another.

hut.description: Vakkar is an uninhabited minor world with breathable air, docile fauna, and rich underground materials. Immense mountain chains divide continents. Extraction promises profit, but transport and ecological protection carry high costs.

Planet.name: Palanhi
Planet.description: Palanhi is a crossworlds planet in the Colonies region. A small planet with a singular continent. On that continent are regular forests and plains. The planet is housing a major bank that holds a large portion of the GAR’s treasury.

pl.description: Palanhi jest niewielkim światem tranzytowym Kolonii z jednym kontynentem, na którym występują zwyczajne lasy i równiny. Znajduje się tam wielki bank przechowujący znaczną część skarbca Wielkiej Armii Republiki. Z tego powodu niepozorna planeta ma ogromne znaczenie finansowe oraz wymaga wyjątkowo silnej ochrony.

en.description: Palanhi is a crossworlds planet in the Colonies region. A small planet with a singular continent. On that continent are regular forests and plains. The planet is housing a major bank that holds a large portion of the GAR’s treasury.

hut.description: Palanhi is a small Colony crossworld with one continent of forest and plains. A major bank holds a large share of the Grand Army treasury. This quiet planet therefore carries immense financial value and security risk.

Planet.name: Bestoon
Planet.description: Bestoon is a planet in the Colonies and “The Interior” regions of the Galaxy, Grid Square J-9. Bestoon is an arid and inhospital wasteland of a planet, with hardly any atmosphere, aside from concentration around the poles of the planet, it features no bodies of water on the planet, it does have a native species the Bestoonians a tan humanoid species with taut skin, adapted to the low water environment of Bestoon. Bestoon itself is known for not much as not many people willingly spend their time on the surface as once noted “Not much is worth being on that planet for”. Although, the people who decide to call Bestoon their home are always a criminal.

pl.description: Bestoon jest suchym, niegościnnym światem niemal pozbawionym atmosfery i wód powierzchniowych. Gęstsze powietrze występuje jedynie przy biegunach. Bestoonianie, smukli humanoidzi o napiętej skórze, przystosowali się do skrajnego niedoboru wody. Niewielu przybyszów pozostaje tam dobrowolnie, a osiedlający się obcy są zwykle związani z działalnością przestępczą. Planeta oferuje mało korzyści poza odosobnieniem.

en.description: Bestoon is a planet in the Colonies and “The Interior” regions of the Galaxy, Grid Square J-9. Bestoon is an arid and inhospital wasteland of a planet, with hardly any atmosphere, aside from concentration around the poles of the planet, it features no bodies of water on the planet, it does have a native species the Bestoonians a tan humanoid species with taut skin, adapted to the low water environment of Bestoon. Bestoon itself is known for not much as not many people willingly spend their time on the surface as once noted “Not much is worth being on that planet for”. Although, the people who decide to call Bestoon their home are always a criminal.

hut.description: Bestoon is an arida wasteland with almost no air or surface water outside polar concentrations. Native Bestoonians adapted to drought. Few outsiders stay willingly; those who do are usually criminals buying isolation rather than prosperity.

Planet.name: Ghorman
Planet.description: Ghorman was a Colonies planet located in the Sern sector’s Ghorman system along the Rimma Trade Route. The planet was known for its streamlined high-quality silk and twill industy, and it was considered a rite of passage for new fashion designers to visit the planet. Much of the population worked in the silk and twill industry, and the planet's people, the Ghor, took pride in their language and their culture.

pl.description: Ghorman leży przy Rimma Trade Route i słynie z wysokiej jakości jedwabiu oraz diagonalu. Wizyta na planecie uchodzi za rytuał przejścia dla młodych projektantów mody. Znaczna część ludności pracuje w przemyśle włókienniczym, a Ghorowie z dumą pielęgnują własny język i kulturę. Produkcja tkanin jest zarazem podstawą gospodarki i symbolem tożsamości.

en.description: Ghorman was a Colonies planet located in the Sern sector’s Ghorman system along the Rimma Trade Route. The planet was known for its streamlined high-quality silk and twill industy, and it was considered a rite of passage for new fashion designers to visit the planet. Much of the population worked in the silk and twill industry, and the planet's people, the Ghor, took pride in their language and their culture.

hut.description: Ghorman is famed along Rimma Trade Route for fine silk and twill. Visiting is a rite for young fashion designers. Most Ghor work in textiles and take pride in language and culture, making cloth both economy and identity.

Planet.name: Abednedo
Planet.description: Abednedo was a planet located on the Corellian Run and in the Abednedo system of the galaxy's Colonies region. It was the home world of the sentient Abednedo species. The Abednedo people created cities of vibrant color and chaotic artistry. They have cave systems that stretch very far as that is their original civilization before living on the surface. The rest of the planet was desert and rocky.

pl.description: Abednedo leży przy Koreliańskim Szlaku i jest ojczyzną gatunku Abednedo. Mieszkańcy tworzą miasta pełne żywych barw i swobodnej, chaotycznej sztuki. Rozległe jaskinie zachowują ślady pierwotnej podziemnej cywilizacji sprzed zasiedlenia powierzchni. Pozostałą część planety stanowią pustynie i skaliste obszary, kontrastujące z barwnymi ośrodkami miejskimi.

en.description: Abednedo was a planet located on the Corellian Run and in the Abednedo system of the galaxy's Colonies region. It was the home world of the sentient Abednedo species. The Abednedo people created cities of vibrant color and chaotic artistry. They have cave systems that stretch very far as that is their original civilization before living on the surface. The rest of the planet was desert and rocky.

hut.description: Abednedo is the homeworld of its namesake people on the Corellian Run. Vibrant cities celebrate chaotic art, while extensive caves preserve their original underground civilization. Desert and rock surround colorful urban life.

Planet.name: Bardotta
Planet.description: Bardotta is a remote planet located in the Colonies region. Renowned for the art and music produced by the simple locals, the planet is ruled by a monarch who is guided by the Dagoyan Order, a group reputed for their mysticism and attention to spiritual matters.

pl.description: Bardotta jest odległym światem Kolonii słynącym ze sztuki i muzyki tworzonej przez miejscową ludność. Planetą rządzi monarcha kierujący się radą Zakonu Dagoyan — mistycznej wspólnoty skupionej na sprawach duchowych. Kultura oraz religijna tradycja mają tu większe znaczenie niż słabo udokumentowana produkcja gospodarcza.

en.description: Bardotta is a remote planet located in the Colonies region. Renowned for the art and music produced by the simple locals, the planet is ruled by a monarch who is guided by the Dagoyan Order, a group reputed for their mysticism and attention to spiritual matters.

hut.description: Bardotta is a remote Colony world renowned for art and music. A monarch rules with guidance from the mystical Dagoyan Order. Culture and spiritual tradition outweigh poorly recorded industry.

Planet.name: Fondor
Planet.description: Fondor could be considered a miniature Coruscant in many ways. The planet showed signs of having once been a forested coastal world; however, after the Techno Union began operations on the planet, as well as expanding its infrastructure, they would quickly convert its surface into factories, cooling towers, mines, cities, workers’ barracks, and office complexes. The Guild of Shipwrights would begin to form out of the Techno Unions' ambition to create a planetary shipyard to rival Kuat. However, those ambitions would never truly be met, despite the planet's state of the art droid brains that covered major districts of work and labor within the different mining and fabrication sectors across the planet. Despite the planet's alignment with the Techno Union and their droid overseers, the people of Fondor are less than loyal to the Separatist cause.

pl.description: Fondor przypomina pomniejszone Coruscant. Dawny leśny świat wybrzeży Unia Technokratyczna przekształciła w kompleks fabryk, kopalń, chłodni, koszar i biur. Gildia Stoczniowców próbowała stworzyć stocznię dorównującą Kuat, wspieraną przez zaawansowane mózgi droidów zarządzające dzielnicami produkcji. Ambicji nie spełniono w pełni, a ludność Fondoru pozostaje znacznie mniej lojalna wobec Separatystów niż korporacyjni nadzorcy.

en.description: Fondor could be considered a miniature Coruscant in many ways. The planet showed signs of having once been a forested coastal world; however, after the Techno Union began operations on the planet, as well as expanding its infrastructure, they would quickly convert its surface into factories, cooling towers, mines, cities, workers’ barracks, and office complexes. The Guild of Shipwrights would begin to form out of the Techno Unions' ambition to create a planetary shipyard to rival Kuat. However, those ambitions would never truly be met, despite the planet's state of the art droid brains that covered major districts of work and labor within the different mining and fabrication sectors across the planet. Despite the planet's alignment with the Techno Union and their droid overseers, the people of Fondor are less than loyal to the Separatist cause.

hut.description: Fondor is a lesser Coruscant built over a former coastal forest. Techno Union filled it with factories, mines, cooling towers, barracks, and offices. Shipwrights sought to rival Kuat using advanced droid management, but never fully succeeded. Fondor's people remain less loyal to CIS than their corporate overseers.

Planet.name: Sandstorm
Planet.description: The boneyard.

pl.description: Sandstorm jest pustkowiem określanym po prostu jako cmentarzysko. Rozproszone szczątki i surowe warunki świadczą o dawnych katastrofach lub porzuconych maszynach, lecz dostępne archiwa nie podają dokładniejszej historii, stałej ludności ani rozwiniętej gospodarki. Jego znaczenie ogranicza się do odzysku, ukrycia i ryzyka związanego z opuszczonym terenem.

en.description: The boneyard.

hut.description: Sandstorm is known simply as the boneyard. Scattered remains suggest old disasters or abandoned machines, but records name no clear history, population, or economy. Salvage, concealment, and danger define it.

Planet.name: Dowut
Planet.description: A frigid windswept planet of bland grey landscapes where no plants can grow. The planet has 3 stars in the sky making it so there is almost no nighttime. The cold tundra did not prevent wildlife from sprouting. The Dowutin people are generally isolated and although a part of the Republic they avoided politics.

pl.description: Dowut jest lodowatym, smaganym wiatrem światem szarych krajobrazów, na których nie rosną rośliny. Trzy gwiazdy niemal całkowicie eliminują noc, lecz tundra nadal podtrzymuje odporną faunę. Dowutinowie żyją w odosobnieniu; formalnie należą do Republiki, ale unikają polityki oraz głębszego zaangażowania w sprawy galaktyczne.

en.description: A frigid windswept planet of bland grey landscapes where no plants can grow. The planet has 3 stars in the sky making it so there is almost no nighttime. The cold tundra did not prevent wildlife from sprouting. The Dowutin people are generally isolated and although a part of the Republic they avoided politics.

hut.description: Dowut is a frigid grey world beneath three stars and almost no night. Plants cannot grow, yet hardy wildlife survives. Isolated Dowutins belong to Republica while avoiding politics and outside entanglement.

Planet.name: Angcord
Planet.description: Angcord was a planet in the galaxy mostly covered in water, with numerous rocky islands blanketed with green trees.

pl.description: Angcord jest planetą w większości pokrytą wodą. Ponad oceanami wznoszą się liczne skaliste wyspy porośnięte zielonymi drzewami. Archipelagowy krajobraz sprzyja osadnictwu przybrzeżnemu i gospodarce morskiej, choć dostępne źródła nie opisują szczegółowo ludności, zasobów ani historii politycznej.

en.description: Angcord was a planet in the galaxy mostly covered in water, with numerous rocky islands blanketed with green trees.

hut.description: Angcord is mostly ocean, broken by rocky islands covered in green trees. The archipelago favors coastal settlement and maritime activity, though population, resources, and politics remain poorly recorded.

Planet.name: N'Zoth
Planet.description: N'Zoth is a desert planet in the Core Worlds. The brutal, xenophobic Yevetha were the planet's only sentient species. However, there are other brutal species on N'zoth. Known to be a solitary planet and aggressive against outsiders. The people's xenophobia has driven a rift against them and the Republic.

pl.description: N'Zoth jest pustynnym światem Rdzenia i ojczyzną brutalnych, skrajnie ksenofobicznych Yevethów. Żyją tam również inne niebezpieczne gatunki. Mieszkańcy pozostają agresywni wobec obcych i utrzymują planetę w izolacji. Narastająca wrogość wobec przybyszów doprowadziła do głębokiego rozłamu w relacjach z Republiką.

en.description: N'Zoth is a desert planet in the Core Worlds. The brutal, xenophobic Yevetha were the planet's only sentient species. However, there are other brutal species on N'zoth. Known to be a solitary planet and aggressive against outsiders. The people's xenophobia has driven a rift against them and the Republic.

hut.description: N'Zoth is a Core desert homeworld of the brutal, xenophobic Yevetha and other dangerous species. Hostility keeps outsiders away and has opened a deep rift with Republica.

Planet.name: Altis
Planet.description: Altis is a campaign adaptation of a broad North Aegean Mediterranean island. Mountainous terrain, pine-covered uplands, dry plains, seasonal salt lakes and a heavily settled agricultural southwest create sharp regional contrasts. Towns, airfields, ports and military sites make it a developed Republic world with strong logistical value. The campaign census records three billion inhabitants, while the source terrain supplies the environmental model rather than a Star Wars history. This entry replaces the unrelated description previously stored here and does not inherit that world's processing network or trade-route identity.

pl.description: Altis jest kampanijną adaptacją dużej wyspy północnego Morza Egejskiego. Góry, sosnowe wyżyny, suche równiny, okresowe słone jeziora i rolniczy południowy zachód tworzą silne kontrasty. Miasta, lotniska, porty i instalacje wojskowe zapewniają rozwiniętej planecie Republiki wysoką wartość logistyczną. Kampanijny spis podaje trzy miliardy mieszkańców; środowisko pochodzi z terenu źródłowego, nie z historii innego świata.

hut.description: Altis adapts a broad North Aegean island of mountains, pine uplands, dry plains, salt lakes, and a settled farming southwest. Cities, airfields, ports, and bases give Republica strong logistics. Campaign census records three billion residents; its environment comes from source terrain, not another world's lore.

Planet.name: Abregado
Planet.description: A major manufacturing and trade-oriented planet, sitting at the beginning of the Rimma Trade Route. Unlike most Core Worlds, Abregado-rae was fairly backward, to the point of being compared with worlds in the Outer Rim Territories. The planet's spaceports seemed safe, at least to the untrained eye, but in fact it was a known smuggler's paradise.

pl.description: Abregado jest ważnym światem produkcyjnym i handlowym położonym u początku Rimma Trade Route. Mimo pozycji w Rdzeniu pozostaje technologicznie i społecznie zacofane, często porównywane z Zewnętrznymi Rubieżami. Porty kosmiczne pozornie wydają się bezpieczne, lecz w rzeczywistości planeta stanowi dobrze znany raj dla przemytników.

en.description: A major manufacturing and trade-oriented planet, sitting at the beginning of the Rimma Trade Route. hut.description: Abregado is a manufacturing and trade world at the start of Rimma Trade Route. Despite Core status, it resembles an Outer Rim backwater. Its ports look safe to untrained eyes but form a famous smuggler haven.

Planet.name: Neimoidia
Planet.description: Neimodia is a warm world with large open orange fungal farms maintained by massive harvester beetles contained by long stretches of laser fences. The Nemoians here live in large palatial estates or condensed brutal cities. Neimoida is the world where most Nemiodians are born as it is host to the most grub hatcheries. It is also a farming world for the Nemoidians as it is host to their fungal farms. Neimoida is also home to the Trade Monarch, the nominal leader of all Nemodians.

high_value_targets.name: Trade Monarch
high_value_targets.title: Leader of all Nemodians
high_value_targets.intel: His capture is crucial in bringing the Trade Federation to heel and perhaps bring an end to this war.

pl.description: Neimoidia jest ciepłym światem rozległych pomarańczowych upraw grzybów obsługiwanych przez olbrzymie chrząszcze żniwne i ograniczonych płotami laserowymi. Neimoidianie mieszkają w pałacowych posiadłościach albo zatłoczonych, surowych miastach. Planeta mieści większość wylęgarni larw i stanowi główny ośrodek rolnictwa gatunku. Rezyduje tu również Monarcha Handlu, nominalny przywódca wszystkich Neimoidian.

hut.description: Neimoidia is a warm world of orange fungal farms worked by giant beetles behind laser fences. Neimoidians live in palaces or harsh crowded cities. Most hatcheries and major food production are here, along with the Trade Monarch, nominal leader of the species.

Planet.name: Zonama Sekot
Planet.description: A most unusual planet. The planet itself is a living being. As such, the planet is nomadic in nature. This allows it to move to wherever they want to. The planet surface has only one continent spanning the entire planet with a few lakes and seas. It is mostly made of tropical jungles and a northern pole was pure white with snow.

pl.description: Zonama Sekot jest niezwykłą, żyjącą planetą zdolną przemieszczać się między układami. Jeden kontynent obejmuje niemal całą powierzchnię, urozmaiconą jeziorami i morzami. Dominują tropikalne dżungle, natomiast biegun północny pokrywa śnieg. Nomadyczna natura świata czyni jego położenie, ekologię i relacje z przybyszami nieporównywalnymi z typowymi planetami.

en.description: A most unusual planet. The planet itself is a living being. As such, the planet is nomadic in nature. This allows it to move to wherever they want to. The planet surface has only one continent spanning the entire planet with a few lakes and seas. It is mostly made of tropical jungles and a northern pole was pure white with snow.

hut.description: Zonama Sekot is a living nomadic planet able to move between systems. One near-global continent holds lakes, seas, tropica jungle, and a snowy north. Its location and ecology obey the will of a living world rather than ordinary charts.

Planet.name: Mygeeto
Planet.description: Banking Clan crystal vaults we held here in the icy planet. The vault waws well hidden in the jagged crystalline landscape. However, it is highly secured by the wealthy banking clan.

pl.description: Mygeeto jest lodowym światem o poszarpanym, krystalicznym krajobrazie. Klan Bankowy utrzymuje tam silnie strzeżone skarbce ukryte pośród formacji kryształów. Naturalne ukształtowanie utrudnia wykrycie i szturm, a ogromne bogactwo przechowywane w kompleksach nadaje planecie kluczowe znaczenie finansowe.

en.description: Banking Clan crystal vaults we held here in the icy planet. The vault waws well hidden in the jagged crystalline landscape. However, it is highly secured by the wealthy banking clan.

hut.description: Mygeeto is an icy crystal world where Banking Clan vaults hide among jagged formations. Natural concealment and heavy security protect immense wealth, making finance the planet's chief strategic value.

Planet.name: Dromund Kaas
Planet.description: Once the ancient capital of the Sith Empire, Dromund Kaas is now a shadow of its former glory. Ancient cults and Sith fanatics now roam its hallowed grounds. Legends and rumors are all that circulate about the existence of Dormund Kaas in the modern Republic, as communications and travel to the planet have been prohibited, or even deleted from civilian star charts. However, what is known about the planet, based upon its previous records, is that it is a deeply forested environment and highly dangerous to adventure into. Beasts and experiments of the Ancient Sith species stalk the eternal nights of the planet, waiting for the perfect opportunity to strike the ill-prepared. Ancient structures of old Imperial armories, fortresses, cities, Sith academies, and tombs cover its surface. Both it and Moraband have been long forgotten, and for most, it is preferred that it stays that way. Some things are meant to be left alone, never to be returned to or to be reawakened.

pl.description: Dromund Kaas, dawna stolica Imperium Sithów, jest dziś cieniem minionej potęgi. Wieczne noce skrywają gęste lasy, niebezpieczne bestie, eksperymenty Sithów oraz ruiny zbrojowni, twierdz, akademii i grobowców. Kultystów i fanatyków przyciąga dawne dziedzictwo, lecz podróże zakazano, a planetę usunięto z cywilnych map. Republika zna ją głównie z legend i woli, by uśpione sekrety pozostały nietknięte.

hut.description: Dromund Kaas is the shadow of an ancient Sith capital. Eternal night hides forests, beasts, experiments, armories, academies, fortresses, and tombs. Cultists still wander there, while Republica bans travel and erases civilian routes. Some old debts are safer unopened.

Planet.name: Saleucami
Planet.description: Saleucami, in its native tongue, means “oasis,” and this is truly apt as the planet is one of the only habitable planets in its system. Saleucami is a forested mountain world covered in thick trees and massive rocky formations. The planet itself has no sentient life to speak of; however, it has been considered a paradise worth settling by different species within the galaxy. Its temperate weather is perfect for sustaining life. Interestingly, despite the world's relative peace, it is consistently at threat from meteor strikes, an issue that the planetary government of Salecami is well aware of and seeking to rectify. Currently under direct control of the Techno Union, it is considered a luxury world for the upper class living within its cities, outside of the farming population in its forests.

pl.description: Saleucami, czyli „oaza”, jest jednym z niewielu zdatnych do życia światów układu. Umiarkowany klimat, lasy, góry i skalne formacje przyciągnęły osadników mimo braku rodzimej inteligentnej ludności. Zagrożeniem pozostają częste meteoryty. Pod kontrolą Unii Technokratycznej planeta stała się luksusowym miejscem dla elit miejskich, podczas gdy społeczności rolnicze utrzymują zaplecze żywnościowe w lasach.

hut.description: Saleucami means oasis and is among its system's few habitable worlds. Mild forests and mountains attract settlers, though meteor strikes remain a constant danger. Under Techno Union rule, city elites enjoy a luxury world while forest farmers sustain it.

Planet.name: Korriban
Planet.description: This desolate planet is relatively empty other than the fierce animals and fauna. Everything on the planet from the caves to the mountains are red and oppressive. It has many Sith tombs and temples scattered all over the planet. The ancient architecture holds secrets known to only few and some will never be discovered.

pl.description: Korriban jest opustoszałym, przytłaczającym światem czerwonych gór, jaskiń i pustkowi, zamieszkiwanym przez groźną faunę. Na całej planecie stoją grobowce oraz świątynie Sithów. Starożytna architektura skrywa wiedzę dostępną nielicznym, a część tajemnic prawdopodobnie nigdy nie zostanie odkryta. Historyczne znaczenie dalece przewyższa współczesną wartość gospodarczą.

en.description: This desolate planet is relatively empty other than the fierce animals and fauna. Everything on the planet from the caves to the mountains are red and oppressive. It has many Sith tombs and temples scattered all over the planet. The ancient architecture holds secrets known to only few and some will never be discovered.

hut.description: Korriban is a desolate red world of oppressive mountains, caves, and dangerous beasts. Sith tombs and temples cover its surface, holding secrets known to few and perhaps never fully recovered. History outweighs any modern market value.

Planet.name: Ilum
Planet.description: Illum is a cold world with ice cliffs and snowy forests. It is also a hidden world where the Jedi take younglings to get their kyber crystals for light sabers. With this many inexperienced Jedi on the world and with the Jedi spread thin they will need protection.

pl.description: Ilum jest ukrytym, lodowym światem urwisk i zaśnieżonych lasów. Jedi przyprowadzają tam młodzików, aby odnajdywali kryształy kyber do mieczy świetlnych. Obecność wielu niedoświadczonych adeptów oraz rozproszenie sił Zakonu zwiększają potrzebę ochrony planety. Jej znaczenie duchowe i dostęp do kyberu czynią ją celem najwyższej wrażliwości.

en.description: Illum is a cold world with ice cliffs and snowy forests. It is also a hidden world where the Jedi take younglings to get their kyber crystals for light sabers. With this many inexperienced Jedi on the world and with the Jedi spread thin they will need protection.

hut.description: Ilum is a hidden ice-world where Jedi younglings seek kyber for lightsabers. Snow forests and cliffs conceal sacred caves. Many inexperienced students and a thinly spread Order make protection essential; spiritual and material value are inseparable.

Planet.name: Polis Massa
Planet.description: Polis Massa was a planetoid in a dense asteroid field located in the Subterrel sector of the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories, far from any major hyperspace lanes. At some point, Polis Massa was a planet located within the system of the same name. The planet was home to a subterranean people called the Eellayin until it was destroyed. But the rocky fragments of the planet still held relics of the Eelayin, which were collected and studied by Kallidahin archaeologists. This planetoid and its surrounding belt are home to several excavation sites and research facilities that are trying to uncover what happened to the planet and her people.

pl.description: Polis Massa jest planetoidem w gęstym pasie asteroid sektora Subterrel, z dala od głównych tras. Stanowi fragment zniszczonej planety, której podziemną cywilizację Eellayin pochłonęła katastrofa. Kallidahańscy archeolodzy prowadzą liczne wykopaliska i laboratoria, zbierając relikty oraz próbując wyjaśnić zagładę świata i jego mieszkańców.

en.description: Polis Massa was a planetoid in a dense asteroid field located in the Subterrel sector of the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories, far from any major hyperspace lanes. hut.description: Polis Massa is a fragment of a destroyed world in a remote asteroid field. The subterranean Eellayin civilization vanished with the planet. Kallidahin excavation sites and laboratories collect relics and seek the cause of destruction.

Planet.name: Kalee
Planet.description: Home world to the Kaleesh people. They are a spiritual species and their architecture reflects that with grandiose temples. The world consists of green plains mixed with rocky cliffs and large oceans.

pl.description: Kalee jest ojczyzną duchowych Kaleeshów. Zielone równiny przeplatają się ze skalnymi urwiskami i wielkimi oceanami, a monumentalne świątynie odzwierciedlają religijny charakter społeczeństwa. Krajobraz, architektura i tradycje przodków pozostają głównymi elementami tożsamości planety.

en.description: Home world to the Kaleesh people. They are a spiritual species and their architecture reflects that with grandiose temples. The world consists of green plains mixed with rocky cliffs and large oceans.

hut.description: Kalee is the spiritual Kaleesh homeworld of green plains, cliffs, and great oceans. Grand temples reflect a society shaped by ancestors and faith. Landscape and sacred architecture define its identity.

Planet.name: Muunilinst
Planet.description: Muunilinst is the Banking Clan Headquarters. It consists of large cities, open plains, and massive reed forests. Places of note are the Banking Clan Headquarters, and the massive ground based orbital defenses. The Banking Clans influential grasp upon the galaxy officiated Muunilinst’s wealth within the galaxy. An urban complex for rich elites.

pl.description: Muunilinst jest siedzibą Klanu Bankowego i jednym z najbogatszych światów galaktyki. Wielkie miasta, równiny i lasy trzcinowe otaczają główną kwaterę oraz masywne naziemne systemy obrony orbitalnej. Wpływy finansowe klanu zapewniły planecie potęgę i luksusowe kompleksy dla elit, a zgromadzony kapitał wymaga ochrony na skalę wojskową.

en.description: Muunilinst is the Banking Clan Headquarters. It consists of large cities, open plains, and massive reed forests. Places of note are the Banking Clan Headquarters, and the massive ground based orbital defenses. The Banking Clans influential grasp upon the galaxy officiated Muunilinst’s wealth within the galaxy. An urban complex for rich elites.

hut.description: Muunilinst is Banking Clan headquarters, enriched by galactic financial influence. Great cities, plains, reed forests, elite complexes, and immense ground-based orbital defenses surround the wealth. Credits and fortification rule together.

Planet.name: Belsavis
Planet.description: The planet’s surface is covered in ice except for small areas that are geothermically heated by active micro-volcanoes. The patches of oasis uncover valuable resources heavily desired for naval warships. However, with the limited amount that is accessible the CIS took over the planet to exploit its mining reserves.

pl.description: Belsavis pokrywa lód, z wyjątkiem niewielkich oaz ogrzewanych przez aktywne mikrowulkany. Odsłonięte obszary zawierają cenne surowce potrzebne do budowy okrętów wojennych. Niewielka dostępna ilość zwiększa ich wartość, dlatego CIS przejęło planetę i eksploatuje złoża. Kontrola nad oazami oznacza kontrolę nad całym wydobyciem.

en.description: The planet’s surface is covered in ice except for small areas that are geothermically heated by active micro-volcanoes. The patches of oasis uncover valuable resources heavily desired for naval warships. However, with the limited amount that is accessible the CIS took over the planet to exploit its mining reserves.

hut.description: Belsavis is icebound except for geothermal oases created by micro-volcanoes. Those patches expose scarce materials desired for warships. CIS seized the world to exploit them; whoever controls the oases controls the mines.

Planet.name: Ziost
Planet.description: Once considered the gateway to the Empire, the planet of Ziost connected multiple Sith worlds via hyperspace lanes. At one point in time, the planet was even the capital of the Ancient Sith Empires before the Galactic Cold War. That, however, was hundreds, if not thousands, of years before its ultimate fate. No matter what the world had once been, landscape or relevance, it does not matter in the modern age of the Republic. The planet would end up being the genocidal birthplace of the original Sith Emperor of the modern Sith Empires. Tenebrae, the Lord of all Sith, went by many names. His creation would be the death of an entire world and all of its essence, all of the Force itself, being consumed by him. In an ancient ritual where he brought about the downfall of his people, consuming all who had participated, using their strength to further finish his consumption of the planet. The once proud capital was reduced to ash and silenced in but moments. The Force itself is void and absent. Monstrous creatures devoid of all life roam the planet, seeking to consume the very life from victims that stumble upon the dead world.

pl.description: Ziost był niegdyś bramą i stolicą starożytnych imperiów Sithów. Tenebrae, późniejszy Imperator Sithów, dokonał rytuału pochłaniającego mieszkańców, ich energię i samą obecność Mocy. Dumna stolica w jednej chwili stała się popiołem. Dziś martwy świat przemierzają bezżyciowe potwory wysysające energię z ofiar, a dawne szlaki i znaczenie polityczne pozostają wyłącznie wspomnieniem.

hut.description: Ziost was once a Sith gateway and capital. Tenebrae's ancient ritual consumed its people, essence, and the Force itself, reducing the world to ash. Lifeless monsters now hunt any visitor. Former power has become only silence and danger.

Planet.name: Jedha
Planet.description: A planet with vast deserts and sheer cliff mountain range as well as colorful mesas. The planet also hosts diverse wildlife that have adapted to the harsh climate. Jedha has a large amount of Kyber crystal deposits along with multiple sandstone temples over the top of those deposits.

pl.description: Jedha jest pustynnym światem wysokich urwisk, barwnych płaskowyżów i fauny przystosowanej do skrajnego klimatu. Występują tam rozległe złoża kryształów kyber, nad którymi wzniesiono liczne świątynie z piaskowca. Połączenie surowca i miejsc kultu nadaje planecie wyjątkowe znaczenie duchowe, archeologiczne oraz strategiczne.

en.description: A planet with vast deserts and sheer cliff mountain range as well as colorful mesas. The planet also hosts diverse wildlife that have adapted to the harsh climate. Jedha has a large amount of Kyber crystal deposits along with multiple sandstone temples over the top of those deposits.

hut.description: Jedha is a desert world of cliffs, colorful mesas, and hardy wildlife. Great kyber deposits lie beneath sandstone temples. Sacred tradition and strategic crystal wealth occupy the same ground.

Planet.name: Zygerria
Planet.description: Zygerria is the homeworld of the Slaver Zygerrians who build their cities on lush mesas surrounded by an arid savanna. Zygerrian cities are known for their large slave markets, and massive places. Their slave fighting arenas host a variety of dangerous and exotic animals.

pl.description: Zygerria jest ojczyzną handlarzy niewolników, którzy budują miasta na bujnych płaskowyżach otoczonych suchą sawanną. Rozległe targi niewolników, pałace oraz areny walk definiują miejscową gospodarkę i władzę. Na arenach wykorzystuje się liczne niebezpieczne, egzotyczne zwierzęta, czyniąc przemoc zarówno narzędziem kontroli, jak i widowiskiem.

en.description: Zygerria is the homeworld of the Slaver Zygerrians who build their cities on lush mesas surrounded by an arid savanna. Zygerrian cities are known for their large slave markets, and massive places. Their slave fighting arenas host a variety of dangerous and exotic animals.

hut.description: Zygerria is the slaver homeworld, with cities on lush mesas above arida savanna. Slave markets, palaces, and fighting arenas define wealth and rule. Exotic predators turn violence into control and spectacle.

Planet.name: Malachor V
Planet.description: Malachor, or Malachor V, is a haunted planet. Deeply entrenched in one of the darkest days of the Old Republic, the planet is a tomb. All that makes up its surface is rock, ash, and mountains of long-abandoned and barren landscapes. To venture to Malachor is to seek out the ghosts of long-forgotten mistakes. And yet many adventurers and fortune seekers still brave the surface of the planet covered in eternal storm, hoping to find long relics and artifacts from the age of the Ancient Jedi and Sith.

pl.description: Malachor V jest nawiedzonym grobowcem jednego z najciemniejszych wydarzeń Starej Republiki. Skały, popiół i góry tworzą opuszczony krajobraz pod wieczną burzą. Mimo ostrzeżeń poszukiwacze przygód i fortuny przybywają po relikty dawnych Jedi i Sithów. Każda wyprawa oznacza wejście między ślady błędów, których skutki przetrwały tysiąclecia.

en.description: Malachor, or Malachor V, is a haunted planet. Deeply entrenched in one of the darkest days of the Old Republic, the planet is a tomb. All that makes up its surface is rock, ash, and mountains of long-abandoned and barren landscapes. To venture to Malachor is to seek out the ghosts of long-forgotten mistakes.
