hut.description: Malachor V is a haunted tomb of the Old Republic, all rock, ash, mountains, and eternal storm. Fortune seekers still hunt Jedi and Sith relics. Every promised artifact carries the debt of ancient catastrophe.

Planet.name: Ossus
Planet.description: A planet affiliated with the Jedi order, the place of the first Jedi Temple. After an intense battle during the old Republic era the planet was decimated, few jedi survived becoming tribal Ysanna. The planet was known to have grassy plains and a connection to force sensitive people.

pl.description: Ossus jest związany z Zakonem Jedi i tradycją pierwszej świątyni. Wielka bitwa epoki Starej Republiki spustoszyła planetę; nieliczni ocalali Jedi stali się plemiennymi Ysanna. Trawiaste równiny oraz silny związek z osobami wrażliwymi na Moc podtrzymują duchowe znaczenie świata mimo dawnych zniszczeń.

en.description: A planet affiliated with the Jedi order, the place of the first Jedi Temple. After an intense battle during the old Republic era the planet was decimated, few jedi survived becoming tribal Ysanna. The planet was known to have grassy plains and a connection to force sensitive people.

hut.description: Ossus is tied to the first Jedi Temple. An Old Republic battle devastated the world, and surviving Jedi became the tribal Ysanna. Grasslands and a strong bond with Force-sensitive people preserve its sacred value.

Planet.name: Zeltros
Planet.description: Zeltros is the home of the Zeltron species, a race of near-human aliens that have a specialized connection to emotions and a pheromone that allows them to comfort and calm almost any individual. Due to this, the Zeltron people have marketed their world to whoever has been the ruler of the galaxy at large. They offer services for either pleasure or party to the highest bidder. Currently, Zeltros finds itself as the premier pleasure world of the Republic, hosting Governors, Politicians, Senators, Generals, Admirals, and even Chancellors if they fancy. It is a world to escape the woes of the galaxy at large, and yet it is also often used as a hidden punishment for failure. Removing problematic individuals within the Republic to keep them satiated and quiet. The planet itself is a temperate coastal world, with beaches and palm trees covering its surface.

pl.description: Zeltros jest ojczyzną Zeltronów, bliskich ludziom istot odczuwających emocje i wydzielających uspokajające feromony. Nadmorski świat plaż i palm stał się głównym ośrodkiem rozrywki Republiki, goszcząc polityków i dowódców. Bywa też wygodnym wygnaniem dla osób problematycznych, którym oferuje się luksus w zamian za milczenie. Przyjemność pełni tu funkcję gospodarczą i polityczną.

en.description: Zeltros is the home of the Zeltron species, a race of near-human aliens that have a specialized connection to emotions and a pheromone that allows them to comfort and calm almost any individual. Due to this, the Zeltron people have marketed their world to whoever has been the ruler of the galaxy at large. They offer services for either pleasure or party to the highest bidder. Currently, Zeltros finds itself as the premier pleasure world of the Republic, hosting Governors, Politicians, Senators, Generals, Admirals, and even Chancellors if they fancy. It is a world to escape the woes of the galaxy at large, and yet it is also often used as a hidden punishment for failure. Removing problematic individuals within the Republic to keep them satiated and quiet. The planet itself is a temperate coastal world, with beaches and palm trees covering its surface.

hut.description: Zeltros is the coastal Zeltron pleasure-world. Emotional sensitivity and calming pheromones support parties and services for Republica elites. The world also serves as luxurious exile for troublesome officials—comfort purchased in exchange for silence.

Planet.name: Takodana
Planet.description: A world of short tree forests and a ton of tiny lakes scattered across the surface. There are random temples dotted around the world that have been converted into resorts and castles for rich aristocrats. As well as a smuggler's haven.

pl.description: Takodana jest światem niskich lasów i niezliczonych małych jezior. Rozproszone świątynie zostały przekształcone w kurorty i zamki zamożnych arystokratów. Jednocześnie odosobnienie oraz liczne kryjówki uczyniły planetę bezpieczną przystanią przemytników, tworząc sąsiedztwo luksusu i działalności poza prawem.

en.description: A world of short tree forests and a ton of tiny lakes scattered across the surface. There are random temples dotted around the world that have been converted into resorts and castles for rich aristocrats. As well as a smuggler's haven.

hut.description: Takodana has short forests, countless lakes, and old temples converted into resorts and aristocratic castles. The same secluded landscape shelters smugglers, placing luxury and shadow trade side by side.

Planet.name: Kiffu
Planet.description: Kiffu is home to the near human Kiffar. It is also an arid world, with many deserts, and mountains. The CIS have invaded and are brutally suppressing the locals. This is an occupation which many locals fight against yet each time they try they are suppressed.

pl.description: Kiffu jest suchą ojczyzną bliskoludzkich Kiffarów, pełną pustyń i gór. CIS okupuje planetę i brutalnie tłumi ludność. Mieszkańcy wielokrotnie organizują opór, lecz każde wystąpienie spotyka się z represją. Konflikt nie jest zwykłym starciem wojskowym, lecz trwającą walką o przetrwanie miejscowej tożsamości i samostanowienia.

en.description: Kiffu is home to the near human Kiffar. It is also an arid world, with many deserts, and mountains. The CIS have invaded and are brutally suppressing the locals. This is an occupation which many locals fight against yet each time they try they are suppressed.

hut.description: Kiffu is the arida mountain home of the near-human Kiffar. CIS occupation brutally suppresses repeated local resistance. The conflict is not merely military; it is a continuing struggle for identity and self-rule.

Planet.name: Bothawui
Planet.description: Bothawui is the homeworld of the Bothans. It is a temperate world of forests, mountains, and cities in the pains between. With many cities and academies including Republic Naval academies being a center of learning in the sector making it of the utmost importance to the Republic Navy. The world is also a center of commerce and space traffic being host to some major spaceports. It also hosts an extensive asteroid field around a nearby Gas Giant that is the predicted host spot for all spacebattles in the region.

pl.description: Bothawui jest umiarkowaną ojczyzną Bothan, z lasami, górami i miastami na równinach. Liczne akademie, w tym szkoły marynarki Republiki, czynią planetę centrum nauki i szkolenia. Wielkie porty kosmiczne obsługują handel oraz ruch tranzytowy. Pobliskie pole asteroid przy gazowym olbrzymie jest przewidywanym miejscem głównych bitew kosmicznych regionu.

en.description: Bothawui is the homeworld of the Bothans. It is a temperate world of forests, mountains, and cities in the pains between. With many cities and academies including Republic Naval academies being a center of learning in the sector making it of the utmost importance to the Republic Navy. The world is also a center of commerce and space traffic being host to some major spaceports. It also hosts an extensive asteroid field around a nearby Gas Giant that is the predicted host spot for all spacebattles in the region.

hut.description: Bothawui is the Bothan homeworld of forests, mountains, and plain cities. Republica naval academies make it a learning center, while major spaceports drive commerce. A nearby asteroid field is the likely ground for regional fleet battles.

Planet.name: Tython
Planet.description: Tyton is a world of forests, snow capped mountains, and grassy plains. Tython is a very important world to the Jedi as it is considered the origin point of the Jedi order in some legends. There are many Jedi ruins throughout the world that the Order does not want desecrated; all trespassers are to be executed.

pl.description: Tython jest światem lasów, ośnieżonych gór i trawiastych równin. W niektórych tradycjach uchodzi za miejsce narodzin Zakonu Jedi. Liczne ruiny mają ogromne znaczenie historyczne i duchowe, dlatego Zakon nie dopuszcza do ich profanacji. Nieupoważnieni przybysze są traktowani jako bezpośrednie zagrożenie dla chronionego dziedzictwa.

en.description: Tyton is a world of forests, snow capped mountains, and grassy plains. Tython is a very important world to the Jedi as it is considered the origin point of the Jedi order in some legends. There are many Jedi ruins throughout the world that the Order does not want desecrated; all trespassers are to be executed.

hut.description: Tython is a world of forests, snowy mountains, and grasslands, named in some traditions as the Jedi birthplace. Numerous ruins carry sacred value. The Order guards them ruthlessly against trespass and desecration.

Planet.name: Serenno
Planet.description: Serenno is a planet of mountains, blue tree forests, and savannas with the occasional city. Of particular importance is Dooku's palace and Great Assembly House which are important locations for the CIS holding valuable intel. Additionally the Spike is an important CIS prison holding many important members of the Republic including Jedi.

high_value_targets.name: Count Dooku
high_value_targets.title: Leader of the CIS
high_value_targets.intel: The former Jedi and now Sith Confederate Head of State.

high_value_targets.name: Moralo Eval
high_value_targets.title: Bounty Hunter
high_value_targets.intel: He is a Phindian criminal mastermind and serial killer. He is responsible for a plot to assassinate the Chancellor.

high_value_targets.name: Separatist Intelligence Informant
high_value_targets.title: Republic Spy
high_value_targets.intel: A republic spy in the heart of the Separatist intelligence agency he needs extraction before his cover is blown as he has intel vital to the republic.

pl.description: Serenno jest światem gór, sawann i lasów o niebieskich drzewach, z rozproszonymi miastami. Pałac Dooku oraz Dom Wielkiego Zgromadzenia są kluczowymi ośrodkami CIS i mogą zawierać cenne dane. Więzienie zwane Iglicą przetrzymuje ważnych jeńców Republiki, w tym Jedi, nadając planecie szczególne znaczenie wywiadowcze i operacyjne.

en.description: Serenno is a planet of mountains, blue tree forests, and savannas with the occasional city. Of particular importance is Dooku's palace and Great Assembly House which are important locations for the CIS holding valuable intel. Additionally the Spike is an important CIS prison holding many important members of the Republic including Jedi.

hut.description: Serenno has mountains, savannas, blue forests, and scattered cities. Dooku's palace and Great Assembly House hold CIS value and intel. The Spire prison contains important Republica captives, including Jedi.

Planet.name: Ord Trasi
Planet.description: As a major ship building planet, it is encircled by a massive shipyard ring. On the surface there are thousands of mines churning out the rare materials and metals that help with the shipyard.

pl.description: Ord Trasi jest wielkim światem stoczniowym otoczonym olbrzymim pierścieniem zakładów orbitalnych. Tysiące kopalń na powierzchni dostarczają rzadkich materiałów i metali bezpośrednio do produkcji okrętów. Integracja wydobycia z montażem pozwala ograniczyć transport i czyni planetę samowystarczalnym ośrodkiem przemysłu morskiego.

en.description: As a major ship building planet, it is encircled by a massive shipyard ring. On the surface there are thousands of mines churning out the rare materials and metals that help with the shipyard.

hut.description: Ord Trasi is encircled by a massive shipyard ring. Thousands of surface mines feed rare materials directly into construction. Integrated extraction and assembly make it a powerful naval industry-world.

Planet.name: Ord Mantell
Planet.description: A military supply world Ord Mantel is heavily controlled by the Black Sun syndicate from behind the scenes. Ord Mantel is a mountainous, arid world, with large seas.

pl.description: Ord Mantell jest górzystym, suchym światem z wielkimi morzami i ważnym zapleczem zaopatrzenia wojskowego. Oficjalną administrację przenikają zakulisowe wpływy syndykatu Czarne Słońce. Połączenie magazynów, transportu i przestępczej kontroli sprawia, że planeta ma znaczenie zarówno dla regularnych armii, jak i półświatka.

en.description: A military supply world Ord Mantel is heavily controlled by the Black Sun syndicate from behind the scenes. Ord Mantel is a mountainous, arid world, with large seas.

hut.description: Ord Mantell is an arida mountain world with large seas and military supply infrastructure. Black Sun quietly controls much of it from behind official rule. Warehouses and shadow influence serve armies and criminals alike.

Planet.name: Ringo Vinda
Planet.description: A civilian graving dock surrounded Ringo Vinda in space. It was used for ship maintenance, repair, and construction. It is filled with long corridors and choke points. Many civilians can be found here while they are traveling or selling, it is a hub for the economy.

pl.description: Ringo Vinda otacza cywilny dok grawitacyjny służący do konserwacji, naprawy i budowy statków. Kompleks tworzą długie korytarze oraz liczne wąskie przejścia, ważne również taktycznie. Przewijają się tam podróżni, kupcy i pracownicy, dzięki czemu instalacja jest znaczącym węzłem gospodarki oraz transportu.

en.description: A civilian graving dock surrounded Ringo Vinda in space. It was used for ship maintenance, repair, and construction. It is filled with long corridors and choke points. Many civilians can be found here while they are traveling or selling, it is a hub for the economy.

hut.description: A civilian graving dock surrounds Ringo Vinda, maintaining, repairing, and building ships. Long corridors and choke points fill the complex. Travelers, merchants, and workers make it an economic and transport hub.

Planet.name: Dxun
Planet.description: Dxun, otherwise known as the “Demon Moon”, is an ancient and culturally important moon to the True Mandalorians. The moon is covered in thick, overgrown forests, swamps, and mountains. It was once considered the stronghold world of Mandalore the Ultimate, and as such, it is covered in ancient Mandalorian architecture and defensive positions. The Mandalorian Wars scars can be seen within a majority of the moon's surface as ancient starships, the skeletons of warriors long forgotten, and burial sites left behind in its bombardment by the Old Republic. The moon’s fauna and wildlife are some of the deadliest and most hostile in the galaxy, having once slaughtered Mandandalore the Indomitable. Due to this and its unimportance to the galaxy at large, the moon has been mostly abandoned and left to the annals of time.

pl.description: Dxun, „Księżyc Demonów”, ma wielkie znaczenie dla Prawdziwych Mandalorian. Zarośnięte lasy, bagna i góry kryją fortyfikacje Mandalora Ostatecznego, wraki, szkielety oraz groby z Wojen Mandaloriańskich. Miejscowa fauna należy do najgroźniejszej w galaktyce i miała zgładzić Mandalora Nieposkromionego. Odosobniony księżyc porzucono, lecz jego ruiny nadal przechowują bolesne dziedzictwo.

en.description: Dxun, otherwise known as the “Demon Moon”, is an ancient and culturally important moon to the True Mandalorians. The moon is covered in thick, overgrown forests, swamps, and mountains. It was once considered the stronghold world of Mandalore the Ultimate, and as such, it is covered in ancient Mandalorian architecture and defensive positions. The Mandalorian Wars scars can be seen within a majority of the moon's surface as ancient starships, the skeletons of warriors long forgotten, and burial sites left behind in its bombardment by the Old Republic. The moon’s fauna and wildlife are some of the deadliest and most hostile in the galaxy, having once slaughtered Mandandalore the Indomitable. Due to this and its unimportance to the galaxy at large, the moon has been mostly abandoned and left to the annals of time.

hut.description: Dxun, the Demon Moon, is sacred to True Mandalorians. Forests and swamps hide ancient defenses, wrecks, bones, and graves from the Mandalorian Wars. Its fauna ranks among the galaxy's deadliest. The abandoned moon preserves a violent inheritance.

Planet.name: Wayland
Planet.description: A lush semi-tropical planet with many forests and mountains. Here, a core Separatist R&D base exists and is led by genetic Terrorist Zeta Magnus. Further knowledge of this planet is scarce due to an admin filing error removing all records of the planet out of the astrogation charts and planetary logs.

pl.description: Wayland jest bujną, półtropikalną planetą lasów i gór. Znajduje się tam kluczowa baza badawczo-rozwojowa Separatystów kierowana przez terrorystę-genetyka Zetę Magnusa. Niewiele wiadomo o obiekcie, ponieważ błąd administracyjny usunął planetę z map astrogacyjnych i rejestrów. Brak dokumentacji zapewnił bazie doskonałą osłonę przed kontrolą.

en.description: A lush semi-tropical planet with many forests and mountains. Here, a core Separatist R&D base exists and is led by genetic Terrorist Zeta Magnus. Further knowledge of this planet is scarce due to an admin filing error removing all records of the planet out of the astrogation charts and planetary logs.

hut.description: Wayland is a lush semi-tropica world holding a core Separatista research base led by genetic terrorist Zeta Magnus. An administrative error erased the planet from charts and logs, providing exceptional concealment.

Planet.name: Lah'mu
Planet.description: The remote farming world Lah'mu held many minor farms which sustained its small economy. It is a planet of large dirt plains and scattered mounds of grass. The soil was fertile and at times difficult to traverse.

pl.description: Lah'mu jest odległym światem rolniczym złożonym z rozległych równin gleby i rozproszonych pagórków traw. Niewielkie gospodarstwa podtrzymują skromną gospodarkę. Żyzna ziemia zapewnia dobre plony, lecz grząski i nierówny teren bywa trudny do pokonania, co ogranicza transport oraz skalę infrastruktury.

en.description: The remote farming world Lah'mu held many minor farms which sustained its small economy. It is a planet of large dirt plains and scattered mounds of grass. The soil was fertile and at times difficult to traverse.

hut.description: Lah'mu is a remote farming world of broad soil plains and scattered grass mounds. Small farms sustain a modest economy. Fertile but difficult ground rewards cultivation while complicating travel and infrastructure.

Planet.name: Onderon
Planet.description: Onderon is a warm human world of blue jungles, red messas, lakes, and old ruins. Every city is walled due to the dangerous wildlife that makes life outside of them difficult. The CIS are trying to overthrow the current King Ramsis Dendup with the usurper Sanjay Rash.

high_value_targets.name: Sanjay Rash
high_value_targets.title: CIS Royal Usurper
high_value_targets.intel: Help the Onderonian loyalists bring him to justice.

high_value_targets.name: General Kalani
high_value_targets.title: CIS Command
high_value_targets.intel: Commands CIS forces on the ground and the next generation of T-Series.

high_value_targets.title: King Ramsis Dendup
high_value_targets.intel: Being held prisoner in his own Palace in the Capital in Iziz.

pl.description: Onderon jest ciepłym ludzkim światem niebieskich dżungli, czerwonych płaskowyżów, jezior i dawnych ruin. Niebezpieczna fauna zmusza każde miasto do utrzymywania murów. CIS próbuje obalić króla Ramsisa Dendupa i osadzić uzurpatora Sanjaya Rasha, przez co naturalne zagrożenia łączą się z trwającym kryzysem politycznym.

en.description: Onderon is a warm human world of blue jungles, red messas, lakes, and old ruins. Every city is walled due to the dangerous wildlife that makes life outside of them difficult. The CIS are trying to overthrow the current King Ramsis Dendup with the usurper Sanjay Rash.

hut.description: Onderon is a warm human world of blue jungle, red mesas, lakes, and ruins. Dangerous wildlife forces every city behind walls. CIS seeks to replace King Ramsis Dendup with usurper Sanjay Rash, adding political crisis to natural danger.

Planet.name: Teth
Planet.description: This planet is a rocky jungle scaped planet. The jungle is made up of trees that twist with each other as they grow. The planet is scattered with many temples from the species that originally lived on the planet but have since gone extinct. These temples are positioned on top of the rock structures that jut far above the jungle. The Hutts now inhabit those temples and have converted them into strongholds. The world is in a state of hazy purple due to the atmosphere and thick fog.

pl.description: Teth jest skalistym światem dżunglowym spowitym fioletową mgłą. Splątane drzewa otaczają wysokie formacje skalne, na których wymarły gatunek pozostawił świątynie. Huttowie zajęli te budowle i przekształcili je w twierdze. Położenie ponad koronami lasu zapewnia doskonałą obserwację oraz obronę, a dawne dziedzictwo służy dziś celom kartelu.

en.description: This planet is a rocky jungle scaped planet. The jungle is made up of trees that twist with each other as they grow. The planet is scattered with many temples from the species that originally lived on the planet but have since gone extinct. These temples are positioned on top of the rock structures that jut far above the jungle. The Hutts now inhabit those temples and have converted them into strongholds. The world is in a state of hazy purple due to the atmosphere and thick fog.

hut.description: Teth is a rocky jungle world beneath purple haze. Temples of an extinct species stand atop tall formations above twisted trees. Hutts converted them into strongholds, turning ancient heritage into excellent defensive ground.

Planet.name: Raxus
Planet.description: A frozen Ice world Raxus contains the ancient ruin of Xim's empire with their ancient battle droids possibly frozen within. The CIS use the world as a hidden fortified base near their capital Raxus Secundus.

pl.description: Raxus jest zamarzniętym światem skrywającym ruiny imperium Xima oraz możliwe, uwięzione w lodzie starożytne droidy bojowe. CIS wykorzystuje planetę jako tajną, ufortyfikowaną bazę w pobliżu stolicy Raxus Secundus. Mróz i zapomniane konstrukcje zapewniają osłonę, lecz mogą również kryć nieprzewidywalne zagrożenia.

en.description: A frozen Ice world Raxus contains the ancient ruin of Xim's empire with their ancient battle droids possibly frozen within. The CIS use the world as a hidden fortified base near their capital Raxus Secundus.

hut.description: Raxus is a frozen world hiding ruins of Xim's empire and perhaps ancient battle droids trapped in ice. CIS uses it as a concealed fortified base near Raxus Secundus. Cold and relics provide cover and uncertain danger.

Planet.name: Raxus Secundus
Planet.description: A temperate world of wide plains, tall mountains, oceans, and orange forests Raxus Secundus is the Capital of the CIS. As such it is host to the Separatist Senate, the most important location in the Confederacy. Many secretive diplomatic talks have been held there by the peace faction of the Republic in an attempt to end the war.

high_value_targets.name: Mina Bonteri
high_value_targets.title: Senator
high_value_targets.intel: She is a human Separatist senator who is interested in negotiating an end to the war. Dooku and his lackeys wish to prevent this at all costs; she will be difficult to get to.

pl.description: Raxus Secundus jest umiarkowanym światem rozległych równin, wysokich gór, oceanów i pomarańczowych lasów. Jako stolica Konfederacji Systemów Niezależnych mieści Senat Separatystów oraz najważniejsze instytucje państwa. Przedstawiciele pokojowych stronnictw Republiki prowadzili tu poufne rozmowy, próbując zakończyć wojnę drogą dyplomatyczną.

en.description: A temperate world of wide plains, tall mountains, oceans, and orange forests Raxus Secundus is the Capital of the CIS. As such it is host to the Separatist Senate, the most important location in the Confederacy. Many secretive diplomatic talks have been held there by the peace faction of the Republic in an attempt to end the war.

hut.description: Raxus Secundus is the temperate capital of Separatista power, with plains, mountains, oceans, and orange forests. The Confederate Senate rules here, while secret peace talks test whether war can still be settled without another costly bargain.

Planet.name: Gridlock
Planet.description: Gridlock is a campaign-defined human colony of continental grasslands supporting about five hundred thousand inhabitants. Its open plains provide room for dispersed settlements and agriculture, while the existing planetary survey also indicates accessible mineral deposits. No dependable Halo lore source identifies a canonical planet under this name, so its system history, native life and founding date remain unclassified. The record deliberately uses only established campaign data and replaces the unrelated description previously stored here. Gridlock's current importance comes from its modest population, usable terrain and location within the UNSC route network.

pl.description: Gridlock jest ustanowioną na potrzeby kampanii ludzką kolonią pośród kontynentalnych równin trawiastych, zamieszkaną przez około pół miliona osób. Otwarte tereny sprzyjają rozproszonemu osadnictwu i rolnictwu, a badania wskazują na dostępne złoża minerałów. Brak wiarygodnego źródła Halo potwierdzającego kanoniczną planetę o tej nazwie, dlatego historia układu, rodzime życie i data założenia kolonii pozostają nieustalone. Znaczenie Gridlock wynika dziś z użytecznych terenów, umiarkowanej ludności i położenia w sieci tras UNSC.

en.description: Gridlock is a campaign-defined human colony of continental grasslands supporting about five hundred thousand inhabitants. Its open plains provide room for dispersed settlements and agriculture, while the existing planetary survey also indicates accessible mineral deposits. No dependable Halo lore source identifies a canonical planet under this name, so its system history, native life and founding date remain unclassified. The record deliberately uses only established campaign data and replaces the unrelated description previously stored here. Gridlock's current importance comes from its modest population, usable terrain and location within the UNSC route network.

hut.description: Gridlock is a campaign human colony of open grasslands and roughly half a million residents. Farming, accessible minerals, and a place in the UNSC route net give it value. Canon records for this world are unavailable, so its older history remains unpriced and unknown.

Planet.name: Myrkr
Planet.description: Unusually, this planet has a strange tree that has an extremely high metal content. These trees mess with most sensors. Otherwise there are a few plains, some low mountains, and a few port cities.

pl.description: Myrkr porastają niezwykłe drzewa o wyjątkowo wysokiej zawartości metalu, zakłócające działanie większości czujników. Poza lasami występują równiny, niskie pasma górskie i nieliczne miasta portowe. Naturalne ekranowanie utrudnia obserwację z orbity, czyniąc planetę dogodnym miejscem dla operacji wymagających dyskrecji.

en.description: Unusually, this planet has a strange tree that has an extremely high metal content. These trees mess with most sensors. Otherwise there are a few plains, some low mountains, and a few port cities.

hut.description: Myrkr's metal-rich trees interfere with most sensors. Plains, low mountains, and a few port cities lie beyond the forests. Natural concealment makes the world useful to anyone whose cargo or business should remain unseen.

Planet.name: Shili
Planet.description: Home to the sentient tortuga species, colorful grasslands, expansive pine tree forests and rolling hills, and famous for melodramatic holovids. Shili is a longtime member of the Galactic Republic and the original home of several notable Jedi. Many beasts also call this planet home such as the Akul, a formidable beast requiring multiple tribes of Togruta to work together to defeat it.

pl.description: Shili jest ojczyzną Togrutów, znaną z barwnych łąk, rozległych lasów iglastych i łagodnych wzgórz. Od dawna należy do Republiki i wydała wielu znamienitych Jedi. Bogata fauna obejmuje akule — potężne drapieżniki, których pokonanie tradycyjnie wymaga współpracy kilku plemion, wzmacniając wspólnotowy charakter miejscowej kultury.

en.description: Home to the sentient tortuga species, colorful grasslands, expansive pine tree forests and rolling hills, and famous for melodramatic holovids. Shili is a longtime member of the Galactic Republic and the original home of several notable Jedi. Many beasts also call this planet home such as the Akul, a formidable beast requiring multiple tribes of Togruta to work together to defeat it.

hut.description: Shili is the Togruta homeworld of colorful grasslands, pine forests, and rolling hills. A loyal Republica member and birthplace of notable Jedi, it also breeds deadly akul whose hunt demands many tribes share risk and honor.

Planet.name: Umbara
Planet.description: Umbara, otherwise known as the “Shadow World,” is a planet that's covered in eternal darkness. Not receiving the majority of sunlight from its star, its people have never seen the light of day. Umbara itself is a deeply forested overgrowth world, and while it is not fully sentient, unlike Kashyyyk and Felucia, it is ripe with living fauna that seek to kill and consume those that get near them. Umbara is also a natural world that harbors Doonium, making it the perfect world to mine the valuable resource for ship production. Interestingly, the planet had once been the homeworld of the New Sith Empire under the Brotherhood of Darkness. Rumor says that the Sith academies that once hid within its mountains may yet still exist.

pl.description: Umbara, zwana Światem Cieni, pozostaje pogrążona w niemal wiecznej ciemności z powodu znikomej ilości światła docierającego z gwiazdy. Gęsta, wroga roślinność i drapieżna fauna czynią powierzchnię skrajnie niebezpieczną. Złoża doonium mają wielką wartość dla przemysłu okrętowego. Dawne związki z Bractwem Ciemności podsycają pogłoski o ukrytych w górach akademiach Sithów.

Not receiving the majority of sunlight from its star, its people have never seen the light of day. Interestingly, the planet had once been the homeworld of the New Sith Empire under the Brotherhood of Darkness. Rumor says that the Sith academies that once hid within its mountains may yet still exist.

hut.description: Umbara is the Shadow World, starved of sunlight and choked by predatory forest. Valuable doonium feeds ship production, while rumors place forgotten Sith academies in the mountains. Darkness conceals both ore and old liabilities.

Planet.name: Malastare
Planet.description: The dry purple desert planet of Malastare was home to the Dugg species. The fauna was generally barren due to an important toxic fuel that resided under the planet’s surface. The fuel was valuable as it was necessary for military and commercial products. However, the extraction of the fuel is dangerous because of predators who have evolved into large beasts, almost impossible to neutralize. Nonetheless, the Dugg people have created refineries to fuel their economy as well as their podracers.

pl.description: Malastare jest suchą, purpurową planetą pustynną i ojczyzną Dugów. Pod jałową powierzchnią zalega toksyczne paliwo niezbędne w produkcji wojskowej i cywilnej. Wydobycie jest niebezpieczne zarówno z powodu właściwości surowca, jak i wielkich drapieżników. Mimo ryzyka Dugowie utrzymują rafinerie, które napędzają gospodarkę oraz słynne wyścigi ścigaczy.

en.description: The dry purple desert planet of Malastare was home to the Dugg species. The fauna was generally barren due to an important toxic fuel that resided under the planet’s surface. The fuel was valuable as it was necessary for military and commercial products. However, the extraction of the fuel is dangerous because of predators who have evolved into large beasts, almost impossible to neutralize. Nonetheless, the Dugg people have created refineries to fuel their economy as well as their podracers.

hut.description: Malastare is the purple desert home of the Dugs. Toxic fuel beneath the wastes serves military and civilian markets, though giant predators make extraction hazardous. Refineries finance the world—and its famous podracing wagers.

Planet.name: Dantooine
Planet.description: Dantooine is a farming planet with very mild weather. Most of the surface consists of grassy plains and rolling hills. Some of these hills are dotted with Balba trees. There are some forested hills containing creeks, rivers, and lakes.

pl.description: Dantooine jest spokojnym światem rolniczym o łagodnym klimacie. Trawiaste równiny i faliste wzgórza porastają miejscami drzewa balba, a wśród zalesionych wzniesień płyną potoki i rzeki zasilające jeziora. Żyzne tereny sprzyjają rozproszonemu osadnictwu oraz produkcji żywności.

en.description: Dantooine is a farming planet with very mild weather. Most of the surface consists of grassy plains and rolling hills. Some of these hills are dotted with Balba trees. There are some forested hills containing creeks, rivers, and lakes.

hut.description: Dantooine is a mild farming world of grass plains, rolling hills, balba trees, streams, and lakes. Fertile land favors scattered settlements and dependable harvests rather than dense city markets.

Planet.name: Devaron
Planet.description: The jungle planet Devaron is the home world of the Devaronian species. The natural beauty of the planet was deliberately maintained by the natives, making sure of the ecosystem's health. The Devaronian's shared desire to keep the planet unsullied by over industrialization is a phenomenon compared to the rest of the galaxy. The natives provided a place for the wild life to thrive and become connected deeply to the Force.

pl.description: Devaron, dżunglowa ojczyzna Devaronian, zachowała znaczną część naturalnego piękna dzięki świadomemu ograniczaniu nadmiernej industrializacji. Mieszkańcy chronią równowagę ekosystemu, pozwalając dzikiej faunie rozwijać się bez rozległej ingerencji. Nienaruszone środowisko ma również silny związek z Mocą, co wyróżnia planetę na tle wielu uprzemysłowionych światów galaktyki.

en.description: The jungle planet Devaron is the home world of the Devaronian species. The natural beauty of the planet was deliberately maintained by the natives, making sure of the ecosystem's health. The Devaronian's shared desire to keep the planet unsullied by over industrialization is a phenomenon compared to the rest of the galaxy. The natives provided a place for the wild life to thrive and become connected deeply to the Force.

hut.description: Devaron is the jungle home of the Devaronians. Its people restrain heavy industry to preserve wildlife and a landscape deeply touched by the Force. Untouched land is the world's greatest asset and must not be spent cheaply.

Planet.name: Raxus Prime
Planet.description: Raxus Prime is a junk world underbelly of the CIS. What regions aren’t covered in garbage are either toxic seas or smog producing factories. The piles of trash bury the ruins of the Tion Civilization. It also hosts a secret fortress of Count Dooku somewhere in the world.

pl.description: Raxus Prime jest zatrutym złomowiskiem i przemysłowym zapleczem CIS. Większość powierzchni pokrywają góry odpadów, toksyczne morza oraz fabryki wytwarzające gęsty smog. Pod warstwami śmieci spoczywają ruiny cywilizacji Tion. Gdzieś na planecie hrabia Dooku utrzymuje tajną twierdzę, dodatkowo zwiększając jej znaczenie strategiczne.

en.description: Raxus Prime is a junk world underbelly of the CIS. What regions aren’t covered in garbage are either toxic seas or smog producing factories. The piles of trash bury the ruins of the Tion Civilization. It also hosts a secret fortress of Count Dooku somewhere in the world.

hut.description: Raxus Prime is a poisoned scrapyard serving CIS industry. Waste mountains, toxic seas, and smog factories bury ruins of the Tion civilization. Count Dooku's hidden fortress adds strategic value to a world built on discarded assets.

Planet.name: Florrum
Planet.description: A desert world hideout for Pirates the only source of water is through the occasional geyser. The Hondo Ohnaka Gang is the main Pirate gang operating out of a series of massive fortified complexes. They have very impressive holding cells for prisoners considering they are a Pirate gang even capable of holding Jedi, and their complexes are more like fortresses capable of resisting a full on assault. These pirates are not to be underestimated as they have weaponry to match any of the major powers.

high_value_targets.name: Hondo Ohnaka
high_value_targets.title: Pirate Leader
high_value_targets.intel: Hondo Ohnaka is the elusive leader of the largest Pirate Gang commanding them from his fortified complex. He is wanted by both the Republic and CIS

pl.description: Florrum jest pustynną kryjówką piratów, gdzie wodę zapewniają jedynie sporadyczne gejzery. Gang Honda Ohnaki działa z rozległych, silnie ufortyfikowanych kompleksów, wyposażonych w cele zdolne przetrzymać nawet Jedi. Uzbrojenie i fortyfikacje piratów pozwalają im przeciwstawić się regularnym siłom, dlatego lekceważenie ich możliwości byłoby poważnym błędem.

en.description: A desert world hideout for Pirates the only source of water is through the occasional geyser. The Hondo Ohnaka Gang is the main Pirate gang operating out of a series of massive fortified complexes. They have very impressive holding cells for prisoners considering they are a Pirate gang even capable of holding Jedi, and their complexes are more like fortresses capable of resisting a full on assault. These pirates are not to be underestimated as they have weaponry to match any of the major powers.

hut.description: Florrum is a desert pirate refuge supplied by rare geysers. Hondo Ohnaka's gang occupies fortress-like compounds with cells fit even for Jedi. Their weapons rival major powers; these pirates bargain from strength.

Planet.name: Anaxes
Planet.description: Discovered first by one of the original ancient human civilizations before the age of the Republic, the Azure Imperium, Anaxes is an ancient fortress world and a bastion of strength within the Republic. Anaxes is a deeply forested, swampy, and mountainous world with cities and Republic bases scattered all across its surface. Deeply cultural to the Republic Navy, it is also a major staging ground for the First Army of the Republic and the training ground for Republic naval cadets. Academies and schools make up just as much of its infrastructure as its production lines and army barracks. Above the planet's surface, it holds one of the largest and most well-armed shipyards in the Republic fleet. Containing the ships and defensive fleet of not only the planet itself but the First Army. Vitally important to the Republic's war effort and recruitment, the planet is one of, if not the most important, military planets in the Republic's arsenal.

pl.description: Anaxes, odkryte przez starożytną ludzką cywilizację Azure Imperium, jest odwiecznym światem-fortecą Republiki. Lasy, mokradła i góry otaczają miasta, bazy, akademie, koszary oraz linie produkcyjne. Planeta stanowi główny ośrodek Pierwszej Armii Republiki i kuźnię kadr marynarki. Nad powierzchnią rozciągają się potężne stocznie wraz z silnie uzbrojoną flotą obronną, czyniąc Anaxes jednym z filarów republikańskiego wysiłku wojennego.

en.description: Discovered first by one of the original ancient human civilizations before the age of the Republic, the Azure Imperium, Anaxes is an ancient fortress world and a bastion of strength within the Republic. Anaxes is a deeply forested, swampy, and mountainous world with cities and Republic bases scattered all across its surface. Vitally important to the Republic's war effort and recruitment, the planet is one of, if not the most important, military planets in the Republic's arsenal.

hut.description: Anaxes is an ancient Republica fortress-world of forests, swamps, mountains, academies, barracks, factories, and mighty orbital yards. It trains naval cadets, stages the First Army, and guards fleets whose value is counted in the survival of the Republica itself.

Planet.name: Brentaal
Planet.description: Brentaal is a warm world of large swaths of farm land, winding rivers, jungles, and massive walled cities mostly compiled of warehouses. These warehouses were important due to the trade importance of Brentaal as it lied in the middle of important trade routes. The locals are heavily pro-separatist having assisted Shogar Tok a local warlord based out of a former prison turned fortress in conquering the planet as soon as the Clone War started.

high_value_targets.name: Shogar Tok
high_value_targets.title: Human Separatist Leader
high_value_targets.intel: Droid commander on a world based out of a former prison turned fortress. The locals adore him and have also taken up arms to assist him.

high_value_targets.name: Zolghast
high_value_targets.title: Zygerrian CIS Commander
high_value_targets.intel: He keeps a body guard of Geonosians and is extremely paranoid of getting captured; willing to have his own troops obliterate his position to prevent it.

pl.description: Brentaal jest ciepłym światem pól uprawnych, krętych rzek, dżungli i olbrzymich miast otoczonych murami. Rozległe dzielnice magazynowe obsługują handel na przecięciu ważnych szlaków nadprzestrzennych. Silne nastroje proseparatystyczne ułatwiły lokalnemu watażce Shogarowi Tokowi przejęcie planety z twierdzy urządzonej w dawnym więzieniu na początku Wojen Klonów.

en.description: Brentaal is a warm world of large swaths of farm land, winding rivers, jungles, and massive walled cities mostly compiled of warehouses. These warehouses were important due to the trade importance of Brentaal as it lied in the middle of important trade routes. The locals are heavily pro-separatist having assisted Shogar Tok a local warlord based out of a former prison turned fortress in conquering the planet as soon as the Clone War started.

hut.description: Brentaal is a warm trade-world of farms, rivers, jungle, walled cities, and vast warehouses at a major route junction. Pro-Separatista locals helped warlord Shogar Tok seize control from a prison turned fortress when the Clone Wars began.

Planet.name: Ord Cestus
Planet.description: Ord Cestus a red desert planet with the occasional volcano is the homeworld of the X'Ting although the human dominated Cestus Cybernetics, a subset of the Techno Union now rule the world. The world mainly produces fungi from fungal farms and droids for the CIS from factories owned by Cestus Cybernetics. The working conditions on the world are horrific and Cestus Cybernetics is only able to maintain their control of the world through their droid army.

pl.description: Ord Cestus jest czerwonym, pustynnym światem z nielicznymi wulkanami i ojczyzną X'Tingów. Faktyczną władzę sprawuje zdominowana przez ludzi Cestus Cybernetics, spółka zależna Unii Technokratycznej. Farmy grzybów zapewniają żywność, a fabryki produkują droidy dla CIS. Skrajnie ciężkie warunki pracy i prywatna armia droidów pozwalają korporacji utrzymywać kontrolę nad miejscową ludnością.

en.description: Ord Cestus a red desert planet with the occasional volcano is the homeworld of the X'Ting although the human dominated Cestus Cybernetics, a subset of the Techno Union now rule the world. The world mainly produces fungi from fungal farms and droids for the CIS from factories owned by Cestus Cybernetics. The working conditions on the world are horrific and Cestus Cybernetics is only able to maintain their control of the world through their droid army.

hut.description: Ord Cestus is the red desert home of the X'Ting, ruled in practice by Techno Union subsidiary Cestus Cybernetics. Fungal farms feed the world and factories supply CIS droids. Harsh labor and a private droid army keep the contract enforceable.

Planet.name: Carida
Planet.description: A mostly barren planet with many high mountains. It also features frozen ice fields and rain forests. But the gravity on this planet is much higher than the average habitable planet.

pl.description: Carida jest w większości jałowym światem wysokich gór, którego krajobraz obejmuje także skute lodem pola i lasy deszczowe. Grawitacja znacznie przewyższa normę większości zamieszkanych planet, utrudniając życie oraz szkolenie. Surowe warunki czynią ją wymagającym środowiskiem dla ludzi i infrastruktury.

en.description: A mostly barren planet with many high mountains. It also features frozen ice fields and rain forests. But the gravity on this planet is much higher than the average habitable planet.

hut.description: Carida is mostly barren, with high mountains, ice fields, and rainforest. Gravity is far stronger than on an ordinary inhabited world, making life, construction, and training expensive—but excellent for testing endurance.

Planet.name: Iridonia
Planet.description: Home to the Zabraks, this planet is generally arid and rough to live in. Sporting harsh red plains with carnivorous beasts around every corner. However, The harsh living has created a reliance upon cityscapes by the locals.

pl.description: Iridonia jest surową, suchą ojczyzną Zabraków. Czerwone równiny, trudny teren i liczne mięsożerne stworzenia sprawiają, że życie poza chronionymi osiedlami jest niebezpieczne. Odpowiedzią mieszkańców stały się zwarte miasta oraz kultura odporności ukształtowana przez wymagające środowisko.

en.description: Home to the Zabraks, this planet is generally arid and rough to live in. Sporting harsh red plains with carnivorous beasts around every corner. However, The harsh living has created a reliance upon cityscapes by the locals.

hut.description: Iridonia is the harsh arid home of the Zabrak. Red plains and carnivorous beasts make open country dangerous, driving settlement into defended cities. Endurance is not merely virtue here; it is survival capital.

Planet.name: Byss
Planet.description: An isolated planet that was lush with bright green plants and fields. The waters are brighter blue than most other Naboo-like planets with lakes and rivers in long chains through grand plateaus and canyons. Byss had no forests, only ferns and lichens.

pl.description: Byss jest odosobnionym, żyznym światem jaskrawozielonych pól i roślinności. Łańcuchy błękitnych jezior oraz rzek przecinają wielkie płaskowyże i kaniony. Zamiast rozległych lasów powierzchnię porastają głównie paprocie i porosty, nadając krajobrazowi otwarty, niemal parkowy charakter.

en.description: An isolated planet that was lush with bright green plants and fields. The waters are brighter blue than most other Naboo-like planets with lakes and rivers in long chains through grand plateaus and canyons. Byss had no forests, only ferns and lichens.

hut.description: Byss is an isolated lush world of bright green fields, plateaus, and canyons crossed by chains of blue lakes and rivers. Ferns and lichens replace great forests, leaving an open and unusually vivid landscape.

Planet.name: Cato Neimoidia
Planet.description: A perpetually foggy planet, shrouded by geysers that spewed water from its acidic, planet-wide oceans. Tower-like rock formations and massive natural arches rose from these seas, and upon them lay the plains and forests. The Neimoidians lived in dense cities of metal-vined bridges that spanned between the towering rock structures.

high_value_targets.name: Trade Federation Middle Management Employee
high_value_targets.intel: Holds a high enough position to gain intel from with not enough power within the Trade Federation to be noticed if he would go missing.

pl.description: Cato Neimoidia spowija nieustanna mgła unosząca się nad kwaśnymi oceanami całej planety. Z wód wyrastają wysokie formacje skalne i olbrzymie naturalne łuki, podtrzymujące równiny oraz lasy. Neimoidianie wznieśli na nich gęste miasta połączone metalowymi mostami, tworząc zabudowę zawieszoną wysoko nad nieprzyjaznym morzem.

en.description: A perpetually foggy planet, shrouded by geysers that spewed water from its acidic, planet-wide oceans. Tower-like rock formations and massive natural arches rose from these seas, and upon them lay the plains and forests. The Neimoidians lived in dense cities of metal-vined bridges that spanned between the towering rock structures.

hut.description: Cato Neimoidia rises above acidic global seas and perpetual geyser mist. Rock towers and natural arches carry forests, plains, and dense Neimoidian bridge-cities. Wealth hangs high above water that forgives no failed footing.

Planet.name: Rhen Var
Planet.description: Rhen Var was once a fertile paradise filled with vegetation and wildlife. However, sometime thousands of years before the modern era, the planet was hit with a devastating cataclysm. Now it is an icy and glacial planet covered in frost and snow-covered mountains and tundra. Once a citadel world for the Rakatan Empire, the planet is now a tomb world for the ancient Jedi, long after the Rakatan's defeat at their hands. Castles, fortresses, and catacombs of ancient empires and civilizations cover its surface. Currently, the planet finds itself as a listening post for the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

pl.description: Rhen Var było niegdyś żyznym rajem, lecz tysiące lat temu katastrofa przemieniła je w lodową planetę lodowców, gór i tundry. Dawna cytadela Imperium Rakatan stała się później grobowym światem starożytnych Jedi. Ruiny zamków, twierdz i katakumb wielu cywilizacji pokrywają powierzchnię. Obecnie CIS wykorzystuje planetę jako posterunek nasłuchowy.

en.description: Rhen Var was once a fertile paradise filled with vegetation and wildlife. However, sometime thousands of years before the modern era, the planet was hit with a devastating cataclysm. Now it is an icy and glacial planet covered in frost and snow-covered mountains and tundra. Once a citadel world for the Rakatan Empire, the planet is now a tomb world for the ancient Jedi, long after the Rakatan's defeat at their hands. Castles, fortresses, and catacombs of ancient empires and civilizations cover its surface. Currently, the planet finds itself as a listening post for the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

hut.description: Rhen Var was once fertile until cataclysm froze it into glaciers, mountains, and tundra. Rakatan citadels, Jedi tombs, castles, and catacombs cover the surface. CIS now profits from the silence by operating a listening post.

Planet.name: Mimban
Planet.description: A perpetually overcast world due to the extremely ionized atmosphere. And in the marshes of the planet it is in constant fog and mist. Other than the marshes Mimban is populated with rainforests and swamps. Due to the highly sought after hyperbaride the CIS have many mining rigs on the surface.

pl.description: Mimban pozostaje stale zachmurzony wskutek silnie zjonizowanej atmosfery. Bagna toną w gęstej mgle, a pozostałą część powierzchni zajmują lasy deszczowe i mokradła. Cenne złoża hiperbarydu przyciągnęły CIS, które rozmieściło liczne instalacje wydobywcze mimo trudnego środowiska.

en.description: A perpetually overcast world due to the extremely ionized atmosphere. And in the marshes of the planet it is in constant fog and mist. Other than the marshes Mimban is populated with rainforests and swamps. Due to the highly sought after hyperbaride the CIS have many mining rigs on the surface.

hut.description: Mimban's ionized atmosphere keeps the world overcast. Fog blankets marshes, rainforest, and swamp, while valuable hyperbaride draws extensive CIS mining rigs. Difficult ground protects ore only until profit justifies the machinery.

Planet.name: Manaan
Planet.description: An ocean world, it is the home world of the Selkath. The only surface city is the massive floating city of Ahto which was built to accommodate non aquatic species. Their main product is Kolto which is a cheaper substitute to bacta.

pl.description: Manaan jest oceaniczną ojczyzną Selkathów. Jedynym wielkim miastem na powierzchni pozostaje pływające Ahto, przystosowane do potrzeb gatunków niezdolnych do życia pod wodą. Najważniejszym towarem planety jest kolto — środek leczniczy stanowiący tańszą alternatywę dla bacty i nadający światu znaczenie medyczne oraz handlowe.

en.description: An ocean world, it is the home world of the Selkath. The only surface city is the massive floating city of Ahto which was built to accommodate non aquatic species. Their main product is Kolto which is a cheaper substitute to bacta.

hut.description: Manaan is the ocean home of the Selkath. Floating Ahto serves air-breathing visitors, while kolto supplies a cheaper rival to bacta. Medicine makes this water-world valuable to every army and honest broker.

Planet.name: Telos IV
Planet.description: Uniquely, a quarter of this planet’s sky was covered by Citadel Station, a massive space station constructed by the High Republic. This planet is also home to a Jedi Temple and old Jedi Academy located on its northern pole, but both have remained hidden for several eras. More importantly, this planet sits at the edge of Galactic Republic controlled space on the strategic Hydian Way Hyper lane.

pl.description: Telos IV wyróżnia się olbrzymią Stacją Cytadela, która przesłania znaczną część nieba i pochodzi z epoki Wielkiej Republiki. Na północnym biegunie ukryto świątynię oraz dawną akademię Jedi, niewidoczne dla świata przez całe ery. Planeta leży na skraju przestrzeni kontrolowanej przez Republikę, przy strategicznym Szlaku Hydiańskim, co nadaje jej istotne znaczenie komunikacyjne.

en.description: Uniquely, a quarter of this planet’s sky was covered by Citadel Station, a massive space station constructed by the High Republic. This planet is also home to a Jedi Temple and old Jedi Academy located on its northern pole, but both have remained hidden for several eras. More importantly, this planet sits at the edge of Galactic Republic controlled space on the strategic Hydian Way Hyper lane.

hut.description: Telos IV lies beneath vast Citadel Station. A hidden Jedi temple and academy endure near the north pole, while the strategic Hydian Way passes the edge of Republica space. Secrets and transit both command a premium.

Planet.name: Ithor
Planet.description: Ithor is a forest planet home to the Ithorians who believed their lush jungles were sacred. Hunting is strictly prohibited on this planet as the wildlife is respected by the world’s people. The forests were filled with dense trees and carnivorous fauna. Ithorians often built their cities away from their forests, in barren lands, in order to keep the land pure.

pl.description: Ithor jest leśną ojczyzną Ithorian, którzy uznają bujne dżungle za święte. Polowania są surowo zakazane, a dzika przyroda — od gęstych drzew po mięsożerną faunę — pozostaje pod ochroną. Miasta wznosi się z dala od najcenniejszych lasów, na terenach jałowych, aby zachować naturalne obszary w możliwie nieskażonym stanie.

en.description: Ithor is a forest planet home to the Ithorians who believed their lush jungles were sacred. Hunting is strictly prohibited on this planet as the wildlife is respected by the world’s people. The forests were filled with dense trees and carnivorous fauna. Ithorians often built their cities away from their forests, in barren lands, in order to keep the land pure.

hut.description: Ithor is the sacred forest home of the Ithorians. Hunting is forbidden and cities stand on barren ground away from protected jungle. Predators and trees alike are preserved; profit must negotiate with faith.

Planet.name: Taris
Planet.description: Taris was once the jewel of the Republic, a city of splendor, pleasure, and hidden arenas of violence that even managed to outshine Coruscant in its brightest days. Yet fate would betray the once proud planet. In the age of Darth Malek, the planet, at first, would see a new boom of entertainment and prosperity under Sith occupation. Yes, the Rakgul threat in the under-city was ignored by the occupiers; however, the upper levels saw an unprecedented level of credits flowing from the now-evident black markets and fighting pits forming in the Republicless world. This small age of wealth would come to an abrupt and ruthless end as Darth Malek, in an attempt to stop Revan and Bastilla Shan from leaving the planet, would orbitally bombard every inch of its surface. For thousands of years, the Rakguls would control the world, and its people would struggle to survive within the regrowth of ancient forests. With the uniting of the Galaxy under the Galactic Republic, the planet has finally received the aid it had needed for millennia. Finally stepping back on its feet, though still facing underlying Rakgul invasions from the under-city, Taris has begun to rebuild.

high_value_targets.name: Kim Robb
high_value_targets.title: Senator
high_value_targets.intel: Senator Robb is a major reason for Taris’s return as an ecumenopolis. Her capability to work with other Senators on public policies and humanitarian issues have allowed her the opportunity to fix her world. Yet many within the Republic see the regrowth of Taris on the galactic stage as a threat to their power base. Thus, the Senator's life is paramount.

pl.description: Taris było niegdyś klejnotem Republiki — wielopoziomowym miastem rozrywki, bogactwa i ukrytej przemocy. Podczas okupacji Sithów czarne rynki oraz areny przyniosły chwilowy rozkwit wyższym dzielnicom, podczas gdy podmiasto pozostawiono pladze rakghuli. Darth Malak zniszczył powierzchnię bombardowaniem orbitalnym, próbując zatrzymać Revana i Bastilę Shan. Po tysiącleciach walki o przetrwanie oraz odradzania się lasów Republika wspiera odbudowę, choć zagrożenie rakghuli nie zostało całkowicie usunięte.

en.description: Taris was once the jewel of the Republic, a city of splendor, pleasure, and hidden arenas of violence that even managed to outshine Coruscant in its brightest days. Yet fate would betray the once proud planet. In the age of Darth Malek, the planet, at first, would see a new boom of entertainment and prosperity under Sith occupation. Yes, the Rakgul threat in the under-city was ignored by the occupiers; however, the upper levels saw an unprecedented level of credits flowing from the now-evident black markets and fighting pits forming in the Republicless world. This small age of wealth would come to an abrupt and ruthless end as Darth Malek, in an attempt to stop Revan and Bastilla Shan from leaving the planet, would orbitally bombard every inch of its surface. For thousands of years, the Rakguls would control the world, and its people would struggle to survive within the regrowth of ancient forests. With the uniting of the Galaxy under the Galactic Republic, the planet has finally received the aid it had needed for millennia. Finally stepping back on its feet, though still facing underlying Rakgul invasions from the under-city, Taris has begun to rebuild.

hut.description: Taris was once a Republica jewel of layered cities, pleasure, and hidden violence. Sith occupation enriched black markets before Darth Malak bombarded the world to stop Revan and Bastila Shan. Millennia later rebuilding continues, while rakghouls still haunt the undercity.

Planet.name: Hapes
Planet.description: The Hapes Consortium is a feverishly independent government that lives within the Hapes system. After the women of the planet had been enslaved by the Lorell Raiders of the Old Republic, and subsequently the Raiders were killed by the Jedi Order, the surviving mothers of the children of the Raiders vowed never again to let a man rule their society. For 3000 years, they have used the deadly Transitory Mists nebulae to conceal their worlds and keep outside vessels from entering their sector. Progressing aggressively and hoarding their technologies against an ever-growing and yet self-destructive galaxy, the Hapes seek to solidify utter dominance over ship-based combat and shielding technologies. Hoping that such advancements would protect them if their borders were to somehow be breached through the nebulae. Hapes itself is a continental mountain world, most of its green landscapes untouched by technology, as the rulers of the planet revere beauty above all else. Preferring to stay within solitary cities scattered around the planet, the people of Hapes rarely, if ever, grow infrastructure outside of the cities, keeping the planet as one of the most vibrant and beautiful in the galaxy.

high_value_targets.name: The Queen Mother
high_value_targets.title: Hapes Leader
high_value_targets.intel: Despite the Jedi’s destruction of the Lorell Raiders, the Hapes treat them and the Republic with discontent and a wish to stay hidden. The Queen Mother has solidified her stance against the barbarity of man. She is no friend of the Republic or the Separatists. Make sure of the continued neutrality of the Consortium lest they turn their advanced weaponry on the Republic.

pl.description: Hapes jest głównym światem zaciekle niezależnego Konsorcjum Hapes. Społeczeństwo ukształtowało się po zagładzie najeźdźców z Lorell, gdy ocalałe kobiety odrzuciły męską władzę. Przez trzy tysiące lat Mgławice Przejściowe osłaniały system przed obcymi, pozwalając gromadzić zaawansowane technologie okrętowe i osłonowe. Sama planeta to górzysty, zielony świat o nielicznych, odizolowanych miastach; piękno krajobrazu chroni się przed niekontrolowaną zabudową.

hut.description: Hapes rules an independent consortium hidden for three millennia behind the Transitory Mists. Its matriarchal society hoards advanced ship and shield technology. Green mountains and isolated cities reflect a culture that values beauty, secrecy, and strong borders.

Planet.name: Kuat
Planet.description: Kuat is a temperate terrestrial world of large continents between large oceans with many industrial cities and large space ports. Kuat and the Kuat shipyards are the most important Naval facilities in the Republic. Since the dawn of the Republic, Kuat Drive Yards has been the exclusive supplier of many of the Republic’s greatest warships. On the surface there are many important Naval Bases which host a lot of important Republic Naval Officers and Data. There are the space elevators that provide transport to and from the Kuat Drive Yards Orbital Array. The Kuat Drive Yards Orbital Array or just the Orbital Array is where most Republic fleets go to repair and resupply. It unfortunately is more vulnerable to a boarding action than the surface based shipyards that are protected by the Planetary Shields and Planetary Cannons. pl.description: Kuat jest umiarkowanym, silnie uprzemysłowionym światem wielkich kontynentów, oceanów, miast i portów kosmicznych. Stocznie Kuat Drive Yards należą do najważniejszych instalacji marynarki Republiki i od wieków dostarczają jej okręty wojenne. Bazy na powierzchni przechowują personel oraz dane, a windy orbitalne łączą je z rozległą macierzą stoczniową służącą naprawom i zaopatrzeniu flot. Instalacje orbitalne są bardziej narażone na abordaż niż chronione osłonami i artylerią zakłady naziemne.

hut.description: Kuat is a temperate industrial world and the Republica's foremost naval yard. Kuat Drive Yards builds, repairs, and supplies warships through a vast orbital array linked by elevators to defended surface bases. The orbital works are valuable—and more vulnerable to boarding than shielded ground facilities.

Planet.name: Trandosha
Planet.description: A rival planet to Kashyyyk, Trandosha is the homeworld of the Trandoshan species. Well known for its deep underground slave network, the planet has become the spawning ground for the Wookie slave trade. Despite this, Trandosha itself has stayed deathly loyal to the Republic, even refusing to join the Sith Empire and the multitude of conflicts within the Republic's early founding. The planet was made up of a majority of forests just like its counterpart; however, unlike Kashyyyk, the planet held a multitude of planes perfect for hunting. A multitude of the galaxy's greatest hunters would use Trandosha as a proving ground, its wildlife proving to be some of the deadliest game in the galaxy.

pl.description: Trandosha, leśna ojczyzna Trandoshan i odwieczna rywalka Kashyyyku, jest znana z podziemnego handlu niewolnikami oraz polowań na Wookieech. Mimo przestępczej gospodarki planeta długo pozostawała lojalna wobec Republiki. Rozległe równiny i wyjątkowo niebezpieczna fauna przyciągają najlepszych łowców galaktyki, którzy traktują miejscowe łowiska jako próbę umiejętności i prestiżu.

hut.description: Trandosha is the forest home of the Trandoshans and Kashyyyk's rival. Slave networks feed the Wookiee trade despite old loyalty to Republica. Open hunting grounds and deadly fauna attract hunters who wager life for reputation.

Planet.name: Mon Cala
Planet.description: The ocean planet of Mon Cala is home to the Mon Calamari and Quarren species. Although being completely covered in ocean, the amphibian people create thriving civilizations under water. However, the proud Quarren people often clash with the Mon Calamari. Also, Mon Cala is famous for its Mon Cal shipyards, being able to produce high quality space faring ships. The seas of Mon Cala thrived with life including thriving sea life and massive coral surrounding cities.

pl.description: Mon Cala jest oceaniczną ojczyzną Mon Calamari i Quarrenów. Oba amfibijne gatunki zbudowały kwitnące podwodne cywilizacje pośród rozległych raf koralowych i bogatego życia morskiego, choć ich interesy często prowadzą do napięć. Stocznie Mon Cala słyną z wysokiej jakości statków kosmicznych, nadając planecie znaczenie przemysłowe wykraczające daleko poza jej morza.

en.description: The ocean planet of Mon Cala is home to the Mon Calamari and Quarren species. Although being completely covered in ocean, the amphibian people create thriving civilizations under water. However, the proud Quarren people often clash with the Mon Calamari. hut.description: Mon Cala is the ocean home of Mon Calamari and Quarren. Their underwater cities thrive among coral and abundant sea life despite political rivalry. Famous shipyards export high-quality vessels, giving the world's waters galactic reach.

Planet.name: Tatooine
Planet.description: With endless dune seas and two suns, Tatooine is an important world for criminals and nomads alike. Inhabited by moisture farmers, native Tuskans, and species from all reaches of the galaxy. The planet’s isolation in the outer rim provides a haven for crime syndicates like the Hutt Cartel. Hidden within the barren wastelands the Hutt palace houses the leader of the Outer Rim crime operations.

high_value_targets.name: Jabba The Hutt
high_value_targets.title: Crime Lord
high_value_targets.intel: Crime lord of the Outer Rim Hutt operation takes a neutral stand to the Clone Wars. Using the war as a smoke screen to his growing empire.

pl.description: Tatooine jest suchym światem bezkresnych mórz wydm oświetlanych przez dwa słońca. Mieszkają tam farmerzy wilgoci, rdzenni Tuskeni, nomadzi i przybysze z całej galaktyki. Odosobnienie na Zewnętrznych Rubieżach zapewnia bezpieczną przystań przemytnikom oraz syndykatom, zwłaszcza Kartelowi Huttów. Ukryte pośród pustkowi pałace stanowią centra przestępczych operacji regionu.

en.description: With endless dune seas and two suns, Tatooine is an important world for criminals and nomads alike. Inhabited by moisture farmers, native Tuskans, and species from all reaches of the galaxy. The planet’s isolation in the outer rim provides a haven for crime syndicates like the Hutt Cartel. Hidden within the barren wastelands the Hutt palace houses the leader of the Outer Rim crime operations.

hut.description: Tatooine is a twin-sun desert of dune seas, moisture farms, Tusken clans, nomads, and offworlders. Outer Rim isolation shelters smugglers and Hutt syndicates. Palaces hidden in the wastes govern trade that prefers no Republica ledger.

Planet.name: Coruscant
Planet.description: The Capital of the Galactic Republic, a planet that once was lush and mountainous but has now become an extensive network of thousands of city layers, creating one of the most populous planets in the entire galaxy. It is here that the Senate, the Jedi, and well over 2 trillion people sit comfortably while the war wages elsewhere. Thousands of ships fill its skies, troopers march through the winding streets, and the never-ending cacophony of the bustling planetwide city drowns out any possible threats… even if they are closer than they truly seem.

pl.description: Coruscant, stolica Republiki Galaktycznej, było niegdyś górzystym światem, lecz dziś pokrywają je tysiące warstw miasta. Senat, Zakon Jedi i ponad dwa biliony mieszkańców funkcjonują w centrum galaktycznej polityki, podczas gdy wojna toczy się na odległych frontach. Nieustanny ruch statków, przemarsze żołnierzy i zgiełk planetarnej metropolii tworzą obraz potęgi, ale mogą również zagłuszać zagrożenia znajdujące się niebezpiecznie blisko.

en.description: The Capital of the Galactic Republic, a planet that once was lush and mountainous but has now become an extensive network of thousands of city layers, creating one of the most populous planets in the entire galaxy. It is here that the Senate, the Jedi, and well over 2 trillion people sit comfortably while the war wages elsewhere. Thousands of ships fill its skies, troopers march through the winding streets, and the never-ending cacophony of the bustling planetwide city drowns out any possible threats… even if they are closer than they truly seem.

hut.description: Coruscant is the city-covered capital of Republica, home to the Senate, Jedi, and more than two trillion residents. Endless traffic and marching troops advertise power while distant war burns. In such noise, even a nearby threat can pass unnoticed.

Planet.name: D'Qar
Planet.description: A verdant planet in the outer rim, this planet used to be home to an unknown civilisation and their ruins span a majority of the planet still. The planet had thick foliage, rolling hills and fields, and a wide variety of species. Likely to contain a few hidden pirate bases or a CIS listening post.

pl.description: D'Qar jest zielonym światem Zewnętrznych Rubieży, porośniętym gęstą roślinnością i pełnym falistych wzgórz oraz otwartych pól. Ruiny nieznanej cywilizacji zajmują znaczną część powierzchni, a różnorodna fauna rozwija się pośród pozostałości. Odosobnienie sprzyja ukrywaniu baz pirackich lub separatystycznych posterunków nasłuchowych, choć ich obecność nie została potwierdzona.

en.description: A verdant planet in the outer rim, this planet used to be home to an unknown civilisation and their ruins span a majority of the planet still. The planet had thick foliage, rolling hills and fields, and a wide variety of species. Likely to contain a few hidden pirate bases or a CIS listening post.

hut.description: D'Qar is a verdant Outer Rim world of thick foliage, rolling hills, fields, and ruins left by an unknown civilization. Seclusion offers excellent cover for pirates or CIS listening posts, though no reliable ledger confirms them.

Planet.name: Atollon
Planet.description: Atollon is found in the Outer Rim of the galaxy. The mysterious planet is barely recorded except for its fauna. The dry and rocky terrain is sporadically included with coral tipped trees.

pl.description: Atollon leży na Zewnętrznych Rubieżach i pozostaje słabo udokumentowanym światem. Suchy, skalisty teren urozmaicają nieliczne drzewa zwieńczone koralowymi koronami. Najwięcej wiadomo o miejscowej faunie; brak rozległych osiedli i wiarygodnych zapisów historycznych czyni planetę dogodnym, lecz nieprzewidywalnym schronieniem.

en.description: Atollon is found in the Outer Rim of the galaxy. The mysterious planet is barely recorded except for its fauna. The dry and rocky terrain is sporadically included with coral tipped trees.

hut.description: Atollon is a poorly charted Outer Rim world of dry rock and scattered coral-crowned trees. Records concern fauna more than settlements. Isolation offers concealment, but unknown ground always adds risk to the price.

Planet.name: Nar Shaddaa
Planet.description: Nar Shadaa, the capital of smuggling and debauchery, the Hutts have a choke hold on the unfortunate people of this dystopian world. Where there is more spice in people’s system than food and more predatory casinos than grocery stores. There may be clashing gangs all over the dirty cities, but all the wealth trickles upwards towards the Hutts.

pl.description: Nar Shaddaa, stolica przemytu i występku, jest gęsto zabudowanym księżycem pozostającym pod bezwzględną kontrolą Huttów. Brudne miasta pełne są rywalizujących gangów, drapieżnych kasyn i handlu przyprawą, podczas gdy zwykłym mieszkańcom brakuje podstawowych dóbr. Niezależnie od ulicznych konfliktów większość bogactwa ostatecznie trafia do rodów Huttów.

en.description: Nar Shadaa, the capital of smuggling and debauchery, the Hutts have a choke hold on the unfortunate people of this dystopian world. Where there is more spice in people’s system than food and more predatory casinos than grocery stores. There may be clashing gangs all over the dirty cities, but all the wealth trickles upwards towards the Hutts.

hut.description: Nar Shaddaa is the smuggler's moon, where spice is easier to find than food and casinos outnumber honest shops. Gangs fight through dirty city levels, but every profitable stream eventually flows upward to the Hutts.

Planet.name: Endor
Planet.description: The forest moon of Endor is a mountainous heavily forested moon. Interestingly it also contains vast deserts, smaller oceans, and secluded lakes that cover its surface. The planet is surrounded in massive trees that allow for life to sustain itself above ground level, hiding said life from the elusive Gorax monstrosity that roams the moon's surface.

pl.description: Leśny księżyc Endora jest górzystym światem porośniętym olbrzymimi drzewami. Występują tam również rozległe pustynie, niewielkie oceany i odosobnione jeziora. Korony drzew podtrzymują bogate życie wysoko nad ziemią i chronią je przed goraksami — potężnymi stworzeniami przemierzającymi powierzchnię.

en.description: The forest moon of Endor is a mountainous heavily forested moon. Interestingly it also contains vast deserts, smaller oceans, and secluded lakes that cover its surface. The planet is surrounded in massive trees that allow for life to sustain itself above ground level, hiding said life from the elusive Gorax monstrosity that roams the moon's surface.

hut.description: Endor's forest moon combines mountains and giant trees with deserts, small oceans, and secluded lakes. Much life survives above ground in the canopy, safely beyond the reach of the enormous Gorax roaming below.

Planet.name: Duro
Planet.description: Duro is the home world of the Duros but today is a smog covered world with polluted oceans and deserts. The planet itself has some dome cities, and many ancient ruins. However, most Duros live in orbiting Space Stations.

pl.description: Duro jest ojczyzną Durosów, lecz jego powierzchnię pokrywają dziś smog, zanieczyszczone oceany i pustkowia. Nieliczne miasta funkcjonują pod kopułami pośród starożytnych ruin. Większość ludności przeniosła się do stacji orbitalnych, pozostawiając planetę jako świadectwo kosztów niekontrolowanej industrializacji.

en.description: Duro is the home world of the Duros but today is a smog covered world with polluted oceans and deserts. The planet itself has some dome cities, and many ancient ruins. However, most Duros live in orbiting Space Stations.

hut.description: Duro is the Duros homeworld, now buried beneath smog, polluted seas, and desert. Dome cities and ruins remain on the surface, while most citizens live in orbital stations. Old industry collected its debt from the planet itself.

Planet.name: Concordia
Planet.description: Concordia is one of two celestial moons orbiting the planet of Mandalore, and to many within the culture, it was considered the cultural home world of the Mandalorian people. Mountainous terrain, combined with lush and vibrant forests, covered the surface of the moon. For generations, Mandalorian farmers would cultivate their grounds and use their bountiful soil to feed not only the people of Concordia but Mandalore as well. However, not all was prosperous within Concordia, as the nights on the moon would prove deadly to those unprepared for what lurked within. Predators on Concordia are nocturnal and will hunt anything or anyone that finds themselves alone or without protection. Despite this, the moon would prosper for thousands of years, and the Mandalorians would maintain their control against the odds. Yet recently, with the outbreak of the Great Clan Wars, the exiled Clan Vizsla has found itself in charge of the once sacred moon. Violence and forced subjugation have turned many of the farms that once covered the lands into either fortresses or ash.

high_value_targets.name: Pre Vizsla
high_value_targets.title: Governer
high_value_targets.intel: The Governor of Concordia has proclaimed loyalty to Satine Kryze, but Rumors of secret dealings with the Separatists have put his name on lists of people of interest. His Allegiance must be observed.

pl.description: Concordia jest jednym z dwóch księżyców Mandalory i dla wielu stanowi kulturową kolebkę Mandalorian. Góry, żyzne lasy i gospodarstwa przez pokolenia zaopatrywały cały sektor w żywność, choć nocą powierzchnię przemierzają groźne drapieżniki. Po wybuchu Wielkich Wojen Klanów wygnany klan Vizsla przejął władzę, zamieniając wiele pól w twierdze lub popiół. Przemoc i przymus zastąpiły dawną pomyślność świętego księżyca.

hut.description: Concordia is a fertile Mandalorian moon of mountains, forests, farms, and deadly nocturnal predators. It once fed the sector. Clan Vizsla's rule turned many fields into forts or ash, exchanging harvest for coercion.

Planet.name: Utapau
Planet.description: Due to the two key factors of 1.) The Great Hyperspace Disaster and 2.) The Nihil Stormwall, the people of Utupau mostly grew absent from the Republic but has no interest in the War and intends to stay neutral. Combined with food shortages, the Planet’s oceans draining underground into a massive “World Ocean” underground, and the deadly storms that rip across the surface of the planet, most of the population lives in giant sinkholes in one main stable continent. Due to the storms and underground ocean eroding alot of the core of the planet, miles deep sinkholes are formed and these often prove to be the safest places to live. With the massive hyperwind storms plaguing the surface, there is little to no lumber on the planet and all buildings are made from the bones of deceased animals.

pl.description: Utapau pozostaje na uboczu Republiki wskutek Wielkiej Katastrofy Nadprzestrzennej i bariery Nihilów, a jego mieszkańcy pragną zachować neutralność. Oceany spłynęły do podziemnego Wszechoceanu, zaś niszczycielskie hiperwiatry pustoszą powierzchnię i pogłębiają niedobory żywności. Większość ludności zamieszkuje olbrzymie zapadliska stabilnego kontynentu, osłonięte przed burzami. Brak drewna sprawił, że budowle wznosi się głównie z kości wielkich zwierząt.
