The Nihil Stormwall, the people of Utupau mostly grew absent from the Republic but has no interest in the War and intends to stay neutral. With the massive hyperwind storms plaguing the surface, there is little to no lumber on the planet and all buildings are made from the bones of deceased animals.

hut.description: Utapau seeks neutrality after disasters severed old Republica ties. Oceans drained underground, hyperwind storms scour the surface, and food is scarce. Most people inhabit immense sinkholes, building with animal bone where lumber cannot survive.

Planet.name: Corellia
Planet.description: Corellia is a major Republic shipyard planet as such it is very urban and industrial. With large oceans many of the shipyards are on the ocean. The major sectors of importance are the Port Authority, Shipyard, Cargo, Industrial, and residential sectors. Its shipyards manufacture many ships as well as pilots for the Republic.

high_value_targets.name: Dal Esor
high_value_targets.title: Separatist Leader
high_value_targets.intel: Leader of the local Separatist cell he is hiding somewhere on the planet organizing all CIS activities.

pl.description: Corellia jest jednym z głównych światów stoczniowych Republiki, silnie zurbanizowanym i uprzemysłowionym. Porty, stocznie, dzielnice towarowe, zakłady przemysłowe i osiedla rozciągają się także wzdłuż wielkich oceanów. Planeta produkuje liczne statki oraz szkoli znakomitych pilotów, odgrywając kluczową rolę w republikańskim transporcie i marynarce.

en.description: Corellia is a major Republic shipyard planet as such it is very urban and industrial. With large oceans many of the shipyards are on the ocean. The major sectors of importance are the Port Authority, Shipyard, Cargo, Industrial, and residential sectors. Its shipyards manufacture many ships as well as pilots for the Republic.

hut.description: Corellia is a major Republica shipyard world, dense with ports, yards, cargo districts, factories, and oceanfront industry. It produces ships and skilled pilots in equal measure, making mobility its most valuable export.

Planet.name: Lothal
Planet.description: Lothal is a world of vast stretches of prairie interspersed by large round rocks sometimes forming mountains, and some seas. In the polar regions these prairies form a tundra and in the equatorial ones they form a savanna. There are few modern cities but for the most part it is rural farmland. Lothal hosts an old abandoned Jedi temple but its only strategic value are its mines as rumors hold they might have Kyber Crystals.

pl.description: Lothal tworzą rozległe prerie, wielkie zaokrąglone skały, pasma górskie i nieliczne morza. Na biegunach równiny przechodzą w tundrę, a przy równiku w sawannę. Poza kilkoma nowoczesnymi miastami dominuje rolnictwo. Opuszczona świątynia Jedi ma znaczenie historyczne, natomiast strategiczną wartość przedstawiają kopalnie, w których mogą występować kryształy kyber.

en.description: Lothal is a world of vast stretches of prairie interspersed by large round rocks sometimes forming mountains, and some seas. In the polar regions these prairies form a tundra and in the equatorial ones they form a savanna. There are few modern cities but for the most part it is rural farmland. Lothal hosts an old abandoned Jedi temple but its only strategic value are its mines as rumors hold they might have Kyber Crystals.

hut.description: Lothal is a rural world of prairies, rounded stone, mountains, seas, polar tundra, and equatorial savanna. An abandoned Jedi temple keeps old secrets, while mines rumored to hold kyber attract modern interest.

Planet.name: Rodia
Planet.description: Rodia is a swampy jungle planet that is currently starving, the planet's allegiance is to whoever can provide food. The home of the Rodians they live in compact stone cities behind glass or energy walls. Of particular importance is the Senatorial Palace that houses the Rodian Senator.

high_value_targets.name: Nute Gunray
high_value_targets.title: Leader of the Trade Federation
high_value_targets.intel: Supports the Sepratist Alliance with funding and political schemes.

high_value_targets.name: Onaconda Farr
high_value_targets.title: Republic Senator
high_value_targets.intel: Rodian Senator afraid of the war.

pl.description: Rodia jest bagnistym, dżunglowym światem i ojczyzną Rodian. Trwający głód sprawia, że polityczna lojalność planety zależy od dostaw żywności. Mieszkańcy skupiają się w zwartych kamiennych miastach chronionych szklanymi lub energetycznymi barierami. Szczególne znaczenie ma Pałac Senatorski, będący siedzibą przedstawiciela Rodii.

en.description: Rodia is a swampy jungle planet that is currently starving, the planet's allegiance is to whoever can provide food. The home of the Rodians they live in compact stone cities behind glass or energy walls. Of particular importance is the Senatorial Palace that houses the Rodian Senator.

hut.description: Rodia is the starving swamp-jungle home of the Rodians. Whoever supplies food can purchase political loyalty. Compact stone cities hide behind glass or energy walls, and the Senatorial Palace remains the chief seat of influence.

Planet.name: Kessel
Planet.description: Kessel’s northern hemisphere is much different than its southern. The north is covered in spice mining run by the Pyke. Whereas the south is densely foliated with lush bush sanctuaries.

pl.description: Kessel dzieli się na dwa wyraźnie odmienne obszary. Północną półkulę zajmują rozległe kopalnie przyprawy kontrolowane przez syndykat Pyke, natomiast południe pokrywa gęsta, bujna roślinność tworząca naturalne sanktuaria. Kontrast między przemysłową eksploatacją a chronioną przyrodą określa charakter planety.

en.description: Kessel’s northern hemisphere is much different than its southern. The north is covered in spice mining run by the Pyke. Whereas the south is densely foliated with lush bush sanctuaries.

hut.description: Kessel has two faces: Pyke spice mines dominate the north, while dense green sanctuaries cover the south. Extraction and untouched refuge share one world, though only one side fills the syndicate's ledgers.

Planet.name: Geonosis
Planet.description: Geonosis is the desert home planet of the Geonosians. Its surface is covered in harsh, rocky deserts, marked by mesas and buttes. The native Geonosians live in various hives located on the planet. The largest is the Stalgasin Hive, inhabited by the upper caste. Both its rocks and sky are tinted in shades of red. Beneath the surface, the CIS have constructed major droid foundries that produce tens of thousands of battledroids for the Trade Federation.

campaign_objectives.description: The planet is overrun with droids. Destroy them to turn the tide in this fight.
campaign_objectives.title: Eliminate Battledroids

high_value_targets.name: Sun Fac
high_value_targets.title: Geonosian Leiutenant
high_value_targets.intel: Sun Fac serves as Archduke Poggle the Lesser's chief lieutenant. Our intelligence suggests that all members of the upper caste live in the Stalgasin hive. He is likely to be unarmed, and will attempt to escape if located.

high_value_targets.name: Brood Commander
high_value_targets.title: Geonosian Alpha
high_value_targets.intel: A Geonosian Brood Alpha was the alpha of the Geonosian broods. They earned the position in the hierarchy of their hive after proving his powers as a champion the arena.

high_value_targets.name: Brood Commander
high_value_targets.title: Geonosian Alpha
high_value_targets.intel: A Geonosian Brood Alpha was the alpha of the Geonosian broods. They earned the position in the hierarchy of their hive after proving his powers as a champion the arena.

Planet.conflict_description: Defeat the Separatist droid army before they can escape.

pl.description: Geonosis jest czerwonawą, pustynną ojczyzną Geonosian, pełną skalistych pustkowi, płaskowyżów i ostańców. Rdzenna ludność żyje w licznych ulach, z których największy — Stalgasin — skupia wyższe kasty. Pod powierzchnią CIS wzniosło olbrzymie odlewnie droidów, produkujące dziesiątki tysięcy jednostek bojowych dla Federacji Handlowej i całej machiny wojennej Separatystów.

en.description: Geonosis is the desert home planet of the Geonosians. Its surface is covered in harsh, rocky deserts, marked by mesas and buttes. The native Geonosians live in various hives located on the planet. The largest is the Stalgasin Hive, inhabited by the upper caste. Both its rocks and sky are tinted in shades of red. Beneath the surface, the CIS have constructed major droid foundries that produce tens of thousands of battledroids for the Trade Federation.

hut.description: Geonosis is the red desert hive-world of the Geonosians. Mesas and rock conceal vast CIS foundries beneath the surface, where tens of thousands of battle droids are manufactured for the Trade Federation and Separatista war machine.

Planet.name: Toydaria
Planet.description: Humid swamps and large forests cover the planet’s surface which is a great environment for the native Toyadarians to make nests. Deep bogs make movement slow and laborious. The dense foliage makes an abundance of blind sides.

pl.description: Toydarię pokrywają wilgotne bagna i rozległe lasy, zapewniające rodzimym Toydarianom dogodne miejsca do zakładania gniazd. Głębokie mokradła znacznie spowalniają ruch, a gęsta roślinność ogranicza widoczność i sprzyja zasadzkom. Teren wymaga znajomości lokalnych szlaków oraz ostrożnego planowania operacji.

en.description: Humid swamps and large forests cover the planet’s surface which is a great environment for the native Toyadarians to make nests. Deep bogs make movement slow and laborious. The dense foliage makes an abundance of blind sides.

hut.description: Toydaria is covered by humid swamp and forest where native Toydarians build nests. Deep bogs slow every traveler, while dense foliage creates blind approaches. Local knowledge is worth more than heavy equipment here.

Planet.name: Hoth
Planet.description: Hoth is a mostly barren snow-covered planet with frigid and glacier-covered north and south poles. However, while Hoth’s surface is covered in ice and snow, it hides a deep cavernous system of fauna and wildlife below the surface. All of these hidden caves are often used by the animals that live on Hoth as a place of respite from blizzards and the deadly nights on Hoth where the temperature drops below survivable levels. All of this is supported by volcanic activity and geysers found above and within the caves. Lastly, Hoth has a vast array of graveyards, similar to Hypori, that are often mined and salvaged by scavs and corporations for parts or ancient technologies.

pl.description: Hoth jest niemal bezludną planetą lodu, śniegu i polarnych lodowców. Pod powierzchnią rozciąga się jednak złożony system jaskiń, ogrzewanych miejscami przez aktywność wulkaniczną i gejzery. Fauna chroni się tam przed zamieciami oraz nocnym mrozem przekraczającym granice przeżycia. Rozległe cmentarzyska wraków przyciągają złomiarzy i korporacje poszukujące części oraz dawnych technologii.

en.description: Hoth is a mostly barren snow-covered planet with frigid and glacier-covered north and south poles. However, while Hoth’s surface is covered in ice and snow, it hides a deep cavernous system of fauna and wildlife below the surface. All of these hidden caves are often used by the animals that live on Hoth as a place of respite from blizzards and the deadly nights on Hoth where the temperature drops below survivable levels. All of this is supported by volcanic activity and geysers found above and within the caves. Lastly, Hoth has a vast array of graveyards, similar to Hypori, that are often mined and salvaged by scavs and corporations for parts or ancient technologies.

hut.description: Hoth appears barren, but geothermal caves shelter wildlife from lethal nights and blizzards. Vast wreck graveyards draw scavengers and corporations hunting parts or ancient technology. Cold preserves both danger and salvage.

Planet.name: Balmorra
Planet.description: Balmorra is a factory planet with lush green plains and spiky black mountains. Its factories are very metallic, modern and sleek. It is an important Techno Union world producing battle droids. This makes it vital to the CIS war machine.

pl.description: Balmorra jest uprzemysłowionym światem fabrycznym, gdzie zielone równiny sąsiadują z ostrymi, czarnymi górami i nowoczesnymi metalowymi kompleksami. Zakłady Unii Technokratycznej produkują tu droidy bojowe na wielką skalę. Zdolności wytwórcze czynią planetę jednym z kluczowych ogniw machiny wojennej CIS.

en.description: Balmorra is a factory planet with lush green plains and spiky black mountains. Its factories are very metallic, modern and sleek. It is an important Techno Union world producing battle droids. This makes it vital to the CIS war machine.

hut.description: Balmorra is a factory-world of green plains, black mountains, and sleek metal complexes. Techno Union plants mass-produce battle droids, making the planet essential to Separatista supply and a valuable industrial contract.

Planet.name: Concord Dawn
Planet.description: Concord Dawn, unlike its cousin in name Concordia, is not actually a moon but a planet within the Mandalore sector. Similar to its parent world of Mandalore, the world is covered in jungles, forests, deserts, mountains, and plains. Similar to Concordia, Concord Dawn would have an agricultural focus to help feed the residents of the Mandalore sector. However, unlike Concordia, which kept a semblance of Mandalorian culture and pride, Concord Dawn tended to be considered an underdeveloped backwater compared to its counterparts. Due to this perception of the planet, it was a primary target of the Death Watch when the Mandalorian Civil War kicked off 58 BBY. Its once vibrant landscapes would be reduced to ash during the war, and years of recultivation have only barely left their mark on attempting to rectify the mistakes of the past. Currently, the planet has found itself under the protection of surviving Journeyman Protectors and True Mandalorians, who seek no involvement in the politics of their New Mandalorian or Clan Vizsla counterparts.

pl.description: Concord Dawn jest planetą sektora Mandalory o dżunglach, lasach, pustyniach, górach i równinach. Rolnictwo wspierało zaopatrzenie regionu, choć świat długo uchodził za zaniedbane pogranicze. Death Watch spustoszyła go podczas mandaloriańskiej wojny domowej, obracając żyzne tereny w popiół. Wieloletnia rekultywacja dopiero zaczyna przywracać dawny krajobraz. Obecnie ochronę zapewniają ocalałe formacje Protektorów oraz Prawdziwi Mandalorianie, unikający sporów Nowych Mandalorian i klanu Vizsla.

en.description: Concord Dawn, unlike its cousin in name Concordia, is not actually a moon but a planet within the Mandalore sector. Due to this perception of the planet, it was a primary target of the Death Watch when the Mandalorian Civil War kicked off 58 BBY. Its once vibrant landscapes would be reduced to ash during the war, and years of recultivation have only barely left their mark on attempting to rectify the mistakes of the past. Currently, the planet has found itself under the protection of surviving Journeyman Protectors and True Mandalorians, who seek no involvement in the politics of their New Mandalorian or Clan Vizsla counterparts.

hut.description: Concord Dawn is a Mandalorian frontier world of farms, jungle, desert, mountain, and plain. Death Watch burned much of it during civil war. Slow recovery continues under Journeyman Protectors and True Mandalorians who reject both rival political camps.

Planet.name: Dathomir
Planet.description: The red planet located in the Outer Rim territories was home to the Zabrak people among dangerous predators and uninviting ecosystems. Constantly shrouded by red mist dwells a mysterious, malevolent aura of the dark side of the Force. While there are multiple witch clans it was also home to rancors. The Nightsisters notably use the intricate caves of Dathomir to freely practice their Magick in solitude.

high_value_targets.name: Mother Talsyn
high_value_targets.title: Leader of the Nightsisters
high_value_targets.intel: No reliable information of her existence to the Republic.

pl.description: Dathomir jest czerwonym światem Zewnętrznych Rubieży, spowitym mgłą i wyraźną, złowrogą aurą ciemnej strony Mocy. W nieprzyjaznych ekosystemach żyją Zabrakowie, liczne klany wiedźm, rankory i inne niebezpieczne stworzenia. Siostry Nocy wykorzystują rozbudowane jaskinie, aby w odosobnieniu praktykować magię i chronić własne tradycje.

en.description: The red planet located in the Outer Rim territories was home to the Zabrak people among dangerous predators and uninviting ecosystems. Constantly shrouded by red mist dwells a mysterious, malevolent aura of the dark side of the Force. While there are multiple witch clans it was also home to rancors. The Nightsisters notably use the intricate caves of Dathomir to freely practice their Magick in solitude.

hut.description: Dathomir is a red, mist-shrouded Outer Rim world steeped in the dark side. Zabrak clans, witches, rancors, and predators share its hostile lands. The Nightsisters practice Magick in deep caves, far from unwanted witnesses.

Planet.name: Eriadu
Planet.description: Eriadu is the trade and administrative capital of the Seswenna sector. As such it is a warm smog covered urban world with large savannas, mountains, and oceans serving as wildlife preserves. The Tarkin family was the first of the republic to colonize Eriadu, and have controlled the planet throughout its history. The working conditions on the world are abysmal and there is much public discontent. The Outland Regions Security Force centered on Eriadu has always seemed more than just an outer rim Security Force however, with Wilhuff Tarkin leading them they have become a proper military force in their own right. The Outland Regions Security Force with the onset of war is now officially recognized as part of the Republic Military by the Chancellor himself; thereby forming the 18th sector army.

high_value_targets.name: Cardiff Tarkin
high_value_targets.title: Governor of Eriadu
high_value_targets.intel: Cardiff Tarkin the human cousin of Wilhuff Tarkin is now the most prominent member of the Tarkin family left on Eriadu as Wilhuff Tarkin is currently off world. The acting governor of Eriadu and a prominent member of the ruling Tarkin family he is also the de facto leader of the Outland Regions Security Force.

pl.description: Eriadu jest handlową i administracyjną stolicą sektora Seswenna — ciepłym, zadymionym światem miejskim otoczonym sawannami, górami i oceanicznymi rezerwatami. Ród Tarkinów od początku kolonizacji zachowuje dominującą pozycję. Skrajnie ciężkie warunki pracy wywołują powszechne niezadowolenie. Dowodzone przez Wilhuffa Tarkina Siły Bezpieczeństwa Regionów Zewnętrznych przekształciły się w pełnoprawną formację wojskową, uznaną przez kanclerza za 18. Armię Sektorową Republiki.

en.description: Eriadu is the trade and administrative capital of the Seswenna sector. As such it is a warm smog covered urban world with large savannas, mountains, and oceans serving as wildlife preserves. The Tarkin family was the first of the republic to colonize Eriadu, and have controlled the planet throughout its history. The working conditions on the world are abysmal and there is much public discontent. The Outland Regions Security Force centered on Eriadu has always seemed more than just an outer rim Security Force however, with Wilhuff Tarkin leading them they have become a proper military force in their own right. The Outland Regions Security Force with the onset of war is now officially recognized as part of the Republic Military by the Chancellor himself; thereby forming the 18th sector army.

hut.description: Eriadu is Seswenna's smog-covered trade capital, ruled in practice by the Tarkin family. Harsh labor fuels unrest. Wilhuff Tarkin transformed the Outland Regions Security Force into the Republica's recognized Eighteenth Sector Army.

Planet.name: Scarif
Planet.description: The tropical planet Scarif lies deep in the outer rim on a pivotal hyperspace lane towards the Republic’s flank. Scarif is a world of massive oceans and low level tropical islands. Advanced research facilities holding incredibly classified information are held on Scarif due to its remote nature. Not many inhabit the paradise-like planet providing plenty of space for hidden complexes.

pl.description: Scarif jest tropikalnym światem położonym głęboko na Zewnętrznych Rubieżach, przy ważnym szlaku prowadzącym ku flance Republiki. Niskie wyspy rozsiane po olbrzymich oceanach kryją zaawansowane ośrodki badawcze i ściśle tajne archiwa. Niewielka populacja oraz odosobnienie zapewniają rozległą przestrzeń dla kompleksów, których istnienie ma pozostać poza publiczną wiedzą.

en.description: The tropical planet Scarif lies deep in the outer rim on a pivotal hyperspace lane towards the Republic’s flank. Scarif is a world of massive oceans and low level tropical islands. Advanced research facilities holding incredibly classified information are held on Scarif due to its remote nature. Not many inhabit the paradise-like planet providing plenty of space for hidden complexes.

hut.description: Scarif is a tropical island-world on a strategic Outer Rim route. Sparse population and vast oceans conceal advanced research sites and classified archives. Paradise is excellent cover when secrecy is the most valuable cargo.

Planet.name: Kamino
Planet.description: Train in the Tipoca City facilities to prepare for combat.

pl.description: Kamino jest oceanicznym światem nieustannych sztormów, nad którym wznoszą się miasta na palach. Tipoca City stanowi główny ośrodek klonowania, szkolenia i przygotowania armii klonów do walki. Zaawansowane laboratoria, symulatory oraz poligony czynią planetę jednym z najważniejszych zapleczy wojskowych Republiki.

en.description: Train in the Tipoca City facilities to prepare for combat.

hut.description: Kamino is a storm-wracked ocean world of stilt cities. Tipoca City clones and trains soldiers for Republica, supported by advanced laboratories, simulators, and ranges. Its product is disciplined military manpower.

Planet.name: Nal Hutta
Planet.description: Nal Hutta (Glorious Jewel in Huttese), also known simply as Hutta, is controlled by the ancient ruling Hutt families. The planet was originally a lush jungle world with vast oceans, though the Hutts eventually transformed it into a polluted and barren wasteland.

pl.description: Nal Hutta — w języku Huttów „Wspaniały Klejnot” — pozostaje siedzibą pradawnych rodów sprawujących władzę nad Kartelem. Niegdyś była bujnym światem dżungli i wielkich oceanów, lecz długotrwała działalność Huttów przemieniła ją w zanieczyszczone, jałowe pustkowie. Polityczna potęga i bogactwo kontrastują z głęboko zdegradowanym środowiskiem.

en.description: Nal Hutta (Glorious Jewel in Huttese), also known simply as Hutta, is controlled by the ancient ruling Hutt families. The planet was originally a lush jungle world with vast oceans, though the Hutts eventually transformed it into a polluted and barren wasteland.

hut.description: Nal Hutta, the Glorious Jewel, is the seat of ancient Hutt kajidics. Once rich in jungle and ocean, it became a polluted wasteland under centuries of exploitation. Power and wealth flourish where the environment paid the cost.

Planet.name: Ryloth
Planet.description: A hot, rocky, and humid planet, Ryloth is the homeworld of the diverse and deadly fauna to which the native Twi’lek species adapted by living in complex cave systems and easily defended settlements. Its terrain varies between lush jungles, rocky deserts, and mesa valleys. Located within CIS-occupied space, the neutral planet serves as an important control point and a heavily defended supply hub for the CIS.

high_value_targets.name: Wat Tambor
high_value_targets.title: Leader of the Techno Union
high_value_targets.intel: Provides key resources to the Separatist Union. Wat Tambor occupies Ryloth’s Ryll refineries, a valuable ore that can be made into medicine or spice.

high_value_targets.name: T-1 Tactical Droid Unit-45721
high_value_targets.title: Droid Commander
high_value_targets.image_url: Commands CIS forces on the ground

high_value_targets.name: T-1 Tactical Droid Unit-64371
high_value_targets.title: Droid Commander
high_value_targets.intel: Occupying a captured local Twi’lek village.

high_value_targets.name: Kelren Narek
high_value_targets.title: Clan Leader
high_value_targets.intel: Clan leader of a faction of Twi’leks. A soldier that wishes for freedom of his people.

pl.description: Ryloth jest gorącą, skalistą i wilgotną ojczyzną Twi'leków. Dżungle, pustynie skalne oraz doliny płaskowyżów zamieszkuje różnorodna, często śmiertelnie niebezpieczna fauna, dlatego społeczności rozwijają systemy jaskiń i łatwe do obrony osiedla. Neutralna planeta leży w przestrzeni okupowanej przez CIS i służy jako ważny, silnie chroniony węzeł zaopatrzeniowy oraz punkt kontroli.

en.description: A hot, rocky, and humid planet, Ryloth is the homeworld of the diverse and deadly fauna to which the native Twi’lek species adapted by living in complex cave systems and easily defended settlements. Its terrain varies between lush jungles, rocky deserts, and mesa valleys. Located within CIS-occupied space, the neutral planet serves as an important control point and a heavily defended supply hub for the CIS.

hut.description: Ryloth is the hot, rocky Twi'lek homeworld of jungle, desert, mesa valleys, caves, and dangerous fauna. Though nominally neutral, its place in CIS-held space makes it a defended supply hub and control point.

Planet.name: Crait
Planet.description: A small, desolate, and uninhabited planet. The Planet is rich in minerals and mainly features salt flats across most of the surface. This made the planet hard to travel as it was often slippery and wind gusts moved around fumes of white salt, revealing the red-colored rhodochrosite underneath. This planet is home to few life, and even fewer features. Located on the surface are several mineral mining and processing stations.

pl.description: Crait jest niewielką, opuszczoną i niezamieszkaną planetą bogatą w minerały. Większość powierzchni pokrywają śliskie solniska, po których wiatr niesie białe obłoki soli, odsłaniając czerwony rodochrozyt. Nieliczne instalacje wydobywcze i przetwórcze wykorzystują złoża mimo trudnego transportu oraz niemal całkowitego braku życia.

en.description: A small, desolate, and uninhabited planet. The Planet is rich in minerals and mainly features salt flats across most of the surface. This made the planet hard to travel as it was often slippery and wind gusts moved around fumes of white salt, revealing the red-colored rhodochrosite underneath. This planet is home to few life, and even fewer features. Located on the surface are several mineral mining and processing stations.

hut.description: Crait is a small uninhabited mineral world of slippery salt flats. Windblown white salt reveals red rhodochrosite below. A few mining and processing stations profit from the deposits despite difficult travel and almost no life.

Planet.name: Alderaan
Planet.description: A key core world, and home world of Senator Bail Prestor Organa. Alderaan is known for its natural beauty. Covered in snowy mountain range, and hilly lush green forests. Politically it’s a key core world for the republic, the planet that sits behind an important diplomatic position being in Chancellor Palpatine loyalist committee. The local populace aligns itself with pacifist values, and a big appreciation for culture and art. Regardless of its pacifist ideals it boasts a military more powerful than typical planetary guards.

pl.description: Alderaan jest kluczowym światem Jądra i ojczyzną senatora Baila Prestora Organy. Słynie z ośnieżonych gór, zielonych wzgórz i lasów, a także z głębokiego przywiązania do sztuki, kultury oraz pacyfizmu. Politycznie zajmuje ważne miejsce w Republice i uczestniczy w komitecie lojalistów kanclerza. Mimo pokojowych ideałów utrzymuje siły znacznie potężniejsze niż typowa straż planetarna.

en.description: A key core world, and home world of Senator Bail Prestor Organa. Alderaan is known for its natural beauty. Covered in snowy mountain range, and hilly lush green forests. Politically it’s a key core world for the republic, the planet that sits behind an important diplomatic position being in Chancellor Palpatine loyalist committee. The local populace aligns itself with pacifist values, and a big appreciation for culture and art. Regardless of its pacifist ideals it boasts a military more powerful than typical planetary guards.

hut.description: Alderaan is a beautiful Core World of snowy mountains and green forests, home to Senator Bail Organa. Culture and pacifism shape its politics, yet its defenses exceed an ordinary planetary guard. Peace is protected by credible strength.

Planet.name: Kashyyyk
Planet.description: Kashyyyk is one of the most unique and influential planets within the galaxy. Home to the strong and prideful Wookie species, the planet is more of a living entity than a rock. Its forests and fauna are all connected through the Force to the degree that when plants and trees interact with one another via their roots, they will merge and join the hivemind of the planet. This has been both a blessing and a curse to the inhabitants. The forests above Kashyyyk, and even those on the ground level, are relatively safe, with about as much danger as can be found on an almost purely forested planet. However, as soon as you venture too far below the sea level, or you make your way into the cave systems and the fabled Shadowed Lands, you have ventured into territories beyond survival for those unprepared for what awaits in the dark. Due to Kashyyyk's unique connection to the Force, as well as the Wookies' connection to the planet and the Force, the world has created a sort of void within its normally light landscapes. The Dark Side has taken full control of these territories, with ancient evils, monstrosities beyond comprehension, and maddened possessed Wookies who lost themselves to the darkness hiding within.

high_value_targets.name: Chieftain Tarfful
high_value_targets.title: Wookie Leader
high_value_targets.intel: Tarfful is one of the Republic's most loyal and honored allies. Working with his people, he has managed to assist in the manufacturing of weapons and vehicles, as well as assisting with diplomatic relations related to multiple worlds within the Republic. His survival is paramount.

pl.description: Kashyyyk jest ojczyzną Wookieech i światem przypominającym żywy organizm. Korzenie lasów łączą roślinność w sieć przenikniętą Mocą. Górne poziomy puszczy są stosunkowo bezpieczne, lecz głębokie jaskinie i legendarne Krainy Cienia kryją skrajnie niebezpieczne stworzenia, pradawne zło oraz Wookieech obłąkanych wpływem ciemnej strony. Silna więź mieszkańców z planetą jest zarazem błogosławieństwem i źródłem zagrożeń, których obcy często nie rozumieją.

hut.description: Kashyyyk is the Wookiee homeworld, a living forest linked through roots and the Force. Upper canopies shelter civilization; deep caves and Shadowlands hold monsters, ancient darkness, and maddened hunters. The planet's bond grants strength and demands respect.

Planet.name: Sullust
Planet.description: Sullust was a barren, obsidian world of lava streams and turquoise lakes. Native fauna such as ash angels foraged during the day and returned to nest at night, while rockrenders prowled the planet's underground. Because the planet's atmosphere was highly toxic, native Sullustans lived in technologically advanced subterranean cities that were highly regarded for their beauty. They commuted to work by lifts and shuttles that carried them to the factories on the planet's surface, alternating between day and night shifts.

pl.description: Sullust jest jałowym, obsydianowym światem strumieni lawy i turkusowych jezior. Toksyczna atmosfera zmusiła Sullustan do budowy zaawansowanych podziemnych miast słynących z piękna. Windy oraz wahadłowce dowożą pracowników do fabryk na powierzchni w systemie zmianowym. Rodzima fauna obejmuje dzienne popielne anioły i skalne bestie polujące w rozległych podziemiach.

hut.description: Sullust is an obsidian world of lava and turquoise lakes under a toxic sky. Sullustans live in beautiful advanced cavern-cities and commute to surface factories. Ash angels forage by day; rockrenders own the tunnels at night.

Planet.name: Felucia
Planet.description: Felucia could be considered a sister planet to Kashyyyk. It is a world that is symbiotic in nature, as its mushroom-like forests are all interconnected into one large hivemind. Because of this, the planet is very alive and very aware, the Force surrounding it and binding all of the life on Felucia to it. The planet is also extremely violent towards intruders, its fauna being well known to the inhabitants, the local Felucians and Jungle Felucians, but aggressive towards anything foreign. While the Felucians themselves are loyal to the Republic, the Jungle Felucians are far more intertwined with the planet and do its bidding, whether that be Light or Dark. It is a death trap to any army looking to conquer it, as the planet’s very fauna is hostile, sarlac pits and rancors being but a minor issue compared to the poisonous plants and living forests.

pl.description: Felucia jest żyjącym, symbiotycznym światem grzybowych lasów połączonych w jeden organizm przeniknięty Mocą. Miejscowa fauna oraz roślinność gwałtownie reagują na obcych. Felucianie pozostają lojalni wobec Republiki, lecz leśne klany są silniej związane z wolą planety, zarówno jasną, jak i mroczną. Trujące rośliny, sarlacci, rankory i świadomy las czynią podbój skrajnie niebezpiecznym.

hut.description: Felucia is a living fungal world joined into one Force-bound mind. Native clans understand its moods; invaders meet poisonous flora, rancors, sarlaccs, and an entire forest willing to fight. Occupation is a ruinously expensive proposition.

Planet.name: Rishi
Planet.description: Rishi is a lush tropical planet with many mountain ranges with massive valleys and scattered swamps. Multiple operational listening sights can be found on Rishi. Confidential information can usually be found in secure facilities.

pl.description: Rishi jest bujnym, tropikalnym światem licznych pasm górskich, ogromnych dolin i rozproszonych bagien. Na powierzchni działa kilka posterunków nasłuchowych, a zabezpieczone instalacje przechowują poufne informacje. Ukształtowanie terenu sprzyja ukrywaniu obiektów, lecz utrudnia ich ochronę oraz łączność.

en.description: Rishi is a lush tropical planet with many mountain ranges with massive valleys and scattered swamps. Multiple operational listening sights can be found on Rishi. Confidential information can usually be found in secure facilities.

hut.description: Rishi is a lush tropical world of mountains, great valleys, and scattered swamps. Listening posts and secure facilities hold confidential intelligence. Terrain conceals valuable information but complicates every defense contract.

Planet.name: Christophsis
Planet.description: Christophsis is a crystal-like planet with hexagonally shaped fields and crystal spire trees. In many of these crystal forests were embedded the cities of the Christophsians. Their buildings were high rising towers with many bridges connecting for foot traffic. With a few large and relatively straight roads to connect the different subsections of Christophis, but the people who live here are in a state of rebellion against the CIS. These rebels are being aided by Bail Organa and his own troops.

high_value_targets.name: Trench
high_value_targets.title: Harch Admiral
high_value_targets.intel: The arachnid commander of the invading CIS forces. Highly intelligent and stays in his Capital ship the Invincible.

high_value_targets.name: T-1 Tactical Droid Unit-51283
high_value_targets.title: Droid Commander
high_value_targets.intel: Commands CIS forces on the ground and personally programmed by Admiral Trench.

high_value_targets.name: T-1 Tactical Droid Unit-98342
high_value_targets.title: Droid Commander
high_value_targets.intel: Commands CIS forces on the ground and personally programmed by Admiral Trench.

pl.description: Christophsis jest krystaliczną planetą sześciokątnych pól i drzew przypominających strzeliste kryształy. Miasta Christophsian wznoszą się pośród tych lasów jako zespoły wysokich wież połączonych licznymi kładkami, a dzielnice spajają nieliczne szerokie arterie. Mieszkańcy prowadzą bunt przeciwko CIS, wspierany przez Baila Organę i jego oddziały.

hut.description: Christophsis is a crystal world of hexagonal fields, spire forests, tower cities, bridges, and broad roads. Its people rebel against CIS rule with support from Bail Organa and his troops. Beautiful infrastructure now serves an urban war.

Planet.name: Mandalore
Planet.description: Mandalore is the ancestral homeworld of the Mandalorians. Once a lush and thriving planet, Mandalore was devastated by the Republic during the Mandalorian wars headed by the once Jedi turned Sith, Revan. Its surface is characterized by ancient deserts and ruins, forcing its populace to live in large City-domes. Under the rulership of the recent Duchess Satine Kryze Mandalore has pursued a doctrine of neutrality, much to the horror of cultural-hardliners such as the Death Watch, who opposed Mandalore's new pacifist ideology.

pl.description: Mandalora jest pradawną ojczyzną Mandalorian. Niegdyś bujny świat został spustoszony podczas wojen mandaloriańskich, pozostawiając rozległe pustynie i ruiny; ludność schroniła się w wielkich miastach pod kopułami. Księżna Satine Kryze prowadzi politykę neutralności i pacyfizmu, budząc sprzeciw tradycjonalistów, zwłaszcza Death Watch, którzy chcą przywrócić wojownicze dziedzictwo planety.

hut.description: Mandalore is the ancestral Mandalorian homeworld, reduced by ancient war from fertile land to desert and domed cities. Duchess Satine's neutral pacifism clashes with Death Watch traditionalists who seek to restore the warrior creed.

Planet.name: Mustafar
Planet.description: Mustafar was a young, small planet located in the Mustafar system, within the Atravis sector of the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories. Once a garden world nourished by the Bright Star artifact, its orbit was shifted when Lady Corvax unleashed the energies of the Bright Star in an attempt to return her husband to life. The resulting gravimetric duel between the gas giants Jestefad and Lefrani over Mustafar heated the planet's core, transforming the lush world into an imbalanced volcanic hellscape. Mustafar is home to many known and unknown POIs to include a temple shrinking a locus in the dark side of the force, a Jedi Enclave that has gone missing over time, dozens of mining installations for dozens of companies, a Techno Union Headquarters, Droid Factories, hundreds of mining towns, and the main home of the Black Sun Crime Syndicate, and a Separatist Base.

pl.description: Mustafar jest młodą planetą wulkaniczną Zewnętrznych Rubieży. Niegdyś żyzny świat został wypaczony, gdy energia artefaktu Jasnej Gwiazdy przesunęła orbitę i wciągnęła planetę w grawitacyjny konflikt gazowych olbrzymów Jestefad i Lefrani. Rozgrzane wnętrze przemieniło powierzchnię w morza lawy. Pośród kopalń i miast górniczych znajdują się fabryki droidów, obiekty Unii Technokratycznej, baza Separatystów, siedziby Czarnego Słońca oraz miejsca silnie związane z ciemną stroną Mocy.

hut.description: Mustafar is a volcanic Outer Rim world, once fertile before the Bright Star altered its orbit and rival gas giants heated its core. Lava now surrounds mines, droid factories, Techno Union holdings, Black Sun interests, a Separatista base, and dark-side sites. Danger has many clients.

Planet.name: Bespin
Planet.description: Bespin is one of the largest gas giants in the galaxy, and one of the foremost producers of Tibanna gas in the known galaxy. Despite being a gas giant, where the majority of the atmosphere would kill most species based on pressure and temperature alone, there was a zone called the “Bespin Life Zone” that existed 150 to 180 kilometers down from space. This zone was capable of supporting life and would be used by the Incom Corporation to create their original Tibanna gas mining operations and the well-renowned Cloud City. The planet is inhabited by the infamous Tibannuck, a species of flying mynock-like creatures that actively feed off of the gas. Ever since the original bounty against the species was placed during the Old Republic, by the miners guild, the species has recently begun to become endangered.

pl.description: Bespin jest jednym z największych gazowych olbrzymów i czołowym źródłem tibanny w znanej galaktyce. Większość atmosfery zabija ciśnieniem i temperaturą, lecz 150–180 kilometrów pod granicą przestrzeni znajduje się strefa zdolna podtrzymać życie. Korporacja Incom uruchomiła tam kopalnie gazu i słynne Miasto w Chmurach. Latające tibannucki żywią się gazem, a wielowiekowe nagrody ustanawiane przez gildie górnicze doprowadziły je na skraj wymarcia.

hut.description: Bespin is a vast gas giant and premier tibanna producer. A narrow life zone supports Incom mining operations and Cloud City amid otherwise lethal pressure. Native tibannucks feed on the gas, but old miners' bounties have made the species scarce.

Planet.name: Naboo
Planet.description: The home world of Senator Amidala, and Chancellor Palpatine, Naboo is a world with a rich resource of plasma and sits on the outskirts of the Mid Rim. This planet has a mix of terrain including Plains, Hills, Swamps, Mountains and cities the most notable city would be Theed. Home to Naboo people and the Gungans they never got along but have joined forces in the fight to keep their planet free. Housing only a small garrison of clone troopers, the majority of the fighting force on Naboo are the local defense forces that the Naboo government hosts.

pl.description: Naboo, ojczyzna senator Amidali i kanclerza Palpatine'a, leży na obrzeżach Środkowych Rubieży i posiada bogate zasoby plazmy. Równiny, wzgórza, bagna, góry oraz miasta — przede wszystkim Theed — tworzą urozmaicony krajobraz. Ludzie Naboo i Gunganie, mimo dawnych sporów, połączyli siły w obronie planety. Niewielki garnizon klonów wspiera głównie miejscowe formacje obronne.

en.description: The home world of Senator Amidala, and Chancellor Palpatine, Naboo is a world with a rich resource of plasma and sits on the outskirts of the Mid Rim. hut.description: Naboo is the plasma-rich home of Senator Amidala and Chancellor Palpatine. Plains, swamps, mountains, and Theed support Naboo humans and Gungans, whose alliance defends the world. Local forces carry most of the burden beside a small clone garrison.

Planet.name: Yavin Prime
Planet.description: Yavin Prime, also known simply as Yavin, was an orange gas giant, nearly 200,000 kilometers in diameter, located in the Outer Rim Territories Its clouds provided cover in battle, but death awaited any pilot who dove too far.It was orbited by twenty-six moons, three of which could sustain humanoid life, including Yavin 4, Yavin 8, and Yavin 13. One of those moons, Yavin 4, was once home to the ancient Massassi warriors and was used by the Rebel Alliance.

pl.description: Yavin Prime jest pomarańczowym gazowym olbrzymem Zewnętrznych Rubieży o średnicy niemal dwustu tysięcy kilometrów. Gęste chmury mogą osłaniać manewry podczas bitwy, lecz zejście zbyt głęboko oznacza zagładę statku. Planetę okrąża dwadzieścia sześć księżyców, w tym trzy zdolne podtrzymać humanoidalne życie: Yavin 4, Yavin 8 i Yavin 13. Yavin 4 był niegdyś siedzibą wojowników Massassi.

en.description: Yavin Prime, also known simply as Yavin, was an orange gas giant, nearly 200,000 kilometers in diameter, located in the Outer Rim Territories Its clouds provided cover in battle, but death awaited any pilot who dove too far.It was orbited by twenty-six moons, three of which could sustain humanoid life, including Yavin 4, Yavin 8, and Yavin 13. One of those moons, Yavin 4, was once home to the ancient Massassi warriors and was used by the Rebel Alliance.

hut.description: Yavin Prime is an immense orange gas giant whose clouds conceal fleets and destroy pilots who dive too deep. Twenty-six moons orbit it; Yavin 4, 8, and 13 sustain humanoid life. Ancient Massassi history marks the fourth moon.

Planet.name: Dagobah
Planet.description: Dagobah was a remote, unexplored planet in the Dagobah system, and one of the purest places in the galaxy within the Force. The planet was hot, humid and a hotbed for all types of life coexisting amongst the swampy forest planet. A location named “The Shelter” is on this planet, home to the descendants of a survey team sent to Dagobah, the Descendants are cult-like and call themselves “The Children”. They are cannibalistic.

pl.description: Dagobah jest odległym, niemal niezbadanym światem bagiennych lasów, wysokiej temperatury i wilgoci. Niezwykle bogaty ekosystem współistnieje z jednym z najczystszych skupisk Mocy w galaktyce. W miejscu zwanym Schronieniem żyją potomkowie dawnej ekspedycji badawczej, określający się mianem Dzieci. Ich odizolowana, kultowa społeczność praktykuje kanibalizm, co czyni kontakt szczególnie niebezpiecznym.

en.description: Dagobah was a remote, unexplored planet in the Dagobah system, and one of the purest places in the galaxy within the Force. The planet was hot, humid and a hotbed for all types of life coexisting amongst the swampy forest planet. A location named “The Shelter” is on this planet, home to the descendants of a survey team sent to Dagobah, the Descendants are cult-like and call themselves “The Children”. They are cannibalistic.

hut.description: Dagobah is a remote swamp world, hot, humid, and exceptionally strong in the Force. Life fills every forest and bog. At the Shelter, descendants of an old survey team call themselves the Children; their isolated cannibal cult makes poor trading company.

Planet.name: Tanoa
Planet.description: Tanoa is a campaign adaptation of the South Pacific archipelago terrain. Warm seas surround islands covered by dense rainforest, steep mountains, mangroves and coral shallows. The source setting supports lumber, sugar and mining activity, giving the adapted world a mixed extractive economy alongside scattered ports and settlements. No canonical interstellar census exists for this version of Tanoa, so its population remains unknown. Within the campaign its difficult jungle interior and separated islands make movement costly while increasing the importance of harbors, airfields and local resource sites.

pl.description: Tanoa jest kampanijną adaptacją archipelagu południowego Pacyfiku. Ciepłe morza otaczają wyspy porośnięte gęstym lasem deszczowym, z wysokimi górami, namorzynami i płytkimi rafami koralowymi. Pozyskiwanie drewna, uprawa trzciny cukrowej i górnictwo tworzą zróżnicowaną gospodarkę obok portów oraz rozproszonych osiedli. Brak kanonicznego spisu ludności. Dżungla i oddzielenie wysp zwiększają koszt transportu, wzmacniając znaczenie przystani, lotnisk i lokalnych złóż.

hut.description: Tanoa is a campaign archipelago of warm seas, rainforest, mountains, mangroves, and coral shallows. Lumber, sugar, mining, ports, and scattered settlements shape its mixed economy. Separated islands make harbors and airfields the essential brokers of movement.

Planet.name: Eridanus Secundus
Planet.description: Eridanus Secundus is a hollowed asteroid hidden in the Eridanus system and used as an Insurrectionist base. Rotational engineering provides roughly three quarters of standard gravity inside an oxygen-nitrogen atmosphere, while corridors and chambers combine excavated rock with salvaged human installations. Ferric material in the asteroid and its concealed position made it useful as both refuge and military headquarters. No reliable population figure survives. Its best-known wartime role was as a center of resistance activity and as a target during early Spartan operations.

pl.description: Eridanus Secundus jest wydrążoną asteroidą ukrytą w układzie Eridanus i wykorzystywaną jako baza insurekcjonistów. Ruch obrotowy zapewnia wewnątrz około trzech czwartych standardowej grawitacji, a atmosfera składa się z tlenu i azotu. Korytarze łączą wykutą skałę z odzyskanymi instalacjami. Materiały żelaziste i trudna do wykrycia pozycja uczyniły obiekt schronieniem oraz kwaterą wojskową, znaną z działalności ruchu oporu i wczesnych operacji Spartan.

en.description: Eridanus Secundus is a hollowed asteroid hidden in the Eridanus system and used as an Insurrectionist base. Ferric material in the asteroid and its concealed position made it useful as both refuge and military headquarters. No reliable population figure survives. hut.description: Eridanus Secundus is a hollow asteroid hiding an Insurrectionist base. Rotation supplies partial gravity, oxygen-nitrogen air fills salvaged chambers, and ferric rock supports industry. Concealment made it both refuge and military headquarters during early Spartan operations.

Planet.name: Eridanus
Planet.description: Campaign records use only the abbreviated designation Eridanus for this cratered body. The available map art depicts a cold, scarred surface, but no surviving source confirms whether the marker represents Eridanus II, another object in the Eridanus system or a campaign-original world. To avoid merging separate locations, its climate, population, resources and colonial history remain unclassified. It is retained as an established UNSC navigation point whose strategic value comes from its mapped routes and position, pending a definitive identification in the campaign material.

pl.description: Rejestry kampanii podają wyłącznie skróconą nazwę Eridanus dla tego usianego kraterami ciała. Materiały mapowe przedstawiają zimną, pokrytą bliznami powierzchnię, lecz nie rozstrzygają, czy chodzi o Eridanus II, inny obiekt układu, czy świat stworzony na potrzeby kampanii. Aby nie łączyć odrębnych miejsc, klimat, ludność, zasoby i historia pozostają niesklasyfikowane. Obiekt zachowano jako punkt nawigacyjny UNSC o znaczeniu wynikającym z położenia i istniejących tras.

en.description: Campaign records use only the abbreviated designation Eridanus for this cratered body. To avoid merging separate locations, its climate, population, resources and colonial history remain unclassified. It is retained as an established UNSC navigation point whose strategic value comes from its mapped routes and position, pending a definitive identification in the campaign material.

hut.description: Campaign ledgers identify this cratered cold body only as Eridanus. Whether it is Eridanus II, another system object, or an original world remains unsettled. Climate, population, resources, and history stay unpriced until proper identification.

Planet.name: Arcadia
Planet.description: Arcadia is a lush human Outer Colony with tropical forests, broad agricultural districts and substantial natural resources. Before the UNKNOWN ENEMY assault it supported farming, tourism and major civilian settlements, giving the world both economic value and a population of just under three million in early 2531. The first invasion of that year turned its cities and resource network into a battlefield, but later destruction recorded elsewhere in Halo history is not treated as the campaign's current state. Arcadia remains a strategically exposed colony whose terrain favors dispersed settlements and ground operations.

pl.description: Arcadia jest bujną ludzką Kolonią Zewnętrzną o lasach tropikalnych, rozległych terenach rolniczych i znacznych zasobach naturalnych. Przed atakiem NIEZNANY WRÓG rozwijała rolnictwo, turystykę i duże osiedla cywilne; na początku 2531 roku liczyła niespełna trzy miliony mieszkańców. Pierwsza inwazja przemieniła miasta oraz sieć wydobywczą w pole bitwy. Późniejsze zniszczenia znane z historii Halo nie są jeszcze stanem bieżącej kampanii.

en.description: Arcadia is a lush human Outer Colony with tropical forests, broad agricultural districts and substantial natural resources. Before the UNKNOWN ENEMY assault it supported farming, tourism and major civilian settlements, giving the world both economic value and a population of just under three million in early 2531. The first invasion of that year turned its cities and resource network into a battlefield, but later destruction recorded elsewhere in Halo history is not treated as the campaign's current state. Arcadia remains a strategically exposed colony whose terrain favors dispersed settlements and ground operations.

hut.description: Arcadia is a lush human Outer Colony of tropical forest, agriculture, tourism, and natural resources. Nearly three million people lived there in early 2531 before UNKNOWN RIVAL attack turned cities and extraction networks into a battlefield. Later devastation has not yet entered this campaign ledger.

Planet.name: Stratis
Planet.description: Stratis is a campaign adaptation of a small North Aegean island terrain. Rocky hills, dry scrub, narrow valleys and exposed Mediterranean coasts shape the settled area. In its source setting the island was reorganized around military facilities after plans for renewable civilian development, leaving airfields and defensive positions as its most important infrastructure. No canonical interstellar population or planetary resource census exists for the adaptation. Its value in the campaign is therefore logistical and military, based on a compact, defensible landscape and access to surrounding space routes.

pl.description: Stratis jest kampanijną adaptacją niewielkiego terenu wyspiarskiego północnego Morza Egejskiego. Skaliste wzgórza, sucha roślinność, wąskie doliny i odsłonięte śródziemnomorskie wybrzeża kształtują osadnictwo. W materiale źródłowym plany cywilnego rozwoju odnawialnego ustąpiły infrastrukturze wojskowej, przez co lotniska i pozycje obronne stały się najważniejszymi obiektami. Brak międzygwiezdnego spisu ludności i zasobów; znaczenie kampanijne jest przede wszystkim logistyczne oraz wojskowe.

hut.description: Stratis is a campaign island adaptation of rocky hills, dry scrub, valleys, and exposed coast. Military facilities replaced plans for civilian renewable development. Airfields, defenses, and a compact landscape define its logistical value.

Planet.name: Earth
Planet.description: Earth is humanity's homeworld, the capital of the Unified Earth Government and the principal headquarters of the UNSC. Oceans, varied continents and climates support the largest human population, while dense cities, industry, research institutions and orbital infrastructure make the planet the center of the wartime economy. Before the Battle of Earth its population was approximately ten billion. The world also anchors the defenses of the Sol system. Later invasion losses are not applied to the current campaign state, which represents the continuing Human-UNKNOWN ENEMY War before that destruction.

pl.description: Ziemia jest kolebką ludzkości, stolicą Zjednoczonego Rządu Ziemi i główną kwaterą UNSC. Oceany, zróżnicowane kontynenty oraz strefy klimatyczne podtrzymują największą populację ludzką. Gęste miasta, przemysł, ośrodki badawcze i infrastruktura orbitalna tworzą centrum gospodarki wojennej. Przed Bitwą o Ziemię mieszkało tam około dziesięciu miliardów ludzi. Późniejszych strat inwazji nie zastosowano do bieżącego stanu kampanii, który przedstawia wcześniejszy etap wojny z NIEZNANY WRÓG.

hut.description: Earth is humanity's home, UEG capital, and UNSC headquarters. Ten billion people, great cities, industry, research, and orbital works anchor the wartime economy and Sol defenses. Later invasion losses have not yet been charged to this campaign.

Planet.name: Mars
Planet.description: Mars is a cold, arid and partially terraformed human world in the Sol system. Long-established cities and sealed industrial zones support heavy manufacturing, shipyards and military logistics, making the planet an important partner to Earth rather than a minor frontier colony. Halo records also associate Mars and its moons with UNSC training, detention and defense facilities. No dependable campaign-era population figure is available, so the census remains unknown. Its economic significance rests on industry and orbital construction, while its thin atmosphere and harsh exterior still constrain open settlement.

pl.description: Mars jest zimnym, suchym i częściowo terraformowanym światem ludzkim w Układzie Słonecznym. Dawne miasta oraz szczelne strefy przemysłowe wspierają ciężką produkcję, stocznie i logistykę wojskową, czyniąc planetę ważnym partnerem Ziemi. Zapisy Halo wiążą Marsa i jego księżyce również z ośrodkami szkoleniowymi, więziennymi i obronnymi UNSC. Brak wiarygodnego spisu ludności z okresu kampanii; cienka atmosfera i surowa powierzchnia nadal ograniczają otwarte osadnictwo.

HoloNetArticle.summary: Obrona Altis załamała się po odcięciu ostatnich szlaków zaopatrzenia. Republika koncentruje flotę i armię, a Senat przygotowuje odpowiedź na zwycięstwo CIS.
HoloNetArticle.description:
PILNE — ALTIS. Ostatnie zorganizowane punkty obrony planety przestały odpowiadać po przerwaniu drogi łączącej zachodnie miasta z magazynami centralnymi. Mandaloriańskie oddziały nadal walczą w rozproszonych grupach, lecz administracja Altis utraciła łączność z portami, elektrowniami i większością schronów. Tysiące mieszkańców oczekują na ewakuację.

Konfederacja ogłosiła zakończenie „operacji zabezpieczającej” i wezwała ludność do podporządkowania się nowym władzom. Jej komunikat obiecuje przywrócenie dostaw oraz amnestię dla obrońców, którzy złożą broń. Z powierzchni napływają jednak doniesienia o konfiskatach, kontrolach dzielnic i zatrzymaniach osób związanych z lokalnymi klanami.

Na Coruscant skończyła się dotychczasowa ostrożność. Flota otrzymała rozkaz koncentracji, a Armia Republiki przegrupowuje oddziały z misji patrolowych. Źródła wojskowe przyznają, że mobilizacja jest pospieszna: część jednostek nadal używa wyposażenia Fazy I, zapasy rozrzucono po odległych placówkach, a wspólne dowodzenie większymi związkami dopiero powstaje.

„Nie składamy broni. Altis nie będzie końcem naszej historii” — przekazał jeden z ocalałych dowódców. W wielu systemach odbywają się demonstracje solidarności, a mandaloriańskie klany organizują własne transporty. Formalna decyzja o wojnie jeszcze nie zapadła, lecz upadek Altis stał się granicą, po której powrót do wcześniejszego porządku wydaje się niemożliwy. W całej galaktyce rozpoczęło się gorączkowe liczenie sił.

en.title: Altis Has Fallen. The Republic Says: Enough
en.summary: The defense of Altis collapsed after its last supply routes were severed. The Republic is concentrating its fleet and army while the Senate prepares its answer to the CIS victory.
en.body:
BREAKING — ALTIS. The planet's last organized defensive positions have fallen silent after the road linking the western cities with the central depots was cut. Mandalorian troops continue to fight in scattered groups, but the Altis administration has lost contact with its ports, power stations, and most shelters. Thousands of residents await evacuation.

The Confederacy has proclaimed the end of its “security operation” and called upon the population to submit to the new authorities. Its communiqué promises restored deliveries and amnesty for defenders who lay down their arms. Reports from the surface, however, speak of confiscations, district searches, and the detention of people associated with the local clans.

Coruscant's former caution has ended. The fleet has been ordered to concentrate, and the Republic Army is regrouping formations withdrawn from patrol duties. Military sources concede that the mobilization is hurried: some units still rely on Phase I equipment, supplies are dispersed among distant outposts, and a unified command for larger formations is only now being established.

“We are not laying down our arms. Altis will not be the end of our story,” one surviving commander declared. Demonstrations of solidarity are taking place across numerous systems, while Mandalorian clans organize transports of their own. No formal declaration of war has yet been issued, but the fall of Altis has become a threshold beyond which a return to the former order appears impossible. Across the galaxy, every power has begun feverishly taking stock of its strength.

hut.title: Altis Has Fallen. Republica Says: Enough
hut.summary: Altis defense broke after the last supply lanes were cut. Republica gathers fleet and army while the Senate weighs its answer to the CIS victory.
hut.body:
BREAKING — ALTIS. The planet's last ordered defenses went silent after the road from the western cities to the central depots was severed. Mandaloriana fighters still resist in scattered bands, but the Altis bosses have lost contact with ports, power stations, and most shelters. Thousands wait for passage offworld.

Confederacy has declared its “security operation” complete and ordered the people to accept new rule. Its message promises restored cargo and amnesty for defenders who surrender their weapons. Surface reports tell a harsher bargain: seized goods, district searches, and arrests among the local clans.

Coruscant has spent its last measure of caution. The fleet gathers; the Republica army pulls troops from patrol work. Mala commanders admit the mobilization is rushed. Some formations still carry Phase I kit, supplies lie scattered across distant outposts, and one command for the great formations is only now being forged.

“We do not yield our arms. Altis will not be the end of our story,” one surviving commander said. Systems across the galaxy hold solidarity marches, and Mandaloriana clans ready transports of their own. The Senate has not yet spoken the formal word for war, but the fall of Altis has closed the road back to the old order. Every power now counts its ships, soldiers, credits, and debts.

HoloNetArticle.summary: CIS zamknęło szlaki do Altis i uderzyło na porty oraz łączność. Podzieleni obrońcy proszą Republikę o korytarz humanitarny i polityczne wsparcie.
HoloNetArticle.description:
ALTIS — Siły Konfederacji zamknęły główne szlaki prowadzące do planety i rozpoczęły skoordynowane uderzenia na mandaloriańskie porty, magazyny oraz węzły łączności. Droidy nacierają równocześnie w kilku regionach, zmuszając obrońców do dzielenia szczupłych rezerw. Transporty cywilne zawracają, a ceny żywności i leków rosną z każdą godziną.

Altis nie ma jednego ośrodka dowodzenia. Miasta, klany i lokalne milicje bronią własnych sektorów, lecz używają różnych częstotliwości i nie uzgodniły priorytetów. „Walczymy o te same ziemie, ale każdy otrzymuje inne rozkazy” — przekazał jeden z obrońców. Konfederacja wykorzystuje chaos, obchodząc umocnienia i przecinając drogi między nimi.

Przedstawiciele planety zwrócili się do Republiki o otwarcie korytarza humanitarnego oraz uznanie działań CIS za agresję. Coruscant wysłało pomoc medyczną i obserwatorów, ale nie zdecydowało o pełnej interwencji. Armia pozostaje rozproszona na szlakach patrolowych, a część senatorów ostrzega, że wejście do systemu może rozpocząć wojnę na skalę galaktyczną.

Na powierzchni przybywa uchodźców. Organizacje pomocowe próbują docierać małymi statkami, lecz blokada przepuszcza wyłącznie ładunki zatwierdzone przez CIS. Altis nadal walczy, a nocne transmisje pokazują działające baterie obronne i improwizowane szpitale. Bez wspólnego dowodzenia oraz zewnętrznych dostaw obrońcy mogą jednak nie utrzymać portów wystarczająco długo, by pomoc zdążyła nadejść.

en.title: Altis Under Siege: Mandalorians Appeal for Aid
en.summary: The CIS has closed the routes to Altis and struck its ports and communications. The divided defenders are asking the Republic for a humanitarian corridor and political support.
en.body:
ALTIS — Confederate forces have closed the principal routes to the planet and launched coordinated strikes against Mandalorian ports, depots, and communications nodes. Droids are advancing simultaneously through several regions, forcing the defenders to divide their meager reserves. Civilian transports are turning back, while the prices of food and medicine rise by the hour.

Altis has no unified command. Its cities, clans, and local militias defend their own sectors, yet operate on different frequencies and have not agreed upon common priorities. “We are fighting for the same land, but every force receives different orders,” one defender reported. The Confederacy is exploiting the disorder by bypassing strongpoints and severing the roads between them.

Planetary representatives have asked the Republic to establish a humanitarian corridor and formally recognize CIS actions as aggression. Coruscant has dispatched medical aid and observers but has not authorized full intervention. The army remains dispersed along patrol routes, and some senators warn that entering the system could ignite a galaxy-wide war.

The number of refugees on the surface continues to grow. Relief organizations are attempting to reach them in small vessels, but the blockade permits only cargo approved by the CIS. Altis continues to resist; nightly transmissions still show active defensive batteries and improvised hospitals. Without unified command and outside supplies, however, the defenders may not hold the ports long enough for help to arrive.

hut.title: Altis Under Siege: Mandaloriana Call for Aid
hut.summary: CIS has closed the Altis routes and struck ports and comms. Divided defenders ask Republica for a mercy corridor and political backing.
hut.body:
ALTIS — Confederacy forces have sealed the main routes to the planet and struck Mandaloriana ports, depots, and communication nodes in one plan. Droids advance through several regions at once, forcing defenders to split thin reserves. Civilian transports turn away, and food and medicine grow dearer each hour.

Altis has no single boss of battle. Cities, clans, and militias guard their own sectors, but speak on different frequencies and follow different priorities. “We fight for the same soil, yet every unit receives another order,” one defender reported. Confederacy profits from the disorder, slipping past strongpoints and cutting the roads between them.

Planetary envoys ask Republica to open a mercy corridor and name CIS action for what it is: aggression. Coruscant has sent medicine and observers but not full intervention. The army remains scattered on patrol routes, while senators warn that entering the system may set the whole galaxy to mala.

Refugees gather across the surface. Relief crews try to reach them in small ships, but the blockade admits only cargo approved by CIS. Altis still fights; nightly transmissions show live defense batteries and makeshift hospitals. Without one command and outside supplies, the defenders may lose the ports before help can cross the void.

HoloNetArticle.summary: Raporty z Kabal pokazują, że armia przygotowana do krótkich misji policyjnych coraz częściej walczy z przeciwnikiem działającym jak regularne wojsko.
HoloNetArticle.description:
KABAL — RAPORT TERENOWY. Po starciach wokół stacji przekaźnikowej klony opisują przeciwnika wyraźnie różniącego się od piratów ze szlaków Savareen. Separatystyczne oddziały potrafią utrzymać pozycje, wycofać się pod osłoną i wrócić z nowym planem. Każdy taki kryzys pozostaje lokalny, lecz razem tworzą obraz narastającego konfliktu.

„Po pierwszej godzinie nadal wykonujesz zadanie zgodnie z instrukcją. Po trzecim dniu kończą się części, sen i pewność, skąd nadejdzie następny atak” — mówi żołnierz, którego oznaczenia ukryto. Największym problemem nie jest wyszkolenie, lecz logistyka: amunicja, łączność, ewakuacja rannych oraz brak wspólnych ćwiczeń większych formacji.

Personel medyczny zgłasza podobne trudności. Zespoły projektowane do szybkiego zabezpieczenia obiektu muszą utrzymywać punkty pomocy pod ostrzałem, a transporty krążą między placówkami rozrzuconymi po planecie. Dowództwo zna te uwagi i prosi o dodatkowe magazyny, sprawniejsze pojazdy oraz procedury przekazywania rozkazów między legionami.

Senatorowie odpowiadają, że Konfederacja nie wystawiła jeszcze regularnej armii przeciw Republice, a kosztowna mobilizacja mogłaby przyspieszyć eskalację. Klony wykonują swoje zadania, lecz każde zwycięstwo wymaga więcej czasu i zasobów. Kabal jest ostrzeżeniem: małe wojny mogą stać się jedną wielką wojną wcześniej, niż instytucje Republiki zdążą ją oficjalnie nazwać. Czasu jest mało.

en.title: Small Wars, Grave Warning
en.summary: Reports from Kabal show that an army prepared for brief policing missions is increasingly confronting an adversary that behaves like a regular military force.
en.body:
KABAL — FIELD REPORT. Following the fighting around the relay station, clone soldiers describe an enemy markedly different from the pirates of the Savareen routes. Separatist troops can hold ground, withdraw under cover, and return with a revised plan. Each crisis remains local in isolation; together, they depict a conflict steadily gathering force.

“After the first hour, you are still carrying out the mission according to the manual. By the third day, you are running out of parts, sleep, and any certainty about where the next attack will come from,” said a soldier whose identifying marks were withheld. The greatest weakness is not training but logistics: ammunition, communications, casualty evacuation, and the absence of joint exercises among larger formations.

Medical personnel report the same strain. Teams designed to secure a facility quickly must instead sustain aid stations under fire, while transports circulate among outposts scattered across the planet. Command has acknowledged these concerns and requested additional depots, more reliable vehicles, and procedures for transferring orders between legions.

Senators reply that the Confederacy has not yet fielded a regular army against the Republic and that costly mobilization could accelerate escalation. The clones continue to fulfill their missions, but every victory demands more time and materiel. Kabal is a warning: many small wars may become one great war before the Republic's institutions are prepared to give it that name. Time is growing short.

hut.title: Small Mala, Great Warning
hut.summary: Kabal reports show an army built for brief police work meeting enemies who fight like regular soldiers.
hut.body:
KABAL — FIELD REPORT. After the struggle around the relay station, clone troopers describe a foe unlike the pirates of Savareen. Separatista troops hold ground, retreat beneath cover, and return with a new plan. Each crisis may look local, but together they show one conflict growing teeth.

“In the first hour, the manual still answers you. By the third day, you have no spare parts, no sleep, and no certainty where the next attack will rise,” said a soldier whose marks were hidden. Training is not the deepest weakness. Koona is: ammunition, comms, wounded transport, and no common drills for the larger formations.

Medical crews report the same strain. Teams meant to secure one place quickly must keep aid stations alive under fire, while transports circle between outposts scattered across the planet. Command asks for more depots, sounder vehicles, and clear rules for passing orders between legions.

Senators answer that Confederacy has not yet sent a regular army against Republica, and that costly mobilization may hasten escalation. The clones still win, but each victory takes more time and materiel. Kabal is the warning: many small mala may become one great mala before Republica finds the courage to name it.

HoloNetArticle.summary: Komisja Zaopatrzenia odłożyła pełne wdrożenie Fazy II. Wojskowi ostrzegają, że sprzęt i struktura armii coraz słabiej odpowiadają dłuższym kryzysom.
HoloNetArticle.description:
KAMINO — Komisja Zaopatrzenia odłożyła szerokie wdrożenie wyposażenia określanego jako Faza II. Program obejmuje nie tylko nowy pancerz, ale też lepszą łączność, ochronę medyczną, wyposażenie specjalistyczne i logistykę dla oddziałów działających z dala od baz. Komisja uznała jednak, że obecne zagrożenia nie uzasadniają natychmiastowych kosztów.

Zwolennicy decyzji wskazują na udane operacje przeciw piratom i skorumpowanym urzędnikom. „Projektowanie całej struktury pod najgorszy scenariusz może uczynić ten scenariusz bardziej prawdopodobnym” — powiedział jeden z senatorów. Według niego widok ciężko uzbrojonych legionów w spokojnych systemach wzmocni propagandę Konfederacji i obawy przed centralizacją.

Wojskowi przedstawiają mniej uspokajający obraz. Pancerz Fazy I sprawdza się podczas abordażu i krótkiego zabezpieczenia obiektu, ale dłuższe rozmieszczenia ujawniają problemy z częściami, sensorami i komunikacją. Kaminoańscy specjaliści proponują stopniowe ulepszenia, zaczynając od jednostek najbardziej narażonych na odcięcie od zaplecza. Instruktorzy domagają się również wspólnych ćwiczeń większych związków.

Faza II nie została anulowana. Dokumentacja, prototypy i linie przygotowawcze pozostają gotowe, lecz nie podano nowego terminu. Decyzja daje budżetowi chwilę oddechu, jednocześnie powiększając różnicę między armią przeznaczoną do utrzymania porządku a siłą potrzebną do prowadzenia wojny. Jeśli kryzysy będą narastać, oszczędność może okazać się najdroższym wyborem Senatu.

en.title: Is Phase I Enough? Senate Defers Clone Army Modernization
en.summary: The Supply Commission has postponed full Phase II deployment. Military officials warn that the army's equipment and structure are increasingly ill-suited to prolonged crises.
en.body:
KAMINO — The Supply Commission has deferred the broad deployment of equipment designated Phase II. The program encompasses not only new armor but improved communications, medical protection, specialist equipment, and logistics for units operating far from their bases. The commission nevertheless concluded that present threats do not justify the immediate expense.

Supporters of the decision point to successful operations against pirates and corrupt officials. “Designing the entire force around the worst possible scenario may make that scenario more likely,” one senator said. In his view, heavily armed legions stationed in peaceful systems would strengthen Confederate propaganda and deepen fears of centralization.

Military assessments are less reassuring. Phase I armor performs adequately during boarding actions and brief facility security missions, but longer deployments expose deficiencies in spare parts, sensors, and communications. Kaminoan specialists propose gradual improvements beginning with units most vulnerable to isolation from support. Instructors are also demanding joint exercises for larger formations.

Phase II has not been canceled. Documentation, prototypes, and preparatory production lines remain ready, but no new date has been announced. The decision gives the budget a moment of respite while widening the gulf between an army designed to preserve order and the force required to wage a war. If the crises continue to mount, today's economy may become the Senate's most expensive decision.

hut.title: Is Phase I Enough? Senate Delays Clone Army Renewal
hut.summary: The Supply Commission has delayed full Phase II deployment. Mala officers warn that army equipment and structure no longer fit prolonged crises.
hut.body:
KAMINO — The Supply Commission has delayed the broad issue of Phase II equipment. The program is more than new armor: it brings stronger comms, medical protection, specialist gear, and koona for units far from their bases. The commission says present dangers do not yet justify the credits.

Friends of the decision point to victories over pirates and corrupt bosses. “Build the whole force for the worst future and you may summon that future,” one senator argued. Heavy legions in peaceful systems, he says, would feed Confederacy words and fear of Coruscant's grasp.

Mala officers offer a colder ledger. Phase I armor serves in boarding actions and short security jobs, but long deployments expose poor parts, sensors, and comms. Kaminoana specialists propose gradual upgrades, first for units most likely to be cut from support. Instructors also demand common drills for the great formations.

Phase II is not dead. Plans, prototypes, and prepared lines remain ready, but no new date has been named. The choice buys the budget one quiet breath while widening the gulf between an army that keeps order and one that survives war. If crises multiply, this saving may become the Senate's costliest bargain.

HoloNetArticle.summary: Komentatorzy z Raxus odrzucają republikańską narrację o piractwie i żądają jawnych umów, niezależnych obserwatorów oraz kontroli nad każdą interwencją klonów.
HoloNetArticle.description:
RAXUS — KOMENTARZ KONFEDERACYJNY. Wydarzenia na Kabal nie były nagłym atakiem piratów na pokojową placówkę. Poprzedziły je miesiące sporów o stację przekaźnikową, podatki i obecność republikańskich oddziałów. Coruscant opisuje pierwszy strzał, ale pomija decyzje, które doprowadziły mieszkańców i miejscową milicję do blokady.

Nie każde działanie milicji było rozsądne i nie każdy dowódca reprezentował ludność. Nie usprawiedliwia to jednak traktowania politycznego sprzeciwu jak działalności przestępczej. Republika wskazuje sukcesy na Savareen i Koorivie, choć właśnie tam wojskowa skuteczność zastąpiła debatę o tym, kto zaprosił klony, określił ich mandat i może nakazać im odejść.

Klony nie są winne polityce, którą wykonują. Odpowiedzialność spoczywa na instytucjach wydających rozkazy bez przejrzystej kontroli. Konfederacja wzywa systemy do publikowania umów z Coruscant, dokumentowania zatrzymań oraz tworzenia wspólnych komisji zdolnych sprawdzić, czy „tymczasowa” obecność wojskowa naprawdę pozostaje tymczasowa.

Raxus proponuje międzyplanetarny zespół obserwatorów, który przybywałby równocześnie z oddziałami Republiki i składał jawne raporty obu stronom. Na Kabal broń ucichła, ale zasadniczy spór trwa. Jeżeli każdy opór nadal będzie nazywany piractwem, kolejne systemy uznają, że jedyną drogą do zachowania autonomii jest opuszczenie Republiki, zanim pod ich portami pojawią się transportowce z klonami.
